title: Retail Backroom Coordinator
description:
HomeGoods

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

  • Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
  • Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
  • Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
  • Trains and mentors Associates on established merchandising and processing principles
  • Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
  • Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
  • Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
  • Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
  • Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
  • Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
  • Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
  • Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
  • Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
  • Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
  • Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
  • Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
  • Promotes credit and loyalty programs
  • Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
  • Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
  • Other duties as assigned

Who We’re Looking For: You.

  • Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
  • Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Capable of multi-tasking
  • Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
  • Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Able to train others
  • 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

17641 N Dale Mabry Blvd

Location:

USA HomeGoods Store 0394 Lutz FL

title: Controls Technician III (Engineering)
description:
TBD

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Troubleshoot and repair PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.
  • Program, modify, and maintain PLC logic using platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider, or Omron.
  • Configure and troubleshoot HMIs and SCADA systems.
  • Install, calibrate, and maintain industrial instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, and level devices.
  • Troubleshoot servo systems, motion control, robotics, and variable frequency drives (VFDs).
  • Diagnose electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-related failures.
  • Interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and control drawings.
  • Perform preventative and predictive maintenance on automation systems.
  • Support equipment startups, commissioning, and production changeovers.
  • Configure industrial communication networks including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, DeviceNet, and other fieldbus systems.
  • Perform system backups, software version control, and documentation updates.
  • Assist engineers with new equipment installations and automation upgrades.
  • Recommend and implement continuous improvement projects that increase equipment reliability and productivity.
  • Mentor Controls Technicians I and II on troubleshooting techniques and best practices.
  • Coordinate with maintenance, engineering, operations, and outside vendors to resolve equipment issues.
  • Ensure compliance with electrical codes, company standards, and safety regulations including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO).
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records using a CMMS.
  • Participate in on-call support and respond to emergency equipment failures as required.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to climb ladders and work from elevated platforms.
  • Ability to work in confined spaces when necessary.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach for extended periods.
  • Ability to distinguish wire colors and read detailed electrical drawings.
  • Must be able to work in industrial environments with varying temperatures, noise levels, and moving machinery.
  • Exposure to electrical equipment, rotating machinery, compressed air systems, and production processes.
  • May require overtime, weekend work, and on-call responsibilities.
  • Appropriate PPE is required.
  • Up to 25% Travel with occasional international travel.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5–8 years of industrial controls or automation experience.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems up to 480 VAC.
  • Experience troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and industrial automation equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Experience using electrical test equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, and process calibrators.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, CompactLogix, FactoryTalk View, Siemens TIA Portal, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to CNC motion control (Omron-Delta Tau, Siemens).
  • Knowledge of robotics (FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, or Universal Robots).
  • Experience with industrial networking and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience supporting SCADA and MES systems.
  • OSHA safety training or NFPA 70E certification.
  • ISA Certified Control Systems Technician (CCST) certification.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • PLC Programming and Troubleshooting
  • HMI Development and Support
  • SCADA Systems
  • Industrial Networking
  • Servo and Motion Control
  • VFD Configuration
  • Robotics Integration
  • Instrumentation and Calibration
  • Electrical Troubleshooting
  • Control Panel Design and Wiring
  • Preventive and Predictive Maintenance
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
  • CMMS Software
  • Microsoft Office Suite

title: Warehouser
description:
The Warehouser will support NOV’s Cedar Park Texas facility by efficiently receiving, inspecting, identifying, storing, and distributing parts, supplies, and equipment. The role includes operating forklifts, hand trucks, cranes, and other material handling tools, preparing finished products for shipment, maintaining accurate inventory records, and keeping the warehouse clean, orderly, and safe. Work is performed onsite.

  • Receive, inspect, and store incoming materials, verifying part numbers and accompanying documentation.
  • Pick, pack, shrink wrap, box, label, and stage finished products for loading onto trucks or carriers.
  • Load and unload trucks and carrier vehicles using forklifts, hand trucks, cranes, hoists, and other equipment.
  • Move materials to designated storage locations and maintain organized aisles and bins.
  • Generate, distribute, and reconcile picking lists, ensuring accurate material selection and staging.
  • Assist in physical inventories and cycle counts, posting receipts and disbursements in the inventory system.
  • Verify and store materials from manufacturing and receiving inspection in assigned locations.
  • Maintain a clean, orderly, and safe warehouse environment, reporting any equipment issues promptly.
  • Operate warehouse machinery safely and follow all safety procedures and PPE requirements.
  • Provide support to Shipping and Receiving teams as needed.
  • Perform other work-related tasks as required and assigned.
  • Comply with all NOV Company and HSE procedures and policies.
  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Forklift certification and experience operating forklifts, hand trucks, cranes, and other material handling equipment, preferred.
  • Basic math skills and ability to read part numbers, inventory labels, and shipping documents.
  • Experience with packaging, shrink wrapping, boxing, and labeling finished goods.
  • Ability to lift and move items up to 40 lb (heavier items with equipment).
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in keeping and inventory tracking.
  • Knowledge of safety procedures and commitment to a safe work environment.
  • Basic computer skills for inventory systems and picking list management.
  • Reliability, punctuality, and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Clear communication skills and willingness to follow instructions.

Work Environment

  • Working conditions are normal for a manufacturing environment.
  • Work involves frequent lifting of materials and product up to 40 pounds.
  • Machinery operation requires the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, Steel toed work boots, and hardhats.
  • Works under immediate supervision.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to fumes, vapors, or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment can be loud.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The essential functions, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include the characteristic duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, and abilities noted herein; however, this is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by positions found in this job description.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:
Customer Focus, Time Management, Integrity, Trust and Functional/Technical Skills

title: Operation Supervisor
description:
The Operations Supervisor for National Oilwell Varco, L.P. Coordinates Field Service Specialists, oversees the preparation, testing, and installation of NOV Completion Tools at customer sites, and actively engages in sales support to grow the regional customer base while maintaining the highest safety and quality standards.

  • Coordinate daily assignments and on‑call rotations for Field Service Specialists and related equipment.
  • Review daily progress, identify issues, and report status to management.
  • Oversee preparation, assembly, testing, and pre‑installation checks of NOV Completion Tools to ensure 100% customer satisfaction.
  • Perform hydraulic calculations, equipment calibrations, and verify specifications against job requirements.
  • Oversee installation of all equipment at customer job sites
  • Support recruitment, training, and development of local personnel.
  • Drive sales support by following up on leads, providing technical input, and assisting proposal development.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, schematics, field tickets, and inventory records.
  • Enforce safety regulations, lead PPE compliance, and execute corrective actions as needed.
  • Identify process improvements and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Minimum 5 years experience in unconventional completions with hands‑on tool knowledge.
  • In‑depth technical expertise in downhole tools, liner hangers, packers, stage and coil tools, and NOV Completion Tools operations.
  • Ability to perform downhole hydraulic calculations, displacements, buoyancy and pressure analyses.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive) and ERP/CRM systems.
  • Strong customer‑focus and proven ability to support sales and service activities.
  • Demonstrated leadership, conflict management, and timely decision‑making skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and residence within the service area.
  • Ability to pass a physical test and meet all HSE requirements, including PPE training.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and customer interaction.
  • Commitment to safety leadership and completion of required safety training.

title: Inspection Crewman - Grinder Operator

title: General Manager
company: Canopy Lawn Care of Lexington, KY
description:
Benefits:
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development
Opportunity for Business Equity

Are you a dynamic leader with a proven track record in lawn care, sales, and team management? Do you have experience as a spray technician, a passion for growing a business, and a drive to exceed goals? If you're a self-starter with the skills to inspire a team and demand excellence in customer service, we want you to join Canopy Lawn Care as our next General Manager. Working at a Growing company, starting at the grown floor, skies the limit!!

Why Canopy Lawn Care?

At Canopy Lawn Care, we're more than just a lawn care company – we're a rapidly growing team committed to delivering top-notch services and exceptional customer satisfaction. As we expand, we are looking for an ambitious, goal-oriented individual to lead our team, oversee operations, and contribute to our continued success. With a focus on quality, integrity, and long-term growth, this role offers not only competitive compensation but the opportunity to gain business equity and make a lasting impact on our organization.

Who We’re Looking For:

We’re looking for a highly motivated General Manager who has:

  • Experience in Lawn Care: Proven track record as a Spray Technician or in a related role, with experience managing operations and teams.
  • Strong Sales & Business Development Skills: You know how to drive sales, grow customer relationships, and enhance customer retention.
  • Leadership & Management Expertise: You can effectively manage a team, ensuring operational efficiency, service quality, and meeting performance targets.
  • A Self-Starter Mentality: You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where you can take the initiative and deliver results.
  • Goal-Oriented & Results-Driven: You set and exceed goals, and you hold yourself and your team to the highest standards of excellence.
  • Commitment to Perfection: You have an eye for detail, delivering outstanding service and ensuring customer satisfaction at every level.
Job Summary:

As the General Manager at Canopy Lawn Care, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of our lawn care service, growing a team as the business grows. You’ll manage customer relations, drive sales, and implement operational strategies to increase efficiency and service quality. In addition, you will foster a positive work culture, coaching and developing your team to achieve their goals.

This position is ideal for someone looking to build a long-term career with the potential to take on business equity as the company grows.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage, and motivate a team of lawn care professionals to ensure service excellence.
  • Drive sales by developing and implementing effective strategies to expand the customer base.
  • Ensure that all operational aspects (quality control, scheduling, customer satisfaction) run smoothly.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, offering personalized service and addressing concerns promptly.
  • Maintain high standards for service delivery, safety, and compliance with industry regulations.
Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in lawn care, including spray tech and management experience.
  • Strong sales skills with a demonstrated ability to grow a customer base and increase revenue.
  • Proven leadership ability with experience managing teams and operations.
  • Self-motivated and driven with a strong desire to meet and exceed goals.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Pay & Benefits: Attractive compensation package with performance-based incentives.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: Clear path to advancement with the opportunity for business equity.
Ready to Take Your Career to the Next Level?

If you’re an experienced leader with a passion for lawn care and a drive to help businesses grow, we encourage you to apply today! Canopy Lawn Care is looking for long-term partners who want to help shape our future. We offer a supportive, rewarding environment with tremendous opportunities for growth and business ownership.

title: Clerk
description:
What You'll Do

You will perform a variety of clerical tasks including answering telephones, managing records, processing documents, and maintaining office systems. Responsibilities also include organizing materials, managing calendars, and supporting office operations through filing, inventory, and correspondence. Occasional travel may be required for business purposes.

Essential Functions

  • Answer telephones, direct calls, and take messages.
  • Communicate with customers, employees, and other individuals to provide information, take orders, and address concerns.
  • Compile, copy, sort, and file records of office activities and business transactions.
  • Complete and mail bills, contracts, policies, invoices, or checks and process documents.
  • Manage calendars, arrange appointments, and maintain filing, inventory, mailing, and database systems.
  • Operate office machines such as photocopiers, scanners, and computers; organize materials as needed.
  • Review files, records, and other documents to obtain information and respond to requests.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) preferred, or minimum 1 year of work experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience providing customer service in a professional setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with customers and team members in both written and verbal formats.
  • Experience with filing systems, Warehouse Management Systems, Microsoft Office Suite, calculators, desktop computers, and photocopiers.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide whole numbers, fractions, and decimals.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
  • Ability to pay close attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and respond appropriately to feedback.

Physical Requirements

  • Requires several hours per day of sitting, getting up and down from chairs, reaching, and/or bending.
  • Requires manual dexterity with normal hand and finger movements for typical office work, including the operation of computers, telephones, and similar equipment.
  • Requires ability to comprehend and communicate with others, verbally and/or in writing.
  • May require travel by automobile and airplane for business.
  • May require visits to warehouse operations in temperatures at or below freezing.
  • May require the occasional lifting, carrying, positioning, and/or moving of objects weighing up to 20 pounds.

title: Navigator I
description:
Navigator I
Community Bridges, Inc. (CB I) is an integrated behavioral healthcare agency offering a variety of different programs throughout Arizona. CBI provides residential, outpatient, inpatient, patient-centered medical homes, medication-assisted treatment, and crisis services to individuals experiencing crisis, opioid use disorder, homelessness, and mental illness.

CBI is the premiere non-profit fully integrated healthcare provider of substance use and behavioral health programs in Arizona, including prevention, education and treatment using cutting-edge, nationally recognized, evidence-based models.

Job Summary

The primary role of the Navigator I is to enhance the likelihood of success, identify and reduce barriers for clients and connect them with needed services and resources. The Navigator will work with individuals who have been determined as in need of additional support and engagement and will be responsible for conducting outreach, engagement, case management, and ongoing wrap around supportive services. The Navigator I will also map out the most appropriate next steps for the individual who may need assistance in accessing various services to achieve ongoing success. The Navigator I is part of a multi-disciplinary team made up of internal and external stakeholders. The Navigator I will document, and track required patient interactions according to the Arizona Administrative Code (AAC), Arizona Department of Health Services/Department of Behavioral Health Services (ADHS/DBHS) Provider Manual, Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF), Community Bridges Policies and Procedures, and specific for the program.

Skills/Requirements

title: Senior Factories & Installation Engineer - Carcass

description:
We are looking for a Senior Factories & Installation Engineer - Carcass to join our global Manufacturing Process Engineering (MPE) team.

The MPE team is responsible for developing and implementing improvements to manufacturing processes, driving greater efficiency, safety, quality, and global standardization across our facilities in Açu, Brazil, and Kalundborg, Denmark.

The primary focus of this position will be the Carcass manufacturing process, identifying improvement opportunities, developing technical solutions, and implementing initiatives aimed at optimizing manufacturing performance and processes.

The successful candidate will work in a multicultural and collaborative environment, interacting frequently with Engineering, Production, Maintenance, Quality, HSE, Supply Chain, and global suppliers.

  • Develop and implement improvements to processes, machinery, equipment, and production lines related to the Carcass manufacturing process.
  • Analyze manufacturing process performance, identifying bottlenecks, losses, risks, variations, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Lead or participate in the execution of engineering projects, including the installation, assembly, modification, and commissioning of machinery and production lines.
  • Develop concepts, technical specifications, layouts, drawings, technical documentation, and requirements for the acquisition or modification of equipment.
  • Develop mechanical designs using 3D modeling tools.
  • Conduct technical, economic, and operational feasibility studies for new equipment and process improvements.
  • Develop and standardize engineering solutions applicable to the Açu and Kalundborg facilities.
  • Participate in defining global standards for equipment, processes, components, and engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with suppliers on scope definition, technical evaluation of proposals, manufacturing, inspection, installation, and equipment acceptance.
  • Oversee manufacturing, assembly, testing, commissioning, and start-up activities.
  • Develop test plans and acceptance criteria, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), when applicable.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and propose corrective and preventive actions for technical and process-related issues.
  • Support Production and Maintenance teams in troubleshooting mechanical issues and improving equipment reliability.
  • Participate in risk assessments related to machinery, processes, and engineering modifications.
  • Ensure that projects comply with safety, quality, productivity, ergonomics, and sustainability requirements.
  • Prepare technical reports, presentations, project schedules, cost estimates, and project documentation.
  • Monitor performance indicators, costs, schedules, risks, and results for projects under their responsibility.
  • Promote knowledge transfer and the sharing of best practices across facilities.
  • Conduct technical training and support the implementation of new standards and operating procedures.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field.
  • Solid professional experience in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Project Engineering, or related areas.
  • Proven experience in executing industrial projects, including the assembly, installation, modification, or expansion of production lines.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, machine elements, materials, tolerances and fits, structures, power transmission systems, pneumatics, and hydraulics.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, including machining, welding, forming, assembly, surface treatment, and the manufacturing of mechanical components.
  • Experience in the development of industrial machinery, equipment, fixtures, or tooling.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling and technical drawing software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Creo, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
  • Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, diagrams, technical specifications, and equipment documentation.
  • Knowledge of project management, including scope definition, planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and supplier coordination.
  • Experience with structured problem-solving and root cause analysis methodologies, such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa, A3, 8D, or similar approaches.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement and process optimization methodologies.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, data analysis, charts, and the development of performance tracking tools and KPIs.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and Outlook.
  • Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for meetings, presentations, technical documentation, and collaboration with global teams.
  • Availability for domestic and international travel, particularly between the Açu and Kalundborg facilities.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. Your role blends leadership, creativity, and customer engagement—delivering genuine hospitality through personalized consultations, expert product application, and a deep understanding of each customer’s beauty and style preferences.

You’ll inspire teamwork to drive sales and elevate the customer experience by creating meaningful, long-lasting connections. With a strong focus on client development, you will cultivate a loyal customer base through outreach, follow-up, and consistent, personalized service.

In addition to meeting and exceeding sales goals, you’ll analyze business performance, execute vendor events and promotions, and partner with vendors and store leadership to grow the business. You'll also oversee stock presentation, hygiene standards, and team performance to ensure an exceptional and polished brand experience.

How Our Counter Managers Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Counter Manager, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by coaching them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.

  • Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.

  • Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.

  • Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.

  • Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.

  • Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.

  • Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.

  • Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.

  • Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.

  • Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.

  • Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.

  • Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.

  • Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.

  • Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:

1.OT/IT convergence

2.Industrial automation

3.IIoT and Smart Factory platforms

4.Industrial data engineering

5.Industrial IT

6.Platform engineering

7.Systems engineering

  • Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.

  • Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.

  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.

  • Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.

  • Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.

  • Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.

  • Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.

  • Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.

  • Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.

  • Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.

  • Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.

  • Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.

  • Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.

  • Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.

  • Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.

  • Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.

  • Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: MPD Sr. Wellsite Supervisor
description:
The Sr. MPD Wellsite Supervisor or coordinator will work safely with rig contractors and operators’ subsurface disciplines, well systems and regulatory entities to come up with the safest and most efficient plans to apply MPD successfully.   • Perform functional specification designs/calculations for surface MPD equipment and integration with rig equipment (frictional pressure losses on surface lines, equipment and accessories, erosion, rig MGS capabilities, etc)

  • Participate if requested in DWOP meetings.

  • Ability and willingness to learn thru a structured development program which includes internal and external courses, external certifications and practical on the job training (both office and field).

title: Team Manager - Inventory
description:

Our customers, which include some of the most respected brands in the food industry, rely on our expertise and commitment to safety in order to deliver on their commitments.

    Investigate stock discrepancies and out-of-stocks, identify root causes, and report findings with corrective actions.

  • People Leadership
    Lead and develop the Inventory Team, drive safety and KPI performance, and deliver training on systems and processes.

  • Proven experience in operations or inventory management (minimum 3 years)

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop large teams

  • Strong understanding of warehouse and distribution operations

  • Excellent people leadership and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability

  • Relevant logistics or supply chain qualification (preferred)

  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure

What We Offer

At Americold, we recognise that our people are critical to our success. In return for your leadership and expertise, we offer:

  • The opportunity to lead a significant, complex operation within a successful and growing global organisation
  • A value-driven culture centred on safety, integrity, teamwork and giving back to the communities in which we operate
  • A competitive remuneration package, including bonus eligibility
  • A role with genuine autonomy, influence and long-term career development opportunities
  • Access to Fitness Passport, supporting your health and wellbeing
  • Structured internal training and development programs to support your growth as a leader
  • Novated leasing options
  • Paid parental leave, supporting you and your family during life’s important moments

Apply now and help shape the future of temperature-controlled supply chains with Americold.

Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, robotiserte løsninger og automatiserte prosesser. Vi kombinerer industriell automasjon, robotteknologi og softwareutvikling for å løse krevende oppgaver i operasjoner der sikkerhet, tilgjengelighet og presisjon er avgjørende.


Vi søker nå en erfaren robotprogrammerer som vil bidra i utviklingen av neste generasjon kontrollsystemer. Du blir en sentral del av et tverrfaglig miljø og får ansvar for å utvikle, integrere, teste og sette i drift robotløsninger som inngår i komplette maskin- og automasjonssystemer.


Stillingen passer for deg som liker å gå fra problemforståelse og systemdesign til fungerende løsning på virkelig utstyr. Du trives med å feilsøke i komplekse systemer, samarbeide tett med andre fagmiljøer og ta eierskap til leveranser fra idé til idriftsettelse.

Hvorfor NOV?
Hos NOV blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø som utvikler teknologi for krevende operasjoner over hele verden. I Maskin Control arbeider vi tett på både utstyret og kundens behov, og du får påvirke hvordan fremtidens automatiserte bore- og robotsystemer skal bygges.

Du får:
• Spennende og teknisk krevende oppgaver med synlige resultater
• Mulighet til å jobbe med avansert robotikk, autonomi og maskinstyring
• Et kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø med høy grad av samarbeid og faglig sparring
• Mulighet til å påvirke arkitektur, arbeidsmetoder og videre produktutvikling
• Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter
• Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Mangfold og inkludering

Vi ønsker å fremme mangfold og like muligheter. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller livssyn.

Arbeidssted: Kristiansand

Oppstart: etter avtale


Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende. Send oss din søknad dersom du ønsker å være med på å utvikle robuste og intelligente robot- og kontrollsystemer for fremtidens boreutstyr.

Kontakt for teknisk informasjon om stillingen: Ståle Enes +47 90 600 353

Arbeidsoppgaver


• Programmering og konfigurering av industrielle roboter og robotceller
• Utvikling av sekvenser, bevegelseslogikk, baner, griperfunksjoner og sikker oppførsel
• Integrasjon mellom robot, PLS, drivsystemer, sensorer, HMI og øvrige kontrollsystemer
• Design, implementasjon og videreutvikling av kontrollarkitektur for automatiserte maskiner
• Testing og verifisering i simulator, testoppsett og på fysisk utstyr
• FAT, idriftsettelse, feilsøking og teknisk støtte i prosjekt- og leveransefasen
• Bidra til standardisering, gjenbrukbare løsninger og gode utviklingsmetoder
• Utarbeidelse og vedlikehold av teknisk dokumentasjon

Vi ser etter deg som har


• Flere års erfaring med programmering og idriftsettelse av industrielle roboter
• Relevant høyere utdanning innen robotikk, automasjon, kybernetikk, mekatronikk, software eller tilsvarende praktisk erfaring
• God forståelse av robotceller, koordinatsystemer, bevegelsesplanlegging og samspill mellom robot og maskin
• Erfaring med feilsøking i sammensatte kontrollsystemer og evne til å se helheten fra software til mekanikk og elektro
• Evne til å arbeide strukturert og selvstendig, samtidig som du deler kunnskap og samarbeider godt i team
• Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig


Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med

title: Patient Ambassador
description:
Benefits:
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k)

Position Summary
The Patient Ambassador owns the nonclinical patient and caregiver experience throughout their time at bVital. This role provides personalized, white-glove support by welcoming patients, anticipating needs, answering appropriate nonclinical questions, helping patients navigate the clinic, and ensuring they feel informed, supported, and cared for.

About bVital
bVital is a regenerative medicine and brain health clinic in Park City, Utah. We work with patients navigating TBI, Parkinson's, complex chronic illness, and serious neurological conditions. Many of our patients are dealing with challenges that affect their mobility, cognition, and stamina. They are not easy cases and they are not quick visits. They need a clinical environment that takes their full experience seriously, from the moment they walk in to the moment they leave. That is where this role lives.

Patient Welcome & Orientation
• Conduct Brain Camp pre-arrival calls to help patients and caregivers understand what to expect.
• Personally welcome and engage patients, spouses, caregivers, and support persons.
• Orient patients to the clinic and serve as an accessible resource for appropriate nonclinical questions.

Patient & Caregiver Support
• Proactively check in throughout the patient experience and identify questions, concerns, or unmet needs.
• Help patients navigate between appointments and services and support timely transitions.
• Keep patients and caregivers informed about delays, schedule changes, and what comes next.

Communication & Service Recovery
• Coordinate with Front Desk, clinical staff, and other departments when patients need assistance.
• Recognize patient-experience concerns early, assist with appropriate service recovery, and follow up when needed.
• Manage Patient Ambassador-related Zendesk tasks and help ensure patient needs do not fall through the cracks.
• Communicate urgent concerns promptly and follow established emergency procedures.

Patient Experience & Clinic Support
• Help maintain welcoming, organized patient-facing spaces.
• Assist other departments when appropriate and within role scope.
• Provide consistent, personalized, white-glove service throughout the patient and caregiver experience.

Qualifications
• Warm, approachable, and comfortable engaging with patients and caregivers.
• Strong listening and communication skills with high situational awareness.
• Proactive, observant, dependable, and able to follow through.
• Calm and solution-oriented during difficult or unfamiliar situations.
• Patient-facing, hospitality, caregiving, healthcare, or high-touch customer service experience preferred.
• Comfortable being on your feet and moving throughout the clinic.

Core Competencies
Emotional Intelligence | Communication | Relationship Building | Situational Awareness | Service Orientation | Adaptability | Problem Solving | Accountability | Collaboration | Follow-Through

What Success Looks Like
Patients and caregivers feel welcomed, informed, recognized, and supported throughout their experience. Patient needs are noticed proactively, transitions are supported, concerns are followed through, and communication across teams is clear. You are consistently on time, fully present, and ready to support whatever the day requires.

title: Project HART Teen Facilitator
company: Community Action Corporation of South Texas
description:
General Summary

Provides instruction and leadership to youth in local middle schools using The Dibble Institute’s Love Notes 4.2 SRA Abstinence Only (AO) Middle School Adaptation (MSA) curriculum per fidelity standards. Facilitators will use a positive youth-development approach by educating youth on self-regulation, goal setting, healthy relationships, focusing on their future, and the prevention and avoidance of sexual activity and other risky behaviors and help teens to better understand and develop themselves, define their goals, and acquire essential healthy relationship and life skills.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Provide group instruction for teens ages 12-14 using The Dibble Institute’s Love Notes 4.2 AO MSA curriculum to teach teens about the benefits associated with self-regulation, goal setting, healthy decision-making, success sequencing and pathways for poverty prevention, focus on the future, healthy relationships, resisting sexual coercion, dating violence, and other youth risk behaviors, such as underage drinking or illicit drug use.

2. Ensure that implementation of the Love Notes 4.2 AO MSA curriculum meets fidelity standards. Work with the Program Manager or Youth Development Coordinator (YDC) to increase fidelity and follow any provided improvement plans.

3. Follow procedures set forth in the district/school and/or organizations served. Coordinate with school counselors, teachers, and organization staff/volunteers for program planning and/or referrals.

4. Assist in strategic dissemination and communication activities to raise awareness of the program with youth, their families, and key stakeholders.

5. Maintains accurate and timely records such as attendance, demographics, consent forms, surveys, etc. as required by ACF-FYSB and the program and communicates relevant data to the Data Reporting Analyst (DRA) to ensure accuracy of reporting mandated by the federal funding agency.

6. Administer pre and post surveys for each youth participant and follow survey administration protocols.

7. Must meet or exceed program goals and objectives set forth by the federal funding agency in their assigned county(ies).

8. Become a certified facilitator in Love Notes 4.2 AO MSA and attend applicable local, state, and national training.

9. Become/remain certified in First Aid and CPR.

10. Attend scheduled training and independently continue to increase knowledge on relevant topics.

11. Comply with the project’s confidentiality policy.

12. Any other duties as assigned by the Program Director, Program Manager, or Youth Development Coordinator.

Work Experience

Required

● Experience working with youth

Preferred

● Working with youth delivering evidence-based positive youth development programming
● Equivalent work experience in the field of social work, Sociology, Education or Psychology

Education/Certifications/Licensure

Required

● Bachelor's degree in social work and/or Sociology, Education, Psychology, or a related field
● Required plus earn a certification as a Love Notes 4.2 AO Facilitator

Skills

Required

● Must have computer skills
● Must be able to communicate with youth openly without judgment.
● Promote a positive image through manners, dress, attendance, and attitude.
● Ability to facilitate to youth/teens in an engaging manner

Preferred

● Bilingual ability (Spanish/English) is preferred.
● Knowledge of community resources and local agencies.

Physical Requirements

If a preliminary offer of employment is extended, a physical will be required before the offer can be accepted.

Frequent travel within the area. Must be willing to work flexible hours. A valid driver’s license, safe driving record, and acceptance by the Agency’s vehicle insurance carrier are required. Must pass PRS background check. Must pass a pre-employment physical.

Able to perform the following physical requirements of the position with or without reasonable accommodation: critical sensory requirements include general vision; specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Hear or listen in the normal range (corrected) and speak and give directions clearly. Able to walk, sit, stand, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects up to 10 lbs., and occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.

title: Training and Service Quality Lead
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description

Role Overview

As a Training and Service Quality Lead, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the Training and Service Quality function supporting Customer Service operations.

You will build and execute an integrated strategy that improves employee capability, service quality, operational readiness, customer experience, and business performance. You will lead Training and Service Quality Specialists and establish frameworks, standards, governance, and operating rhythms for consistent learning, quality assurance, coaching, and continuous improvement.

The Impact You Will Make

Training & Service Quality Strategy

  • Develop and execute a Training and Service Quality strategy aligned with Customer Service, customer expectations, and business priorities.
  • Establish an integrated model connecting learning, quality assurance, coaching, performance improvement, and continuous improvement.
  • Translate business priorities and operational challenges into clear action plans.
  • Define capability-development priorities based on performance trends, organizational changes, and future needs.
  • Focus resources on areas with the greatest customer, employee, operational, and business impact.
  • Evolve practices as customer expectations, technology, processes, and business needs change.

Training & Capability Leadership

  • Lead new-hire training, onboarding, systems and process training, upskilling, cross-training, refresher training, and ongoing development.
  • Establish learning standards, curricula, competency frameworks, and certification requirements.
  • Ensure training prepares employees to perform independently and consistently.
  • Oversee training needs analysis and ensure interventions address validated knowledge and skill gaps.
  • Apply adult-learning and instructional-design principles.
  • Set standards for training materials, job aids, assessments, simulations, and knowledge resources.
  • Keep learning content current, accurate, standardized, and aligned with approved processes.
  • Use feedback, quality results, operational data, and post-training performance to improve programs.
  • Measure learning effectiveness beyond training completion.

New-Hire Readiness & Speed-to-Proficiency

  • Own the framework supporting new employees from onboarding through operational readiness.
  • Establish competency, assessment, certification, and readiness standards.
  • Partner with Operations to define transition points from training to nesting and live operations.
  • Monitor new-hire performance and trends affecting readiness, quality, and speed-to-proficiency.
  • Ensure remediation and reinforcement are available when needed.
  • Analyze early-tenure performance to improve hiring profiles, onboarding, training, coaching, and support.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, and Operations to connect hiring quality, training outcomes, and early-tenure success.

Service Quality Strategy & Governance

  • Develop, implement, and improve the Service Quality framework for Customer Service operations.
  • Establish quality standards, scorecards, evaluation methods, sampling approaches, critical-error definitions, and governance requirements.
  • Ensure monitoring evaluates customer and business outcomes, not only procedural compliance.
  • Ensure evaluations are consistent, objective, evidence-based, and documented.
  • Lead calibration with Training and Service Quality, Operations, and process owners.
  • Address scoring, interpretation, or calibration gaps.
  • Establish escalation mechanisms for critical quality, customer, compliance, and process risks.
  • Review frameworks regularly to stay aligned with business and customer expectations.

Performance Analytics & Root-Cause Management

  • Establish a data-driven approach to Training and Service Quality decisions.
  • Analyze quality results, operational KPIs, customer feedback, complaints, training outcomes, assessments, and related data.
  • Ensure structured root-cause analysis is completed before recommending interventions.
  • Differentiate issues caused by knowledge, skill, behavior, process, policy, systems, capacity, leadership, or other factors.
  • Prevent unnecessary retraining by addressing the actual cause of performance issues.
  • Identify recurring defects and partner with stakeholders on corrective and preventive actions.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, risk, frequency, severity, and operational significance.
  • Translate data into clear insights and recommendations for leadership.

Coaching & Performance Improvement

  • Establish standards and methods for coaching and performance reinforcement.
  • Ensure Specialists provide consistent, constructive, evidence-based, and actionable coaching.
  • Partner with Operations leaders to strengthen coaching capability and accountability.
  • Establish remediation approaches for recurring capability and quality gaps.
  • Monitor coaching and remediation effectiveness.
  • Escalate systemic issues that cannot be resolved through individual coaching.
  • Promote shared accountability between Training, Service Quality, and Operations.

Training-Service Quality-Operations Feedback Loop

  • Maintain a feedback loop between Training, Service Quality, Operations, Process Owners, and relevant functions.
  • Use quality findings to inform training priorities, coaching, onboarding, and knowledge-management updates.
  • Use training outcomes and competency assessments to inform quality-monitoring priorities.
  • Evaluate whether interventions improve operational and customer outcomes.
  • Convert recurring defects and customer issues into capability or process-improvement initiatives.
  • Incorporate lessons learned into future training and operational practices.

Team Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage a high-performing team of Training and Service Quality Specialists.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, quality standards, and development objectives.
  • Build team capability in facilitation, instructional design, quality evaluation, calibration, coaching, analytics, root-cause analysis, and stakeholder management.
  • Conduct observations and calibration of trainer and quality performance.
  • Allocate resources based on training demand, monitoring needs, business priorities, and risks.
  • Identify future capability needs and support succession and development planning.
  • Foster accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

Analytics and Reporting

  • Define and monitor Training and Service Quality KPIs and success measures.
  • Establish dashboards and reporting for training effectiveness, competency, certification, quality performance, defect trends, coaching impact, and improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor new-hire readiness, speed-to-proficiency, assessment performance, quality trends, recurring defects, calibration consistency, and post-intervention improvement.
  • Connect results to customer experience, service levels, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.
  • Present insights, risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to leadership.
  • Ensure reporting drives decisions and improvement.

Continuous Improvement & Transformation

  • Lead initiatives supporting transformation, system implementations, process changes, product or service changes, and organizational priorities.
  • Assess capability and quality impacts of business changes and establish readiness strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify learning, strengthen quality controls, and improve knowledge management.
  • Champion digital learning, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, and other scalable technologies.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods to recurring issues.
  • Promote proactive identification of capability and quality risks.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary Training and Service Quality partner to Customer Service and Operations leadership.
  • Build partnerships with Supply Chain, business groups, HR, Talent Acquisition, process owners, subject-matter experts, technology teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Influence leaders toward sustainable solutions when issues extend beyond training or individual capability.
  • Represent Training and Service Quality in operational reviews, transformation initiatives, and leadership forums.
  • Communicate risks, quality findings, systemic issues, and recommendations with clarity and credibility.
  • Use evidence to challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
  • Keep priorities aligned with changing business and customer requirements.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure activities comply with company policies, quality standards, regulatory requirements, ethical expectations, and internal controls.
  • Maintain governance over training records, competency assessments, certifications, quality evaluations, and calibration outcomes.
  • Ensure critical quality and compliance risks are identified, documented, escalated, and addressed.

Your Skills and Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited institution.
  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in Training & Development, Learning & Development, Service Quality Assurance, Customer Service Operations, Operational Excellence, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of people leadership experience, preferably leading Training, Service Quality, Learning & Development, or combined teams.
  • Experience managing training/capability development and service quality programs.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design, training-needs analysis, competency assessment, and learning effectiveness.
  • Experience managing quality frameworks, scorecards, calibration processes, and governance.
  • Ability to use operational and quality data to identify trends and drive improvement.
  • Capability in root-cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience leading new-hire training, onboarding, certification, and readiness programs.
  • Strong coaching, people-development, stakeholder-influence, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic operational environment.

Additional Qualifications That Could Help You Succeed

  • Experience leading an integrated Training and Service Quality function in Customer Service, Shared Services, Global Business Services, BPO, Supply Chain Customer Operations, or a multinational organization.
  • Experience establishing Training and Service Quality frameworks or operating models.
  • Experience managing distributed or multi-site teams.
  • Experience supporting transformation, process migration, system implementation, or organizational change.
  • Experience with LMS, digital-learning platforms, content-authoring tools, ERP/CRM systems, and reporting platforms such as Power BI.
  • Experience applying automation, AI, or advanced analytics to learning, quality, or operational performance.
  • Master’s degree or certification in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, Service Quality Management, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or a related discipline is advantageous.

Leadership Profile

  • Strategic Training & Service Quality Leadership: Connects learning and quality priorities to business and customer outcomes.
  • People Leadership: Builds capable, accountable, high-performing teams.
  • Operational Acumen: Understands how training, quality, process, technology, and people affect performance.
  • Service Quality & Customer Mindset: Maintains high standards with customer outcomes central.
  • Analytical Leadership: Converts data into insights, priorities, and action.
  • Root-Cause Orientation: Solves underlying performance problems rather than symptoms.
  • Continuous Improvement: Challenges current practices and drives sustainable improvement.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Builds credibility and influences across functions.
  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through changing processes, technologies, and requirements.
  • Execution & Accountability: Establishes ownership and delivers measurable results.

Measures of Success

  • Improved training effectiveness and employee competency.
  • Improved service quality performance and calibration consistency.
  • Effective closure of capability and performance gaps.
  • Measurable improvement after training and coaching interventions.
  • Stronger operational coaching capability.
  • Improved team effectiveness.
  • Accurate, actionable analytics and reporting.
  • Strong stakeholder confidence.
  • Measurable contribution to customer experience and operational performance

title: Senior Planner Scheduler
description:
About the Role

As a Senior Planner / Scheduler, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining production schedules that align customer demand with manufacturing capacity, material availability and operational priorities. Using Oracle MRP, you'll convert customer orders into executable production plans while ensuring work progresses efficiently through assembly and machining operations.

Why This Role Matters

This role plays a vital part in supporting operational performance and customer satisfaction. By proactively managing production schedules, identifying potential constraints and coordinating across multiple functions, you'll help improve On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) performance, reduce lead times and ensure manufacturing commitments are achieved.

About the Team

You'll join a collaborative Planning team supporting NOV's Wellhead manufacturing operations in Kintore. Working alongside Production, Engineering, Supply Chain and Sales, you'll be part of an experienced and supportive team that values open communication, teamwork and proactive problem-solving. The environment is fast-paced, highly interactive and focused on delivering results for customers.

About NOV

NOV delivers technology-driven equipment, systems and solutions that support energy production and industrial operations worldwide. Within Intervention & Stimulation Equipment (ISE) Operations, our Kintore facility manufactures Wellhead and Pressure Control Equipment, combining engineering expertise with advanced manufacturing capabilities to deliver high-quality products that support customers across the global energy industry.

Why Join NOV

Joining NOV means becoming part of a growing business with strong market demand and a collaborative working culture. You'll benefit from structured onboarding, including a dedicated buddy programme, while developing your expertise in manufacturing planning within a supportive team environment. As your experience grows, you'll have opportunities to broaden your responsibilities, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and explore future career opportunities across the business.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Develop and maintain production schedules based on customer demand, manufacturing capacity and material availability.
  • Convert customer orders into production work orders using Oracle MRP/ERP.
  • Coordinate and monitor the flow of work through assembly and machining operations to ensure production schedules are achieved.
  • Proactively identify and resolve scheduling challenges that could impact manufacturing performance or customer deliveries.
  • Work closely with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain and Sales to align priorities and maintain efficient production flow.
  • Monitor manufacturing capacity and recommend actions to address potential bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Maintain accurate planning data and update production schedules to reflect changing business priorities.
  • Support On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) delivery performance by ensuring production plans remain realistic and achievable.
  • Prepare production reports and communicate schedule status, risks and priorities to key stakeholders.
  • Support new product introductions and planning activities associated with manufacturing readiness.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning efficiency, lead time reduction and operational performance.
  • Ensure planning activities are completed in accordance with company quality, health, safety and operational procedures.

Essential Qualifications

Experience

  • Experience in production planning or scheduling within a manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems used for production planning and scheduling.
  • Experience coordinating production activities across multiple stakeholders and functions.
  • Understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly assembly and machining operations.

Technical Skills

title: Software Engineer - Drilling Fluid (m/f/d)
description:

You will be part of a strong engineering environment, working with drilling-fluid products and the software and automation systems that control this equipment. You will join a close-knit team working together to deliver sophisticated automation solutions for drilling operations.

What We Offer

  • Opportunities to develop expertise in PLC/HMI, software engineering, C++/C#, Qt, process automation, and system architecture.
  • Exposure to both project delivery and software development activities.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with different engineering disciplines and, when required, customers.
  • Increasing technical ownership and project delivery responsibility as your experience develops.
  • A supportive team environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
This role ensures cybersecurity efforts are not only executed effectively, but also measurable, traceable, and defensible. The Cyber Security Analyst will help structure and maintain the processes, data, and documentation required to support security operations, risk and remediation tracking, control validation, and compliance readiness.

The analyst will work across engineering, operations, OT and IT security teams, and regulatory and compliance stakeholders to maintain asset and system visibility, support security reviews and assessments, validate security controls, track vulnerabilities and remediation activities, and ensure documentation and reporting are audit-ready and reliable.

Success in this role will be demonstrated through accurate and accessible asset inventory and system data, consistent and repeatable security processes, effective tracking of risks and vulnerabilities through closure, verified and defensible security controls, and reliable, audit-ready documentation and reporting.

  • Organize and maintain asset and system visibility.

  • Coordinate and support internal audits, external assessments, and third-party security reviews.

  • Support administration of OT security platforms.

  • Validate and test that security controls are implemented and operating as intended.

  • Develop reporting and dashboards to provide insight into risk and compliance posture.

  • Coordinate cybersecurity processes across engineering, operations, and security teams.

  • Participate in risk assessments for new or evolving technologies, systems, and third-party services.

  • Track the progress of security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and configuration and change activities.

  • Ensure defined processes, including risk assessments, approvals, and reviews, are consistently followed.

  • Coordinate security reviews, remediation efforts, and assurance activities.

  • Identify gaps in workflows and contribute to process improvements.

  • Maintain and support accurate inventory of OT and digital assets across environments.

  • Organize system-level information, including ownership, network relationships, and configuration baselines.

  • Support configuration monitoring efforts by identifying and validating changes within control systems.

  • Administer and support OT security platforms used for asset visibility, configuration monitoring, vulnerability management, and threat detection.

  • Assist with tuning and improving platform outputs to reduce noise and improve usability.

  • Monitor and report on ongoing compliance with internal standards and external frameworks.

  • Identify, assess, and track vulnerabilities through remediation.

  • Support incident response activities by organizing information, tracking actions, and assisting coordination.

  • Validate that remediation actions are completed and effective.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports related to asset visibility, vulnerability status, configuration changes, control effectiveness, and compliance posture.

  • Track and report control gaps, deficiencies, and remediation status to support assurance and audit readiness.

  • Support audit, compliance, and assurance activities by maintaining documentation, organizing and maintaining evidence, supporting control walkthroughs and documentation, and tracking requirements aligned with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, NERC CIP, or similar.

  • Provide clear, structured reporting to stakeholders and leadership.

  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, security guidelines, and internal standards.

  • Ensure documentation is consistent, current, and aligned across teams.

  • Support enforcement and adoption of security policies and standards across teams.

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams, operations and field personnel, OT and IT security teams, and regulatory and compliance stakeholders.

  • Facilitate communication and ensure alignment between technical teams and security processes.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Security, or another Information Technology-related field.

  • 3–7 years of experience in OT cybersecurity, IT security, GRC, or operational environments.

  • Experience in industrial, energy, or regulated environments preferred.

  • Experience supporting OT security programs in regulated environments is preferred.

  • Exposure to audit processes and compliance reporting is preferred.

  • Familiarity with additional OT monitoring or detection tools is preferred.

  • Experience in energy, utilities, or oil & gas sectors is preferred.

title: Elektriker lærling (m/f/d)

  • Forebyggende vedligeholdelse og eftersyn

Du har afsluttet grundforløbet på elektrikeruddannelsen og er klar til at begynde din læreplads. Om du følger EUD eller EUX, er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig.

  • Kan lide at løse praktiske udfordringer

  • Er ansvarlig og mødestabil

Hos NOV bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor læring, samarbejde og sikkerhed er i fokus. Vi investerer i vores lærlinge og sørger for, at du får de bedste rammer for at udvikle dig – både fagligt og personligt.

Must-Have

  • Relevant engineering background, particularly in mechanical engineering, materials or a comparable technical discipline.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent level of capability gained through relevant experience.
  • Practical understanding of materials, welding and structural/fabrication principles.

  • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with suppliers and internal technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to produce clear technical and inspection reports.
  • Proactive and independent approach to identifying and resolving quality issues within established processes.
  • Willingness and ability to undertake international business travel, primarily within Europe.
  • Driving licence.

Preferred

  • Experience within offshore, marine or another relevant engineered-equipment/fabrication environment.

  • Experience with fabrication workflows, inspection planning and/or document-control systems.

  • International supplier and inspection exposure, primarily across Europe.
