title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the next generation of Max Platform experiences. This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX, UI, and interaction design craft with a practical understanding of how design improves product adoption, customer workflows, and business outcomes.

You will design for a complex industrial software platform used across customer-facing applications, administrative workflows, data-rich interfaces, and operational tools. The work requires the ability to move from ambiguous product needs and technical constraints into clear workflows, intuitive interfaces, prototypes, and production-ready design specifications.
You will work closely with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and customer-facing teams to create high-quality platform experiences, refine designs based on user and business feedback, and help establish reusable patterns that make Max Platform easier to use, scale, and extend.

Responsibilities

  • Own UX, UI, and interaction design for key Max Platform experiences.
  • Design customer-facing workflows across platform navigation, administration, analytics, product discovery, and cross-application workflows.
  • Translate product requirements, customer problems, and technical platform capabilities into clear flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready design specifications.
  • Create interaction patterns for complex workflows such as onboarding, account setup, user and permission management, application switching, data configuration, product discovery, notifications, and workflow handoffs between applications.
  • Design AI-assisted product experiences that help users complete tasks, analyze data, understand system behavior, and make better operational decisions.
  • Partner with product managers and stakeholders to make platform capabilities easier to discover, adopt, and use.
  • Partner with engineering to ensure designs are technically feasible, consistent with platform architecture, and specific enough to reduce implementation ambiguity.
  • Define reusable platform design patterns for navigation, administration, configuration, data views, dashboard workflows, application templates, and cross-product experiences.
  • Maintain design quality across the platform while supporting fast execution by distributed engineering teams.
  • Use customer feedback, product analytics, support signals, and internal stakeholder input to improve platform workflows over time.
  • Use AI-enabled design, research, and prototyping tools to accelerate exploration, improve design quality, and reduce time from concept to validated direction.
  • Help establish a practical design system and component usage model that supports consistency without slowing product delivery.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, Computer Science, or related field.
  • The ideal candidate should have 5–10 years of design experience.
  • Senior product design experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, industrial software, platform products, data products, or complex workflow applications.
  • Strong UX, UI, and interaction design skills, with a portfolio showing end-to-end product work from problem framing through shipped designs.
  • Experience designing complex workflows, administration experiences, configuration tools, dashboards, data-heavy interfaces, or multi-application product experiences.
  • Experience designing integrated AI experiences that support task completion, data analysis, decision-making, recommendations, or guided workflows.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into structured flows, prototypes, interaction models, and production-ready design details.
  • Strong Figma capability, including component usage, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff.
  • Competency with AI toolkits and the ability to integrate them effectively into the design process to expedite delivery and improve the quality of the user experience.
  • Ability to work closely with product managers, engineers, domain experts, customer-facing teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Practical understanding of accessibility, responsive design, state handling, error handling, permissions, and usability for operational users.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design tradeoffs without hiding behind design jargon.
  • Experience with industrial technology, IIoT, energy, drilling, production, connected equipment, or operational data workflows.
  • Experience designing platform experiences used by multiple applications or internal/external teams.
  • Experience with embedded analytics, dashboard builders, application development environments, or configurable workflow tools.
  • Experience working in environments where UX must connect product strategy, technical constraints, field workflows, and business outcomes.

title: Software Developer/Engineer - Digital Completion Solutions
description:
NOV’s Cranesmart and Rigsmart businesses develop wireless safety, monitoring, and data-acquisition solutions for cranes, drilling, workover, and snubbing operations. Our products help protect personnel and equipment, reduce non-productive time, and improve operational visibility in demanding environments.

We are seeking an intermediate-to-senior Embedded Software Developer or Engineer to support the continued development and modernization of the LMI5 platform serving both Cranesmart and Rigsmart products. The LMI5 is a touchscreen display, wireless receiver, and control module that presents critical operating information, warnings, and safety-related functions to crane operators.

This is a hands-on role focused primarily on leading development of embedded software and firmware. The successful candidate will contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from requirements and implementation through testing, release, troubleshooting, and field deployment. The position level will be based on the candidate’s experience and demonstrated technical leadership.

Why join us?

You will help develop and modernize field-proven technology that directly supports crane and rig safety. This role offers meaningful technical ownership, exposure to the complete software lifecycle, and the opportunity to see your work operate in real-world industrial applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware for the LMI5 and related Cranesmart and Rigsmart products.
  • Develop application logic, communication interfaces, diagnostics, touchscreen functionality, and integration with wireless and wired sensors.
  • Maintain and modernize existing software while improving performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and fault handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex software, timing, sensor-data, wireless, networking, and communication issues.
  • Develop and support device configuration, logging, diagnostics, provisioning, and over-the-air or offline software updates.
  • Create technical documentation and automated or manual tests, and participate in code reviews, root-cause investigations, and product releases.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, manufacturing, service, and customer-facing teams; mentor less-experienced developers as appropriate.
  • Occasionally travel to customer locations for field testing, troubleshooting, and first-article installations.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in computer engineering, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline—or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of embedded software or firmware development experience.
  • Strong C and C++ skills on microcontroller or resource-constrained platforms.
  • Experience with embedded communications such as CAN bus, Modbus, TCP/IP, serial, MQTT, OPC UA, or TLS.
  • Experience with real-time systems, device drivers, sensor integration, touchscreen interfaces, industrial controls, or safety-related applications.
  • Familiarity with embedded interfaces such as GPIO, UART, I²C, SPI, and PWM.
  • Experience with debugging, logging, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and maintaining legacy embedded applications.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work safely in industrial environments and travel when required.
  • For candidates hired under an Engineer classification, eligibility for registration with APEGA is required. A P.Eng. designation is an asset but is not mandatory.

title: Peachtree Ranch Foreman
description:
Peachtree Ranch Foreman
Position Title: Peachtree Ranch Foreman
Location: King City, Peachtree Ranch, CA
FLSA Status: Full-time, Non-Exempt
Reports to: Ranch Manager
Pay Scale: $26.00-$29.75


Overview

The Ranch Foreman is responsible for the daily supervision and coordination of ranch operations at Peachtree Ranch. This position provides leadership to ranch hands and day workers while ensuring the safe, efficient, and productive management of livestock, equipment, facilities, roads, water systems, and grazing lands. The Ranch Foreman leads by example and actively participates in all ranch activities, including cattle operations, fencing, maintenance, and land stewardship. This position will be on stocker ranches of 40,000+ acres where we have run a combined total of 7,500-11,000 head of stockers the past two growing seasons.


Responsibilities

Livestock Management

  • Oversee daily cattle operations, including gathering, sorting, branding, vaccinating, shipping, and receiving livestock.
  • Monitor herd health and report illnesses, injuries, or unusual conditions.
  • Coordinate with veterinarians and livestock professionals as needed.
  • Ensure proper handling of livestock following animal welfare standards.
Employee Supervision

  • Supervise ranch hands and day workers.
  • Assign daily work schedules and priorities.
  • Train employees on equipment operation, livestock handling, and safety procedures.
  • Promote a positive and productive team environment.
Ranch Maintenance

  • Maintain fences, corrals, gates, roads, water systems, and ranch buildings.
  • Inspect ranch infrastructure and schedule repairs.
  • Operate and maintain tractors, skid steers, UTVs, trucks, trailers, and other ranch equipment.
Land and Resource Management

  • Monitor grazing conditions and pasture utilization.
  • Assist with water management and conservation practices.
  • Conduct routine inspections of stock tanks, pipelines, wells, and ponds.
  • Support ranch improvement projects and habitat management initiatives.
Safety and Compliance

  • Enforce ranch safety standards and policies.
  • Assist in maintaining required records related to livestock, equipment, maintenance, and employee activities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Respond to emergencies involving livestock, equipment, weather, or property.


Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 5 years of ranching experience, preferably in cattle operations.
  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of livestock handling and range management.
  • Experience operating agricultural and ranch equipment.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding outdoor work in varying weather conditions.
  • Valid California driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Preferred

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).
  • Experience with large-scale cattle ranch operations.
  • Welding, mechanical, or heavy equipment maintenance experience.
  • CPR/First Aid certification.


Skills

  • Physical stamina and endurance for outdoor work.
  • Basic mechanical skills for equipment maintenance.
  • Problem-solving and adaptability to changing conditions.
  • Commitment to environmental stewardship and conservation principles.
  • Basic welding skills
  • Familiarity with plumbing and water systems
Working Conditions

  • Full-time position with variable hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends.
  • Work performed outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Physical demands include lifting, standing, and walking on uneven terrain.




Compensation & Benefits

Non-Exempt position. Hourly Pay Range $26.00-$29.75

You will use engineering drawings, schematics, technical descriptions, and project requirements to develop and program equipment into fully functioning automated process systems. Your responsibilities will span engineering, programming, testing, documentation, and project delivery, giving you exposure to the complete lifecycle of an industrial automation solution.

The role offers an opportunity to develop practical expertise across PLC and HMI/SCADA systems while gaining exposure to broader software technologies and engineering tools. As your knowledge develops, you will have the opportunity to work more independently and take greater responsibility for technical and project deliveries.

About NOV

NOV is a global provider of technology, equipment, and services supporting drilling, energy, marine, and industrial operations. We combine engineering expertise with technology and software to help our customers improve the safety, efficiency, reliability, and performance of their operations.

You will be part of a strong engineering environment, working with drilling-fluid products and the software and automation systems that control this equipment. You will join a close-knit team working together to deliver sophisticated automation solutions for drilling operations.

Why Join Us

  • Work with automation technology used in some of the world’s most advanced drilling rigs.
  • Join a collaborative engineering team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are central to successful delivery.
  • Gain hands-on experience with real industrial automation projects and complex process systems.
  • Work across different engineering technologies rather than being limited to a single technical area.
  • Build experience in an international technology company while contributing to real customer projects.

What We Offer

  • Structured onboarding covering NOV products, engineering tools, Quality Assurance (QA), and Health, Safety and Environment (HSE).
  • Opportunities to develop expertise in PLC/HMI, software engineering, C++/C#, Qt, process automation, and system architecture.
  • Exposure to both project delivery and software development activities.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with different engineering disciplines and, when required, customers.
  • Increasing technical ownership and project delivery responsibility as your experience develops.
  • A supportive team environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

#LI-ZS1

  • Develop and program automation solutions for project deliveries.
  • Program and support PLC and HMI/SCADA systems.
  • Translate drawings, schematics, and technical requirements into functioning automation solutions.
  • Test and verify systems to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Prepare engineering and project documentation.
  • Contribute to software development and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet project requirements and delivery schedules.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with process automation, including PLC and/or HMI systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices, including design patterns and coding standards.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
  • Collaborative and open-minded approach, with a willingness to learn and contribute to the team.
  • Passion for technology and an interest in keeping up to date with developments in software and automation.

description:
NOV is actively recruiting ambitious college/university graduates for a Software Engineering Intern role in the summer of 2027 within the Rig Technologies business unit located in Houston, Texas.⁠ The start date for this program is June 2027.

Following the software engineering career track, the primary responsibilities are as follows:

  • Design and write software for drilling equipment and/or applications
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of software documentation including updates after release
  • Provide support for the implementation, training and troubleshooting of software products
  • Develop and de-bug software products prior to release
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot associated hardware as required
  • Work with customers (internal/external) and review project defining documents to understand project requirements
  • Participate in design reviews

We invite you to apply if you have the following qualifications and skills:

  • Required—graduating December 2027 or May 2028 from one of the following programs or equivalent:
    • Computer Engineering
    • Computer Science
    • Electrical Engineering
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Mechatronics Engineering
  • Experience and proficiency in one or more software languages such as C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, PHP, and Python; and/or PLC software such as STEP 7/TIA Portal and RSLogix
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate ideas and thoughts clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and versatile with a desire for continuous learning
  • Comfortable working in a large team environment

About NOV: NOV delivers technology-driven solutions that are critical to the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the global energy industry. For more than 160 years, NOV has pioneered innovations that have made the industry safer, more efficient, and more resilient.

Throughout every region in the world, NOV provides the technology and equipment that support energy production across oil and gas, renewables, and emerging markets. Our focus is clear: Improve performance, reduce operational intensity, and deliver long-term value through disciplined execution.

We are thousands of individuals working as one team to create a lasting impact for our customers, ourselves, and the communities where we live and work. We take responsibility for each other and our company’s future, knowing that personal ownership leads to broader success.

We see where our customers’ needs are not being met, and we act. Through business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to better power the industry that powers the world.

We have been the backbone of the oil and gas industry and are leveraging our engineering and manufacturing experience to support additional industries. Our focus is to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget to push our customers’ business forward.

About Rig Equipment: Our Rig Equipment team designs, manufactures, and sells land rigs and drilling rig equipment and components designed to mechanize and automate complex drilling rig processes. Our prolific portfolio includes several industry-first equipment innovations including the 20K BOP and the fully-automated robotics system, the ATOM RTX.

Additional innovations for safer handling and control, NOVOS™ reflexive automated drilling system, a process automation platform, which offers fleet-wide drilling process automation to enable dramatic improvements in drilling efficiency, reliability, and performance.

NOV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination or Harassment of Any Kind: NOV is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for everyone and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. NOV values inclusion and diversity; we encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

NOV is committed to providing employees and their families with valuable benefits and wellness opportunities.

title: OT Systems Administrator
location: Sao Joao da Barra, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS) in Brazil is seeking an OT Systems Administrator who will take ownership of production-critical Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure, supporting our Smart Factory transformation journey. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that OT systems remain stable, reliable, secure, and fit for purpose in dedicated hardware. You must own the lifecycle of assigned systems, including their maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.

As an OT Systems Admin you will:

  • Manage the complete lifecycle of production-critical systems, including maintenance, upgrades, documentation, and continuous improvement
  • Take ownership of assigned OT systems and ensure their availability, stability, security, and performance
  • Act as the primary point of contact for OT system-related topics across manufacturing operations
  • Support incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem resolution
  • Maintain system documentation, governance processes, configuration control, and change management practices
  • Coordinate with Corporate IT on infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, Active Directory, virtualization, and networking topics
  • Manage vendor relationships, support agreements, and escalation paths for assigned systems
  • Ensure reliable integration between production systems, machines, PLCs, databases, and business applications
  • Support operational technology infrastructure including servers, virtualization environments, and production-critical platforms

  • Drive improvements that enhance system reliability, data availability, maintainability, and user experience

    Smart Factory & Digitalization Responsibilities

  • Support implementation of MES, Smart Factory, industrial data integration, and manufacturing digitalization initiatives
  • Participate in OT infrastructure modernization initiatives
  • Help establish scalable and sustainable digital manufacturing capabilities across SPS sites

Essential Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience with OT or IT infrastructure supporting critical operation.
  • Knowledge with industrial networking concepts and infrastructure architecture.
  • Knowledge of virtualization environments and server infrastructure.
  • Experience with Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Dockers and OpenShift.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical issues. Initiative, creativity, and a proactive mindset.
  • Experience with Windows Server, virtualization platforms (such as Hyper-V, VMware, Nutanix, or similar), and Active Directory.
  • English Fluency is a must,

Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledge of industrial automation and system integration is a plus.
  • Experience within industrial production environments.
  • Experience with MES, SCADA, Historian, or other industrial data systems.
  • Understanding of OT cybersecurity principles and IT/OT segregation.

  • Experience with documentation, governance, and system ownership practices.

Soft Skills

To succeed in this role, you must be:

  • A proactive and structured problem solver.
  • Comfortable taking ownership and accountability for critical systems.
  • Hands-on, pragmatic, and solution-oriented.
  • Able to balance technical depth with operational awareness.
  • Effective at communicating across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adaptable and open to change in a rapidly evolving digital manufacturing environment

title: Senior Instrumentation & Controls Eng
description:
Job Overview:

McDermott is seeking an experienced Senior Instrumentation and Controls Engineer to join our Houston office and support the engineering and delivery of field instrumentation and mechanical package scopes for oil and gas, petrochemical, and power generation projects. This role will develop and oversee key instrumentation deliverables, provide technical support for equipment requisitions and supplier coordination, and may lead defined scopes of work as an Instrument Requisition Engineer or Mechanical Package Support Engineer. The successful candidate will also provide limited support for automation deliverables, collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams, clients, suppliers, and remote engineering offices, and apply their technical expertise to guide and mentor less-experienced engineers.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for managing the development of Instrument Index and Instrument Datasheets. For small projects, may be required to develop these documents. For large projects, will direct a team of support office engineers in developing the documents and will review the completed deliverables

  • Assist the Process discipline with the development of P&IDs by providing instrument tag assignments, reviewing instrument symbology, attending internal and client P&ID review meetings, and redlining instrument content to reflect scope changes

  • As a Requisition Engineer (RE) for instrument packages (e.g., valves, gauges, transmitters, flow meters), will be responsible for working with Supply Chain for the development of request-for-quote packages, technical bid evaluations, requisition for purchase packages, and reviewing supplier data. For large projects, will coordinate these efforts with support office engineers who are doing most of the work. For very small projects, will independently complete much of the work

  • As a Mechanical Package Support Engineer, will support the Mechanical discipline in developing requisition packages by providing I&C requirements for inclusion in the requisition, participating in technical bid evaluations, reviewing supplier data, and attending factory testing. For large projects, will coordinate these efforts with support office engineers who are doing most of the work

  • May be required to support the automation scope on a project, such as developing cause & effect diagrams, motor control schematics, or complex loop descriptions

  • May be required to travel to project sites for inspections or testing and to supplier facilities for factory acceptance testing of mechanical and automation packages

  • May be required to mentor early-career engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • 8-12 years of experience in the oil and gas industry working as an I&C engineer

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline

  • Detailed knowledge of current instrument technologies

  • Familiar with industry codes and standards

  • Experience working with clients and suppliers to resolve technical issues

  • Able to work in team environment with company, suppliers, and clients, including remote teams in other countries

  • Experience using MS Office Suite (MS Word, MS Excel)

  • Eligible to work in the United States (US Citizen or Green Card holder)

  • Preferred experience using SmartPlant Instrumentation or Aveva

  • Preferred experience at a project site supporting construction or commissioning activities

title: Drilling Solutions Engineer - Diamond Program
description:
NOV is actively recruiting ambitious college/university graduates for an Application Engineering role that will be part of our ReedHycalog Diamond Rotational Program.


The ReedHycalog Diamond Rotational Program offers recent college engineering graduates the opportunity to obtain meaningful work experiences through a structured 16-month rotational program. The program consists of four 4-month rotations in different geographically locations. The program is designed to help participants develop strong functional/technical expertise and business knowledge through challenging, hands-on assignments and exposure to various engineering groups across ReedHycalog. Towards the end of the program, participants will work with their management support team to identify full-time positions that best suit individual skill sets as well as company needs.

Participants will spend the 1st rotation in Fundamental Drill Bit Engineering training. The 2nd Rotation is with the Drill Bit Application Engineering team. The 3rd Rotation is with the Product Center Engineering Team. The 4th rotation is with the Borehole Enlargement Engineering Team. All 4 rotations will require travel and will be in geographically different locations. For the 2nd through 4th rotations, the participant will be working on engineering projects, learning new skills, and be participants in highly motivated and successful teams.

The start date for this program will be December 2026

Customer Service:

  • Focus regular actions and take initiatives to improve and sustain customer relationships

  • Focus regular actions on special relationship initiatives that will take the relationship to the next level
  • Pursue/Seek/Gain leads on new operators to gain “ground floor” advantage
  • Maintain strict confidentiality according to internal policy for area customers

Operations:

  • Monitor tool performance and report trends to your team through regular reporting
  • Coordinate the gathering of competitor's performance data (bit records, run reports, downhole tools, etc.)
  • Prepare and provide technical application support to sales team through customer visits and presentations in the assigned area
  • Support with the local team with the bit repair process
  • Provide onsite support for bit runs as needed
  • Provide the drill bit dull grading and evaluation and trends

Sales Support:

  • Assist the sales force with detailed performance studies for optimization of drilling performance for critical or strategic applications
  • Provide direct support for the development and implementation of customer strategy
  • Maintain consistent communication with the Engineering Support team and assigned account manager concerning issue resolutions and current status of opportunities
  • Be prepared to provide technical applications support to sales account manager through customer visits and presentations at field site
  • Assisting for achieving sales metrics and KPI’s for assigned rig count
  • Identify new business opportunities, qualifying needs and pursue key decision-makers, buyers on site
  • Share “best practice” methods, processes, and ideas across the business’ countries/areas/regions

Reporting:

  • Create Application Maps / Study for the applications in your area
  • Capture tool performance data from ongoing jobs for data base entry and prepare to present customer run reports and run performance summaries.
  • Develop outstanding run reports for internal and external use
  • Create dull conditions reports for all required run in the area
  • Create incident reports analysis according to the QMS system

Product Development Process:

  • Lead the process of gathering ReedHycalog product information on the assigned area
  • Lead the process of gathering competitor intelligence information from customer applications.

Complete all assigned online training promptly

title: Refrigeration Technician II
description:
What You'll Do

You will perform routine maintenance, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration systems throughout the warehouse, ensuring equipment operates correctly and safely. Responsibilities include monitoring system performance, replacing components, conducting tests and calibrations, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining accurate preventive maintenance records. Flexible shifts and on-call work may be required.

Essential Functions

  • Perform operation, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration systems throughout the warehouse.
  • Monitor system performance and determine when systems are not operating correctly.
  • Replace refrigeration system components following safe lockout/tagout procedures and program standards.
  • Conduct basic pump out and evacuate refrigerant as necessary for valve replacement or repair.
  • Perform routine maintenance on warehouse equipment in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Test, calibrate, and evaluate equipment performance and inspect completed work for compliance with specifications and safety standards.
  • Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records and ensure work areas are clean and organized.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
  • Minimum 2 years of industrial refrigeration maintenance experience or minimum 3 years industrial maintenance experience plus relevant industry certification such as RETA, Garden City, or EPA Universal.
  • Successful completion of assigned industrial refrigeration and maintenance courses required.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and repair differing control systems including ALTA and Allen Bradley.
  • Required HAZMAT training and certification and experience using Oracle Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

What Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working in a cold storage environment.
  • Ammonia refrigeration maintenance experience.
  • CARO and CIRO certification.
  • Ability to share knowledge and train less experienced technicians.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures of minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius) and outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold, and precipitation).
  • Able to work at heights in excess of 30 ft. (9 meters) and access elevated platforms, catwalks, and roofs.
  • Able to work in confined areas.
  • Able to climb ladders and stairs.
  • Able frequently to stand, walk, push, pull, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, and/or crouch.
  • Able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds (23 kg) frequently.
  • Able to operate hand and power tools safely.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job including close vision, distance vision, color vision, and depth perception. (Use of contacts are prohibited when working with ammonia.)
  • Depending on specific role, able to pass a physical and respiratory/respirator fit exam.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for any/all tasks.

The Company’s good-faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting for this position is $23.25 to $35.00 hourly.

description:

Job Title:
Bilingual Field Instructor

Cal-Wood Mission & Philosophy

Cal-Wood Education Center is on a mission to facilitate positive nature experiences for all—especially those who haven't yet spent time in the mountains. Since 1982, Cal-Wood has provided residential environmental and outdoor education programs to hundreds of thousands of Coloradans at our 1,200-acre outdoor classroom located west of Boulder, Colorado. Through school programs, summer camps, and family camps, we provide access for kids and adults from underrepresented communities to have life-changing experiences outdoors.

We believe that no matter where you live or what language you speak, you deserve to feel safe and welcome outside. We strive to grow our programs so that more people from all walks of life can find a meaningful connection with nature.

Cal-Wood has received several national and local awards for our high-quality programs and service to linguistically diverse audiences. Our field instructors receive training in sheltered instruction and inclusive teaching practices to help them effectively engage all students—from Commerce City to Aurora to Boulder and beyond. Instructors provide dynamic, hands-on science education in the field so that all students can explore, learn, and see themselves as scientists.

Position Overview

Cal-Wood seeks a Bilingual Field Instructor whose primary duty is teaching environmental science curriculum to K–12 students in an outdoor setting. Field Instructors work in our beautiful 1,200-acre outdoor classroom alongside a motivated team passionate about natural science, education, and conservation.

Instructors are responsible for providing educational experiences for learning groups of 10–15 students by leading outdoor learning activities and teaching environmental science lessons. Programs range from one-day visits to three-day overnight trips for local students of all ages. Instructors are charged with teaching instructional modules in outdoor skills and environmental science, including applied lessons in ecology, wildlife biology, and outdoor field studies. Utilizing Cal-Wood's curriculum and materials, Instructors independently develop lesson plans, select instructional methods, adapt curriculum to meet student needs, and evaluate student performance. Bilingual Field Instructors often work directly with students (and adult chaperones) who speak Spanish as their first language, so that Instructors can support participants in their communication and learning while at Cal-Wood.

This position begins January 11, 2027 and runs through December 17, 2027, with the possibility of extending employment for additional seasons.

This position is a seasonal, full-time role.
Salary, Exempt.

Schedule

  • Monday through Friday, with some evening and weekend shifts as needed
  • Average 40-hour work week
  • Programs may require early mornings, evenings, and overnight presence for facilitation (note: Instructors do not sleep in cabins with students)

Responsibilities

75% Teaching:

  • Lead a learning group of 10–15 students during each school’s visit; typical programs run 2–3 days
  • Spend 4–8 hours per day, 3–5 days per week, leading programs outdoors in all seasons in the mountains of Colorado
  • Develop, teach, and evaluate environmental education programs aligned with local curriculum standards
  • Incorporate science, math, history, creative writing, art, and team-building into programs as requested by schools
  • Teach English, Spanish, and multilingual groups with sheltered teaching methods.
25% Support

  • Lead large-group games, songs, skits, storytelling, and campfires to foster a fun, inclusive environment
  • Facilitate 1–2 meals (breakfasts and/or dinners) and 1–2 evening programs (typically a night hike or campfire) each week
  • Assist with translating curriculum materials into Spanish
  • Assist with maintenance of program staff commons areas, organize educational materials, gear room, and staff office

Qualities & Qualifications

  • Bilingual (Spanish–English)
  • Individuals from underrepresented groups are encouraged to apply
  • High level of personal motivation, flexibility, and responsibility, with a positive attitude
  • Bachelor’s degree in science, natural resources management, education, environmental education, or a related field
  • One or more years of teaching experience, particularly with kids and Spanish-speaking populations.
  • Ability to work and live closely with a small, passionate instructional team (approximately 10–15 staff members)
  • Comfortable living in a remote mountain town approximately 35 minutes from Boulder, CO (optional housing available)
  • Ability to pass background checks and motor vehicle report
  • Ability to hike 3–6 miles daily, lift up to 50 lbs for short periods (sometimes multiple times per day), and work outdoors in all weather conditions
  • Ability to learn and implement sheltered teaching methods through on-the-job training.
  • Current First Aid/CPR certification or willingness to obtain certification required; Wilderness First Aid (WFA) or Wilderness First Responder (WFR) certification is a plus
Benefits
  • Health
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • Life AD&D
  • Simple IRA with 3% employer match
  • Optional employee housing (free rent and utilities)

title: Sales Engineer - Mixing
description:
The Sales Engineer – Mixing is responsible for driving profitable and sustainable growth of the Mixing Solutions business by combining strong technical expertise with commercial and customer-focused capabilities.

The role will focus on developing new business opportunities, strengthening relationships with existing and prospective customers, and positioning NOV’s mixing solutions to address customer applications and operational requirements.

The successful candidate will collaborate with customers, sales teams, engineering, operations, and other internal stakeholders to develop technically appropriate and commercially competitive solutions while supporting the achievement of business growth and sales objectives.

  • Develop and execute sales and business development strategies to drive profitable and sustainable growth of the Mixing Solutions business.
  • Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities with existing and prospective customers while building strong, long-term customer relationships.
  • Understand customer applications, technical requirements, and operational challenges to recommend appropriate mixing solutions.
  • Provide technical and commercial support throughout the sales cycle, including customer enquiries, solution development, proposals, presentations, and technical discussions.
  • Serve as a product and application resource for mixing technologies, providing technical guidance to customers and supporting internal and external sales teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and other internal functions to develop solutions that meet customer specifications, performance requirements, schedules, and commercial objectives.
  • Prepare and support technical and commercial proposals, including scope definition, costing, pricing, delivery requirements, and pre-contract negotiations.
  • Monitor market requirements, customer needs, competitor activities, and industry trends to identify growth opportunities and support product positioning and market penetration.
  • Contribute to sales forecasting, business planning, pricing strategies, financial objectives, and periodic commercial reviews for the Mixing Solutions portfolio.
  • Coordinate effectively across sales, engineering, operations, marketing, and other functions to ensure successful execution of customer requirements and achievement of business objectives.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in any technical domain.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in technical sales, applications engineering, business development, product management, or a related customer-facing technical role.
  • Mixing Solutions Experience: Demonstrated experience with mixing solutions, mixing equipment, or related industrial mixing applications.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand customer applications and translate technical requirements into practical and commercially viable solutions.
  • Commercial awareness with experience in customer relationship development, business opportunity identification, pricing, proposals, and negotiations.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive, analytical, customer-focused, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and effectively within a multinational and matrixed organization.

title: Refrigeration Technician II
description:
What You'll Do

Under general supervision, you will work independently to perform routine maintenance, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration systems throughout the warehouse, ensuring equipment operates correctly and safely. Responsibilities include monitoring system performance, replacing components, conducting tests and calibrations, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining accurate preventive maintenance records.

Essential Functions

  • Perform operation, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration systems throughout the warehouse.
  • Monitor system performance and determine when systems are not operating correctly.
  • Replace refrigeration system components following safe lockout/tagout procedures and program standards.
  • Conduct basic pump out and evacuate refrigerant as necessary for valve replacement or repair.
  • Perform routine maintenance on warehouse equipment in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Test, calibrate, and evaluate equipment performance and inspect completed work for compliance with specifications and safety standards.
  • Inspect completed work for compliance to blueprints, specifications, and safety standards.
  • Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records and ensure work areas are clean and organized.
  • Work flexible shifts, if required, including on call.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
  • Minimum 2 years of industrial refrigeration maintenance experience OR minimum 3 years industrial maintenance experience plus relevant industry certification such as RETA, Garden City, or EPA Universal.
  • Successful completion of assigned industrial refrigeration and maintenance courses required.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and repair differing control systems including ALTA and Allen Bradley.
  • Required to complete HAZMAT training and maintain certification.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working in a cold storage environment.
  • Ammonia refrigeration maintenance experience.
  • CARO and CIRO certification.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose down to the component level on all refrigeration equipment.
  • Ability to share knowledge and train less experienced technicians.
  • Experience using Oracle Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

Physical Requirements

  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures of minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius) and outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold and precipitation).
  • Able to work at heights in excess of 30 ft. (9 meters) and access elevated platforms, catwalks, and roofs.
  • Able to work in confined areas.
  • Able to climb ladders and stairs.
  • Able frequently to stand, walk, push, pull, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, and/or crouch.
  • Able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds (23 kg) frequently.
  • Able to operate hand and power tools safely.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job, including close vision, distance vision, color vision and depth perception. (Use of contacts are prohibited when working with ammonia.)
  • Depending on specific role, able to pass a physical and respiratory/respirator fit exam.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for any/all tasks.

title: Cybersecurity IAM Engineer
description:
Location: Av. Hidalgo #2404, Colonia Obispado (Torre TOP), Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days onsite / 2 days remote).

We are seeking a Cybersecurity IAM Engineer to design, implement, and optimize identity and access solutions across our global infrastructure. This role plays a key part in securing user and system identities across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM, enabling secure digital operations while enforcing Zero Trust and least privilege at scale.
As an IAM Engineer, you'll go beyond processing tickets—you'll build automations, optimize SSO and federation integrations, enforce policy controls through scripting, and work with cross-functional teams to secure identity lifecycles across IT and OT environments. Come and join a great team who are driving tomorrow’s cybersecurity.


  • Design, implement, and maintain IAM solutions across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM
  • Integrate and manage SSO and MFA for cloud and on-prem applications using SAML, OAuth, WS-Federation, and SCIM
  • Automate identity workflows, group assignments, access revocations, and certification campaigns using tools like PowerShell, Python, or Okta Workflows
  • Enforce access controls aligned to Zero Trust, RBAC, and JML (Joiner-Mover-Leaver) lifecycle policies
  • Harden IAM configurations in hybrid environments (e.g., password policies, conditional access, privileged account handling)
  • Participate in the evaluation and integration of IAM-related technologies and security enhancements
  • Collaborate with IT, cloud, HRIS, and security engineering teams to embed identity governance in enterprise systems
  • Assist with privileged access management (PAM), identity federation design, and directory service integrations
  • Support audit and compliance efforts by maintaining evidence, resolving control gaps, and improving access visibility
  • Other duties as assigned by organization leadership
  • 3+ Year of hands on experience with IAM Admin.
  • Possess strong communications and interpersonal skills in English
  • Self-directed, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Strong ability to work collaboratively with others, to influence based on knowledge and experience
  • Strong experience with one or more of the following identity platforms: Okta, Azure AD/Entra, Active Directory
  • Hands-on knowledge of authentication standards: SAML, OAuth, OIDC, WS-Federation and SSO implementation/support
  • Experience with identity lifecycle automation, group policy management, and access governance tooling
  • Working knowledge of federated identity, MFA, conditional access, and directory sync processes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the administration of Active Directory and related technologies (GPO, PKI, DNS, etc)
  • Experience with the administration of identity governance (IGA) and privileged access (PAM) solutions
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or SOX
  • Familiarity with AI or LLM tooling for identity analytics, automation, or anomaly detection
  • Okta Administrator or Consultant Certification
  • Active Directory Certifications (AZ-802, ADDS Applied Skills)

Why NOV?

  • Build identity security controls at global scale for a diversified energy and technology leader
  • Be part of a security team driving Zero Trust transformation across IT and OT
  • Use modern IAM platforms with the freedom to innovate and automate

  • Hybrid work model (3 days onsite / 2 days remote).

  • Monday to Friday schedule (7:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.).

  • Permanent employment from day one.

  • Major Medical Insurance.

  • Minor Medical Insurance.

  • Funeral Expense Insurance.

  • Life Insurance.

  • Savings Fund.

  • 30 days of Christmas bonus (Aguinaldo).

  • Vacation in accordance with Mexican labor law.

  • Biweekly payroll.

title: Sr Real Estate Analyst
description:

You will maintain the real estate database, manage records and documentation, and provide reporting on property metrics. Travel is required for business purposes.

  • Lead and advise internal parties on lease concepts and ensure uniform adherence to lease contracts from both landlord and tenant perspectives.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot table analysis and financial analytics tools such as IRR, ROI, CAP Rates, ROC, ROIC, and NPV.
  • Ability to manage lease negotiations including structure, underwriting, and pricing.
  • Experience maintaining real estate databases and managing property documentation including deeds, surveys, environmental reports, and appraisals.

Graduation from senior high school or equivalent supplemented by specialized vocational/technical school training in the field of automotive mechanics plus thorough experience at the mechanic level

Must be able to work nights, weekends, and possibly holidays as needed per emergencies.

Job Description:

Job Title: Hy-Chi Department Clerk

Department: Hy-Chi

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our Hy-Chi department offers customers a unique and delicious experience, and our Hy-Chi Department Clerks are at the heart of making it happen. In this role, you'll fill customer orders, prepare and replenish product, keep the department running smoothly, and deliver the kind of friendly service that makes every customer feel welcome. Whether you're taking an order at the counter, pulling product from the cooler, or keeping the workspace clean and organized, your work makes a real difference every shift.

If you enjoy a fast-paced food service environment, take pride in quality, and love working with people, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile, taking orders at the Hy-Chi counter, and assisting them with their needs throughout the store

  • Review orders for the day and ensure an adequate food supply is ready and on hand by developing or following a production list

  • Prepare, finish, and replenish product as necessary and pull product from the cooler or freezer to prepare for cooking

  • Review the status and appearance of food for freshness and maintain quality standards throughout the shift

title: VIP Client Experience Manager
description:
Benefits:
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k)
Employment type: Full-Time, On-Site (Hybrid eligible after onboarding) | Location: Park City, UT | Reports to: COO
Schedule: Core business hours with availability expected outside standard hours during active VIP visits

Who You Are
You have worked with people who expect things to simply be handled. Not explained, not escalated, not followed up on tomorrow. Handled. You are the kind of person who reads a situation before it becomes a request and has already thought three steps ahead by the time
someone else is still asking the first question.

You have coordinated at a high level. Maybe that was as an executive assistant to a C-suite leader, a personal assistant to someone who runs in high-profile circles, or a luxury hospitality professional who built the kind of guest experience that people talk about long after they leave.
Whatever the context, you know what it takes to make a complex, high-touch experience feel effortless, and you understand that the whole thing falls apart if even one detail slips.

You are calm when other people are not. When a guest's assistant calls at 7 PM with a schedule change, you handle it without drama. When two VIPs have overlapping needs and Dr. Eckel has a packed morning, you figure out how to make it work. You do not need to be told what good looks like because you already have a standard that is higher than what most people ask for.

You are also a strong communicator across very different personalities. One day you are coordinating with a polished EA managing a Fortune 500 executive's calendar. The next you are personally reassuring a guest's family member who has questions about what their loved one's
program looks like. You can match tone, read the room, and know exactly how much information to give and when.

What you are tired of: roles where the standard for "good service" is mediocre and nobody notices the difference between adequate and exceptional. You want to work somewhere that treats excellence as the baseline and gives you the trust, autonomy, and responsibility to actually deliver it.

About bVital
bVital is a regenerative medicine and brain health clinic in Park City, Utah. We work with patients navigating serious neurological conditions, chronic illness, and performance decline. Some of our patients are private individuals referred through medical networks. Others are high-profile guests: executives, athletes, and public figures who have come to Park City specifically for a customized, high- touch clinical experience that does not exist anywhere else. The level of care we deliver in the clinical setting needs to be matched by the level of coordination and hospitality surrounding it. That is the gap this role fills.

The Role
After our VIP sales closer brings a high-profile guest on board, you take the handoff and own everything that comes next. That means designing and coordinating the guest's full experience from the moment they commit to the moment they leave Park City. You work directly with Dr. Eckel, Kitty, the VIP sales closer, and clinic management to build a customized program plan for each guest. You then manage every logistics and communication thread required to make that plan real.

These guests are not booking a standard package. They are coming for a purpose-built clinical experience, which means no two programs look exactly the same. Your job is to make sure the clinical plan Dr. Eckel designs translates into a coordinated, day-by-day guest experience that feels intentional and seamless from start to finish.

Clinical Schedule Coordination:
  • Work with Dr. Eckel and the clinical team to understand each VIP's care plan and sequence appointments correctly: the right modalities, in the right order, with the right providers.
  • Build and manage the complete clinical itinerary for each guest's visit, including provider appointments, therapy sessions, lab draws, and any specialized procedures.
  • Ensure the clinical team is fully briefed and prepared before each guest arrives: who they are, what their program looks like, and what the guest's expectations are.
  • Translate the clinical plan into a clear, guest-facing schedule that communicates what is happening and why, without overwhelming or confusing.
  • Manage real-time changes when schedules shift: reschedule appointments, adjust sequencing, and make sure every affected provider and team member is updated immediately.
Guest Coordination and Logistics:
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for each VIP guest and their personal or executive assistant from post-sale through departure.
  • Manage all non-clinical logistics: travel coordination, local accommodation guidance, transportation, and any special arrangements the guest or their team requests.
  • Anticipate and address needs before they become requests. If a guest's schedule shifts, you have already thought about how it ripples across the clinical plan and you have a solution ready.
Program Planning and Customization
  • Work directly with Dr. Eckel and Kitty to understand each VIP's goals and translate the clinical vision into a coordinated program plan.
  • Build clear, professional itineraries and program summaries for the guest and their team.
  • Track open items, changes, and requests across every active VIP engagement and ensure nothing is dropped.
Relationship Management
  • Maintain ongoing communication with guests and their representatives throughout the program: before, during, and after their visit.
  • Handle escalations, changes, and sensitive situations with discretion, calm, and professionalism.
  • Build relationships with personal assistants, executive assistants, and family representatives who are often the primary interface for booking future visits or referrals.
  • Represent bVital at the level of care and professionalism that high-profile guests expect.
Internal Coordination
  • Serve as the operational bridge between the clinical team, ownership, and the VIP guest. Everyone needs to know what is happening and when.
  • Coordinate closely with the COO on new VIP engagements, program design decisions, and any situations that need leadership visibility.
  • Maintain organized records for each VIP engagement: communications, itineraries, program plans, and post-visit notes.

Who Thrives Here
Must-haves:
  • Experience in a high-touch coordination, executive support, or luxury hospitality role where the standard for service was genuinely high, not just stated
  • Proven ability to manage complex logistics across multiple stakeholders simultaneously without things falling through the cracks
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you write with clarity and warmth and you speak to everyone from a CEO's assistant to a nervous family member with equal professionalism
  • High emotional intelligence: you read people well, adjust quickly, and stay composed under pressure or in ambiguous situations
  • Comfort with flexible availability: this role requires responsiveness outside of standard business hours when VIP guests or their teams need something
  • Experience working in healthcare
Bonus points:
  • Background in luxury hotel, resort, or private club guest services
  • Experience as an executive assistant or personal assistant to a high-profile principal
  • Familiarity with coordinating across time zones and with international guests
  • Prior exposure to integrative medicine, wellness retreats, or concierge medical settings
You thrive here if...
  • Anticipating a need before it is expressed is something you do naturally, not something you have to remind yourself to do.
  • You take real pride in the handoff. When a guest leaves, you want them to feel like every detail was thought of. Not most details. Every detail.
  • Working directly with ownership and operating with a high degree of trust and autonomy energizes rather than intimidates you.
  • You are calm, kind, and professional even when the situation is not.

This is not the right fit if...
  • You prefer a role with clear, predictable hours and minimal after-hours communication. VIP guests and their teams operate on their own schedules.
  • You need step-by-step instruction to know what good looks like. This role requires independent judgment on a daily basis.
  • High-pressure or high-expectation environments drain you. The guests we work with have high standards and they expect those standards to be met.

How You'll Be Measured
1. Guest experience quality — do VIP guests and their representatives leave feeling that every detail was handled at the level they expected?
2. Coordination reliability — are clinical teams, providers, and ownership always informed and prepared before each guest interaction?
3. Response and follow-through — are requests from guests and their teams addressed promptly, completely, and without needing a follow-up?
4. Relationship outcomes — are the relationships you build with VIP guests and their representatives translating into return visits, referrals, or ongoing engagement?

title: Bilingual Community Educator
description:
Cal-Wood Education Center is seeking a Bilingual Community Educator to support our Community Engagement team in expanding access to meaningful outdoor and environmental education experiences for students and families.

Working closely with the Community Engagement Manager, this position will help build relationships with schools and families by representing Cal-Wood at community events, participating in parent meetings, and delivering engaging, culturally responsive environmental education lessons in area schools. The Bilingual Community Educator will serve as an approachable and professional connection between Cal-Wood, schools, students, and families.

The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who is fluent in Spanish and English, has experience working with students and/or families, and is comfortable representing an organization in a variety of community settings. This position requires someone who can communicate respectfully and professionally with parents and school staff, create positive relationships with diverse communities, and independently travel to schools and community events.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Community Outreach and Engagement

  • Represent Cal-Wood Education Center at community events, school events, family nights, and other outreach opportunities.
  • Work alongside the Community Engagement Manager to engage families and community members in Cal-Wood programs and opportunities.
  • Help establish and maintain positive relationships with families, teachers, school staff, and community partners.
  • Communicate information about Cal-Wood programs, scholarships, registration, transportation, and other opportunities in clear and accessible language.
  • Participate in parent meetings and school events, answering questions and helping families feel comfortable and informed about participating in Cal-Wood programs.
  • Provide outreach and program information in both English and Spanish.
  • Support the Community Engagement Manager with follow-up communication to families, schools, and community partners as needed.
  • Represent Cal-Wood professionally and in alignment with the organization's mission, values, and commitment to equitable access to outdoor experiences.

In-School Environmental Education

  • Deliver engaging, age-appropriate environmental education lessons at partner schools, primarily in elementary and middle school classrooms.
  • Facilitate lessons using Cal-Wood curriculum and educational materials while adapting instruction to meet the needs of individual groups.
  • Create positive and inclusive learning environments that encourage student participation, curiosity, and connection to the natural world.
  • Support lessons in both English and Spanish as appropriate for students and teachers.
  • Build positive relationships with classroom teachers and school staff.
  • Prepare, organize, transport, and care for educational materials and equipment needed for school-based programs.
  • Provide feedback to the Community Engagement Manager about student engagement, teacher feedback, and opportunities to improve programming.
  • Follow Cal-Wood's educational, safety, and behavior-management expectations while working with students.

Communication and Administrative Support

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with parents, teachers, school administrators, and community members.
  • Respond to routine questions from families and refer more complex questions or concerns to the Community Engagement Manager or Director of Programs.
  • Maintain accurate records related to outreach activities, school visits, and community events.
  • Provide timely updates to the Community Engagement Manager or Director of Programs regarding program delivery, community needs, and any concerns that arise.
  • Complete required program documentation, timesheets, and other administrative tasks accurately and on time.
  • Support other Cal-Wood programs and organizational activities as appropriate.
  • Uphold Cal-Wood's commitment to creating positive, inclusive, and accessible experiences in nature.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English required.
  • Experience in education, environmental education, youth development, community engagement, outdoor recreation, or a related field.
  • Experience working with elementary or middle school students preferred.
  • Ability to communicate with parents in a mature, respectful, and professional manner, including when answering questions or addressing concerns.
  • Strong classroom management and facilitation skills. Formal teaching experience or a degree in education is preferred but not required.
  • Reliable transportation and the ability to travel independently to local schools and community events required.
  • Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends for community and family events.
  • Current First Aid/CPR certification or willingness to obtain preferred.
  • Successful completion of a comprehensive background check required.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to travel to and work at schools, community centers, outdoor spaces, and other community locations.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and carry educational materials and supplies weighing up to approximately 25 pounds.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Ability to actively participate in environmental education activities and games with students and families.

title: Business Management Analyst
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.



This position is preferred as an onsite position located in Falls Church, VA with opportunity for a hybrid work schedule.


Position Overview
The Strategic Cost Management and Operations, Cost Optimization team is seeking a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Business Management Analyst. This role is responsible for the financial rigor, narrative quality, and reporting integrity of assigned business cases and optimization ideas moving through the Optimization Hub. The analyst partners directly with managers and directors across the organization to develop defensible business cases and apply established narrative and financial standards consistently.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Integrated Project Teams (IPTs) to develop comprehensive, data-driven business cases and optimization ideas from problem definition through approval and benefits realization.
  • Gather and synthesize financial, operational, technical, and qualitative data into cohesive, evidence-based, narrative-driven decision artifact.
  • Independently validate financial assumptions and calculations, including return on investment, net present value, payback period, run-rate savings, and one-time benefits, using established financial templates and methods.
  • Perform sensitivity and risk analyses to identify material financial, execution, schedule, or benefits-realization risks; document findings and recommend corrective actions.
  • Review business cases, optimization ideas, and supporting artifacts against established narrative and financial standards to ensure submissions are complete, internally consistent, defensible, and executive-ready.
  • Advise and coach IPTs on business case and optimization idea development, financial modeling, and executive narrative quality.
  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, traceability, and reporting readiness of initiative data within the Optimization Hub.
  • Produce and analyze approved business cases and optimization ideas performance reporting for weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, highlighting trends, exceptions, and emerging risks.
  • Monitor business cases and optimization ideas across pipeline stages and apply established health, aging, and at-risk criteria consistently.
  • Escalate material variances, aging actions, and underperforming initiatives to project owners and appropriate leadership, supported by clear analysis and recommendations.
  • Partner with Business Management, CIDO, and other stakeholders to reconcile realized savings, run-rate versus one-time classifications, and budget-to-actual results.
  • Identify recurring control, reporting, and data-quality issues and recommend improvements to templates, standards, metrics, and operating processes.
  • Prepare and present financial analyses, portfolio insights, and recommendations to managers, directors, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary analytical point of contact for assigned business cases and optimization ideas.

Job Characteristics

  • Complete understanding and application of principles, concepts, practices, and standards. Full knowledge of industry practices. Independently demonstrates the skill and ability to perform fairly complex professional tasks.
  • Develop solutions to a variety of complex problems. May refer to established precedents and policies.

Required Qualifications

  • 3 years of relevant experience with a Bachelors; 1 years with Masters
  • Advanced Excel skills, including development and review of formula-driven financial models.
  • Working proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Experience preparing and presenting executive-level reporting to senior leadership.
  • Ability to develop proficiency in the FinOps Framework as well as data center and cloud financial-management concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IT cost management, procurement, FinOps, and/or corporate FP&A program doing business cases and cost-benefit analysis.
  • FinOps practitioner certificate
  • Strong written communication skills, with experience holding business documents to an explicit narrative or writing standard.
  • Able to work independently within established standards and recommend practical improvements to templates, metrics, and processes.

Primary Level Salary Range: $75,800.00 - $113,800.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
