title: Planner Operations
description:
Job Summary

Planner is responsible for managing internal manufacturing of components and final assemblies leveraging ERP system and using extended planning horizons such that manufacturing can occur as scheduled; resource and capacity issues become visible with sufficient lead-time to define and manage on-time completion of work orders. This position will be responsible for interfacing with intercompany business units for order acknowledgements, sales contract review, delivery status etc.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage intercompany sales orders (NSO): Order Management process steps from order entry through to delivery shipment of product to customer
  • Manage sales order on-time delivery and communicate of order changes/delays to concern stake holders
  • Develop priorities and communicate support functions while taking an active role in problem resolution as required.
  • Review and release work orders per the system demand, manage the system recommended messages, as well as maintain work order dates that adhere to the metrics of the organization.
  • Expedite work orders through production process as required. Execute production dispatch activities. Generate ERP Dispatch Reports and manage shop scheduling and optimization.
  • Manage all WIP and resolution of WIP aging issues. Analyze and implement corrective actions for all Job Closure variances outside the required tolerance.
  • Development of weekly and monthly shipment plan and co-ordination of shipment activities
  • Comply with all NOV Company, departmental and HSE procedures and policies.

Facility Responsibilities

  • Lead daily production meetings with relevant stakeholders.
  • Attend Weekly/Monthly status calls with customers
  • Review material shortages and work with Buyer to resolve shortages between CPO material plans and actual manufacturing needs.
  • Commit all items and release Work Orders for in-house production and OSP per MRP.
  • Monitor work-in-process and status work orders and maintain estimated completion dates in the system
  • Manage ERP exceptions and system generated messages.
  • Maintain and manage list of Orders that have risk to on time delivery.
  • Reason out and understand order / shipment issues, and resolve.
  • Timely and clear communication and follow through from issue identification to closure.
  • Communicate clearly with the customer, warehouse, team members, Customers, logistics partners and across Order Management
  • Conduct open order review meeting with team members
  • Escalate issues and potential resolutions to Management as appropriate.
  • Timely coordination with engineering, manufacturing, purchase, quality and management
  • Perform work such that a perpetual state of audit readiness is maintained.
  • Participate in internal audits as required.

Metric Accountabilities

  • On-Time Delivery
  • Customer Satisfaction

Education & Experience Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or MBA preferred with emphasis in business administration, project management or engineering
  • Minimum 7 years’ experience in planning function
  • Excellent communications skills with all stakeholders, including the customer, sales, warehouse, transportation, order management, and purchasing teams
  • Experience with using MRP systems, such as Oracle, including generating reports from ERP systems.
  • Experience solving complex problems, has problem solving skills Proficient in use of Microsoft Office suite of products.
  • English speaking and writing needs to at a proficient level.
  • Needs to be able to work independently
  • Strong time management and analytical skills.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Demonstrates strong ownership of responsibilities and accountability for achieving project milestones, ensuring on-time delivery.
  • Communicates clearly and proactively, fostering teamwork, cross-functional collaboration, and transparency to achieve shared objectives.
  • Approaches problems systematically, leveraging data and insights to make sound, evidence-based decisions.
  • Efficiently plans and prioritizes tasks, managing multiple projects and resources to meet deadlines and quality standards.
  • Anticipates stakeholder needs, maintains strong customer relationships, and ensures timely and accurate information flow to support satisfaction and trust.
  • Responds effectively to changing priorities, project dynamics, and business environments with flexibility and a positive attitude.

Technical Competencies

  • Skilled in Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and ERP systems (E.g Oracle)
  • Strong demand forecasting and data analysis capabilities
  • Good understanding about operations planning, scheduling, and capacity management
  • Coordinates effectively across supply chain, procurement, and production team
  • Applies Lean or continuous improvement principles to optimize efficiency
  • Monitors KPIs and prepares accurate operational reports
  • Identifies risks and develops contingency or recovery plans
  • Ensures planning documentation and processes comply with standards and policies
  • Proficient in use of Microsoft Office suite of products

title: Manager II, Engineering & Maintenance
description:
What You'll Do

You will oversee daily maintenance operations across multiple warehouses or a single complex facility, ensuring the installation, repair, and upkeep of machines, equipment, and utility systems. You will manage engineering and maintenance teams, set performance objectives, and monitor compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Occasional travel up to 5-12% may be required for development, training, and other business needs.

Essential Functions

  • Direct and assign work to engineering and maintenance associates, set performance objectives, and monitor team performance.
  • Prepare annual maintenance budgets, schedule expenditures, analyze variances, and initiate corrective actions to achieve financial objectives.
  • Determine work priorities and schedule repair, maintenance, and installation of machines, tools, and equipment to support operational productivity.
  • Design, implement, and modify preventive maintenance programs by reviewing reports, inspecting equipment, and ensuring operational standards are met.
  • Ensure compliance with all OSHA regulations and state codes, maintain a safe and clean working environment, and protect employees and visitors.
  • Maintain and analyze equipment reliability reports, initiate action plans for improvement, and ensure material handling equipment is operational and in good repair.
  • Execute capital projects including obtaining bids, submitting requests, and managing contractors and vendors throughout the process.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience required in maintenance with at least 3 years directly managing or supervising others.
  • High School diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and prioritize effectively.
  • Fully competent in mechanical and basic electrical concepts with ability to work hands-on in mechanically oriented situations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office including Excel and experience with SAP or Oracle CMMS platforms.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Associate's degree or higher relevant to facility maintenance preferred.
  • CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional) or similar certification preferred.
  • Completion of all eight RETA courses preferred.
  • RETA CARO or CIRO or equivalent preferred.
  • Familiarity with ISO standards.
  • Material Handling Equipment (Forklift) knowledge and certification preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to build mentoring relationships and contribute to team development.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work in spaces with 55 inches (1.4 meters) of headroom.
  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures varying from 32 degrees Fahrenheit (0 degrees Celsius) to minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius), as well as outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold and precipitation).
  • Able to climb ladders or step ladders.
  • Able to tolerate heights up to 30 ft. (9 meters) and be able to access elevated products from inside safety cage.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for working at heights and in cold temperatures.
  • Able to stand and/or walk continuously or frequently over an 8-10-12 hour shift. Occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Depending on specific role, must be able to lift boxes of varying weights up to 80 lbs. (36 kg) and carry product a distance of up to 6 ft. (2 meters) without mechanical assistance.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job, including close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
  • Able to hear and speak in order to comprehend, respond to, and provide instructions and safety warnings, as well as able to read and understand packaging, shipping documents, and safety guidelines.

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
About the Role

As a Mechanical Technician, you will be responsible for the safe and precise assembly and testing of advanced wireline equipment, including winches and masts, supporting critical operations in the energy sector. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality production standards, continuous improvement, and safe working practices within a collaborative workshop environment.

About the Company

NOV is a leading global provider of technology, equipment, and services to the energy industry. With a long-standing history of innovation, NOV supports customers in improving efficiency, safety, and environmental performance across operations worldwide.

What We Offer

  • Modern, clean, and well-organised workshop environment with high safety standards
  • Access to high-quality tools, equipment, and newly invested machinery
  • Structured onboarding with a hands-on buddy system to support your development from day one
  • Stable, full-time employment in a global organization with long-term career opportunities
  • Clear pathway for progression into more senior technician roles over time
  • Opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and influence how work is done
  • Supportive, close-knit team environment where collaboration and knowledge sharing are encouraged

Why Join Us?

Join our Global Family:

We offer an inspiring place to work with great opportunities to develop your skills and the opportunity to work with the brightest minds in the energy industry. You will become part of a professional culture where we work together in teams with other dedicated professionals to achieve common goals.

NOV is a leading provider of technology, equipment, and services to the global energy industry that supports customers across drilling, completion, and production operations. NOV powers the industry that powers the world.

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your personal, financial, and professional wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

Health & Wellbeing

Finance & Protection

Flexible Benefits (via salary sacrifice options for you and your family)

Core Responsibilities

  • Assemble and test mechanical and hydraulic equipment in line with engineering drawings and specifications
  • Read, interpret, and follow blueprints, schematics, and bills of materials
  • Maintain cleanliness and integrity of hydraulic systems during assembly
  • Inspect materials and components to detect defects or faults
  • Ensure all work meets required quality standards (“right first time”)

Additional Responsibilities

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (LEAN / 5S)
  • Support and collaborate with team members to improve overall performance

Desired

Soft Skills

  • Team-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset

  • Good communication skills and willingness to support others

title: R&D Designer
description:
This role will prepare designs to assist in developing ideas generated by engineers, designs products and equipment, and will be responsible for producing safe, technically accurate and cost effective equipment designs.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist Project Leader, Senior Designer or Design Engineer in selection of the simpler components and the design details for inclusion in the project/product design.
  • Layout and design specific areas as assigned per the Company procedures and standards.
  • Design general arrangements or base systems based on customer needs and requirements.
  • Analyze data to determine feasibility of product proposal.
  • Prepare or direct preparation of product or system layout with detailed drawings and schematics.
  • Review work order and procedural manuals to determine critical content.
  • Calculate figures to convert design dimensions to resizing dimensions specified for subsequent production processes.
  • Assist in systems development as required, such as drafting standards, parts list systems, computer programming.
  • Perform other work related tasks as assigned.
  • Comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures.

FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop detailed 3D solid models using CAD software for new product concepts.
  • Produce accurate 2D engineering schematics, drawings, and BOMs from 3D models.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional R&D teams to iterate designs and resolve technical challenges.
  • Work independently and create new designs with minimal input. Own designs from concept development and meet all customer requirements.
  • Ensure all releases meet company quality standards and global manufacturing requirements.
  • Maintain design documentation and version control in accordance with NOC standards.
  • Lead design reviews, provide feedback on manufacturability and cost effectiveness.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Drafting, or related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience creating 3D models and 2D drawings in an R&D environment.
  • Proficiency with industry‑standard CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Creo).
  • Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerancing, and manufacturing processes.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and ability to think quickly under tight deadlines.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities across global locations.
  • Attention to detail with a commitment to high‑quality deliverables.

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

  • Solidworks
  • Solidworks Vault
  • Teamcenter
  • AutoCAD

  • FREE MDLIVE virtual visits (when enrolled in an NOV medical plan).
  • FREE preventative medical and dental care for the entire family (when enrolled in an NOV medical/dental plan and seeing an in-network physician).
  • FREE Basic Life and AD&D insurance at 2 times your annual salary (for full-time employees).
  • All regular full-time employees start with 3 weeks of paid vacation per year (prorated based on start date). Pre-NOV relevant experience (years of service) may be considered for vacation accruals.
  • All regular full-time employees receive up to 11 paid holidays per year

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Riverside Galleria at Tyler - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges

title: Engineering Manager, Pipe System Design
description:
At NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we power the industry that powers the world.

Our core business is the engineering, manufacturing, and delivery of high-quality flexible pipe systems to customers worldwide. Across our operations in Brazil and Denmark, we combine advanced engineering expertise with state-of-the-art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea solutions for some of the energy industry's most challenging projects.

Being part of NOV means joining a global, purpose-driven organization committed to operational excellence, collaboration, and long-term career development.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager – Pipe System Design (PSD) to lead a team of skilled pipe and system design engineers and manage the engineering execution of a portfolio of projects from our NOV SPS Rio office, working in close coordination with our Açu factory and site.

This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your leadership, management, and technical skills while contributing to a global Engineering organization and expanding the knowledge and experience within our Pipe System Design team.

As Engineering Manager, your primary focus will be leading the PSD project execution team and ensuring effective delivery across the assigned project portfolio. You will oversee engineering design, development, and project completion throughout the product lifecycle, from tender through execution.

You will manage engineering risks and coordinate solutions across Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, Planning, and Manufacturing, while ensuring that customer specifications and applicable standards are properly addressed.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders across Rio de Janeiro, Açu, and Brøndby.

Key Responsibilities:

As Engineering Manager – Pipe System Design, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the day-to-day activities of the PSD project execution team, ensuring timely and effective delivery of the assigned project portfolio;
  • Leading, supporting, and developing an experienced team of pipe and system design engineers;
  • Planning and managing engineering scope, resources, priorities, deliverables, and project milestones;
  • Attending project meetings and providing the necessary technical support, information, and decisions to the team and other project stakeholders;
  • Tracking project deliverables, risks, resources, and milestones in collaboration with Project Managers, Technical Managers, Engineering Managers, Engineering Leaders, and other relevant stakeholders;
  • Overseeing and participating in internal design activities, technical reviews, and engineering assurance activities for projects in execution;
  • Managing engineering risks and coordinating solutions across Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Project Execution;
  • Ensuring that engineering design and documentation comply with customer specifications and applicable standards;
  • Reviewing and approving design documentation;
  • Supporting technical developments and improvements through applicable group charter activities when specifically designated;
  • Promoting and supporting continuous improvement initiatives focused on engineering efficiency and quality;
  • Maintaining close day-to-day coordination with the PSD Engineering Manager in Açu, ensuring clear accountability and effective interfaces between project execution, local manufacturing support, FEED and conceptual studies, Sales Engineering, and after-sales activities;
  • Leading or coordinating customer interactions related to Pipe System Design together with the wider project team;
  • Preparing technical documentation, as required, based on input from customers and other Engineering teams;
  • Exercising sound engineering judgment and effectively challenging complex technical matters;
  • Communicating effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams, including factory operations, engineers, and specialists from international backgrounds;
  • Traveling as required to support projects, customer engagements, coordination with the Açu factory and site, global PSD collaboration, and other business needs.

Qualifications & Experience:

We are looking for a technical professional with strong leadership and management capabilities, combined with relevant engineering experience.

We expect you to have:
- A degree in Engineering;
- Strong technical experience in flexible pipe system design engineering or a similar engineering field;
- Proven people-management and leadership skills;
- Experience in project management activities, including planning, scope breakdown, resource estimation, prioritization, and milestone management;
- Ability to plan resources and lead the execution of a complex portfolio of engineering projects;
- Experience with engineering design activities, technical reviews, design documentation, and engineering assurance;
- A broad technical background with the ability to exercise sound engineering judgment and challenge complex technical matters;
- Strong technical responsibility and the ability to understand the drivers, risks, and consequences associated with engineering decisions;
- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, project teams, factory operations, engineers, and specialists from different cultural and professional backgrounds;
- High level of English proficiency, both written and spoken, for effective communication within our global organization;
- A self-driven and collaborative approach, with the ability to manage priorities and solve technical and organizational challenges;
- Willingness to travel according to project and business requirements.
It will be considered an advantage if you have:
- Experience in the design of unbonded flexible pipe systems, or closely related engineering experience.

Who You Are
You have a strong sense of technical responsibility and are comfortable making sound assessments while understanding the drivers, risks, and consequences of your decisions.


You are self-driven, communicate clearly, and naturally motivate and lead others. You enjoy solving technical and organizational challenges through dialogue, planning, and effective priority setting while collaborating closely with engineering leadership and key stakeholders.


Bring your leadership, technical expertise, and ideas to NOV SPS and help us deliver some of the industry's most challenging engineering projects. Join a global team that powers the world!

description:

  • Manage electrical systems, including switchgear, UPS systems, backup generators, and distribution panels

Flexibility: Ability to work on-call and extended hours (including weekends and holidays).
Hight Standards: A hands-on approach and a commitment to maintaining high standards of work and safety.
Physical Readiness Comfortable with tasks that involve bending, kneeling, and working in confined spaces. Ability to climb ladders (up to 30 feet) and walk multiple flights of stairs daily. Flexibility to work indoors and outdoors, in all weather conditions.
License: A valid Driver’s License!

Why You’ll Love This Role:

Competitive Pay & Perks! Your hard work and success are rewarded with great wages, bonuses and PTO!
Awesome Benefits! We offer employee housing discounts, 401k match, health insurance with no waiting period, tuition reimbursement, relocation bonuses and more!
Growth Opportunities! We’re invested in your career and offer training and advancement paths.
Team Spirit! Work with a supportive and fun group of people who value your contributions.
Variety! Every day is different, keeping your work fresh and engaging.
Make a Difference! Play a key role in creating a safe and welcoming community for residents.

Apply now to start an exciting journey with Westminster, where your skills and leadership will be celebrated and rewarded!

title: Quality Supervisor
description:
Lead, manage, and coordinate QA/QC and QMS activities to support Mumbai facility repair operations. Oversee key quality functions, provide QA/QC operational support, deliver quality awareness and process training, and ensure the effective and sustainable implementation of the QMS in alignment with customer, industry, and NOV Global Quality/BPA/Standardization standards, as well as other applicable requirements.

Collaborate closely with the Operations Team, Department Leads, and Process Owners to achieve product quality and on-time delivery objectives, while driving quality awareness, promotion, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee daily QA/QC operations to ensure compliance with company, customer, and regulatory requirements.
  • Review Work Orders and Sales Orders to develop Quality Plans (QP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), quality certificates, and data books.
  • Plan and coordinate inspections and testing activities including receiving, in-process, and final inspections, documentation review, functional testing, and FAT witnessing at internal facilities and customer/supplier sites.
  • Monitor inspection and testing processes to ensure adherence to applicable quality standards and procedures.
  • Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and maintenance of quality records within the document management system.
  • Manage NCRs, CARs/PARs, and customer feedback; lead root cause analysis (RCA), corrective action implementation, and timely closure.
  • Lead internal quality audits (IQA), support BPA process audits, QMS certification audits, customer audits, and supplier audits as assigned.
  • Review and update site-specific quality procedures to maintain compliance with Global Quality standards and QMS requirements.
  • Prepare and present annual quality performance reports.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA/QC effectiveness and optimize quality resources.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop QA/QC personnel, including performance management and training.
  • Ensure full compliance with company Quality and HSE policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Facility/Group Specific Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate QC activities at the facility and customer-designated locations (e.g., shipyards) to ensure project and contractual compliance.
  • Maintain and support the site’s QMS certification, ensuring effective implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems and documentation.

  • Safeguard QMS process and document integrity, ensuring timely follow-up with process owners and suppliers on quality matters requiring review, action, and closure (e.g., risk assessments, MOC, procedures, CAR/PAR, RCA, reports).

  • Certified QMS Auditor or hands-on experience with API Q1 and/or ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

  • Strong knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards.

  • Good command of written and spoken English, with effective presentation skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team successfully.

Job Requirement

title: Digital Workplace Administrator
description:
This role is responsible for administering, securing, monitoring, and continuously improving NOV's global Microsoft 365 environment. The Digital Workplace Administrator will support Microsoft 365 and communication and collaboration services for colleagues across more than 60 countries, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient digital workplace services.

The administrator will work across IT teams, business stakeholders, and global users to maintain Microsoft 365 services, support messaging and collaboration platforms, automate administrative processes, troubleshoot operational issues, and contribute to service improvements. The role requires a proactive approach to operations, a strong automation mindset, and a commitment to service reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role will be demonstrated through stable and secure Microsoft 365 operations, effective automation of administrative tasks, reliable mail and collaboration services, timely incident resolution, well-maintained documentation, and continuous enhancement of the end-user experience.

  • Administer, monitor, maintain, improve Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online and Microsoft Teams and related platforms.

  • Monitor and maintain mail filtering and unified communications services, including mail flow and related configurations.

  • Maintain secure configurations, policies, and access controls; monitor issues and address risks.

  • Troubleshoot service incidents and problems, contribute to change management, and maintain clear operational documentation.

  • Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online policies and integrations.

  • Assist with data and application migrations related to mergers and acquisitions.

  • Build and maintain secure automation for administration and operational tasks using PowerShell and, where appropriate, Ansible or other tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, automation, and end-user experience across the environment.

  • Monitor service health and respond to operational issues affecting collaboration and communication services.

  • Maintain and troubleshoot mail flow, DNS records, directory synchronization, and related services.

  • Support spam filtering and email protection solutions.

  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency.

  • Support integrations using Microsoft Graph and related Microsoft 365 technologies.

  • Manage and maintain scripts and automation assets using GitHub or similar platforms.

  • Participate in service improvement initiatives and operational excellence activities.

  • Support change management activities and ensure defined processes are followed consistently.

  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, procedures, and knowledge of articles.

  • Collaborate with global teams to ensure effective and reliable service delivery.

  • Support security best practices and compliance requirements within the Microsoft 365 environment.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of administration, automation, and support processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field.

  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive in a large enterprise environment.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and security best practices.

  • Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting PowerShell scripts and automation solutions, including integrations with Microsoft Graph API.

  • Working knowledge of mail flow, DNS records, directory synchronization, and troubleshooting associated identity and messaging services.

  • Familiarity with spam and email filtering solutions.

  • Experience using GitHub or a similar platform to manage scripts and automation.

  • Understanding of service desk operations and ITIL practices.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize operational needs, and take initiative in improving services.

  • Experience supporting large enterprise environments.

  • Experience with Ansible, n8n, or other automation tools is preferred.

  • Understanding of CI/CD principles is preferred.

  • Microsoft 365 certifications relevant to administration, security, or collaboration services are preferred.

  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and their responsible use in day-to-day work is preferred.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with global teams.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities.

  • Careful attention to detail and a practical, methodical approach to problem-solving.

  • Commitment to documentation and continuous learning.

description:

Starting as an Assistant Technician, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, develop your technical expertise, and grow within a supportive team environment. You will work closely with engineers and technicians, providing technical support while maintaining a safe, organized, and efficient workshop. In this role, you will gain valuable hands-on experience and contribute to high-quality maintenance and workshop operations that support some of Norway's leading energy operators, including Equinor and Aker BP.

What you will do

  • Perform routine maintenance checks to identify and address potential issues, ensuring equipment longevity.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to implement equipment improvements and stay at the forefront of industry advancements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, for effective collaboration with colleagues, engineers, and field personnel.
  • A willingness to learn and stay updated with industry advancements, embracing new technologies and best practices to enhance maintenance strategies.
  • A safety-conscious mindset is essential, prioritizing the well-being of oneself and colleagues, and adhering to safety protocols.

title: Drilling Solution Engineer
description:
As Drilling Solution Engineer within NOV’s you will be responsible for providing technical support and expertise in drilling operations. You will work closely with clients, drilling engineers, and other team members to ensure the successful execution of drilling projects. Your role will involve analyzing and optimizing drilling solutions to maximize operational efficiency and safety.

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their drilling objectives and develop appropriate drilling solutions.
  • Conduct engineering analysis to optimize drilling parameters, such as weight on bit, drilling fluid properties, and drill string configurations.
  • Monitor drilling operations in real-time and provide technical support to drilling teams on the rig.
  • Perform post-well analysis to evaluate drilling performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including drilling reports, procedures, and best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with clients, drilling supervisors, and multidisciplinary teams to assess drilling objectives, provide technical expertise, and develop comprehensive drilling plans and strategies.
  • Utilize advanced drilling software applications and data analytics to optimize drilling parameters, minimize risk, and maximize operational efficiency.
  • Monitor real-time drilling operations, analyzing data and performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement and make necessary adjustments to enhance drilling performance.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments in drilling operations, incorporating relevant advancements into project planning and execution.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality technical reports, presentations, and documentation to clients, management, and industry conferences, showcasing innovative drilling solutions and successful project outcomes.

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of drilling fundamentals, including drilling techniques, drilling fluids, wellbore stability, and drilling equipment.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Drilling or a related role in the oil and gas industry.
  • Experience with drilling optimization, including the selection of drilling parameters and drilling fluid properties.

Desirable

  • Basic understanding of drilling rig components, including drill bits, drill string, and drilling fluids.
  • Familiarity with drilling practices, such as rotary drilling, mud circulation, and well control.
  • Ability to interpret drilling data, such as drilling parameters and wellbore conditions.
  • Proficiency in basic wellbore stability analysis and drilling fluid properties.
  • Proficiency in utilizing and customizing advanced drilling software applications, such as real-time monitoring systems, drilling optimization algorithms, and data analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with drilling software applications for hydraulics analysis and torque and drag modelling.

Interim Ranch Foreman
Position Title: Interim Ranch Foreman
Location: King City, Topo Ranch, CA
FLSA Status: Full-time, Non-Exempt
Reports to: Ranch Manager
Pay Scale: $26.00-$29.75


Overview

The Interim Ranch Foreman is responsible for the daily supervision and coordination of ranch operations at Topo Ranch. This position provides leadership to ranch hands and day workers while ensuring the safe, efficient, and productive management of livestock, equipment, facilities, roads, water systems, and grazing lands. The Interim Ranch Foreman leads by example and actively participates in all ranch activities, including cattle operations, fencing, maintenance, and land stewardship. This position will be on stocker ranches of 40,000+ acres where we have run a combined total of 7,500-11,000 head of stockers the past two growing seasons.


Responsibilities

Livestock Management

  • Oversee daily cattle operations, including gathering, sorting, branding, vaccinating, shipping, and receiving livestock.
  • Monitor herd health and report illnesses, injuries, or unusual conditions.
  • Coordinate with veterinarians and livestock professionals as needed.
  • Ensure proper handling of livestock following animal welfare standards.
Employee Supervision

  • Supervise ranch hands and day workers.
  • Assign daily work schedules and priorities.
  • Train employees on equipment operation, livestock handling, and safety procedures.
  • Promote a positive and productive team environment.
Ranch Maintenance

  • Maintain fences, corrals, gates, roads, water systems, and ranch buildings.
  • Inspect ranch infrastructure and schedule repairs.
  • Operate and maintain tractors, skid steers, UTVs, trucks, trailers, and other ranch equipment.
Land and Resource Management

  • Monitor grazing conditions and pasture utilization.
  • Assist with water management and conservation practices.
  • Conduct routine inspections of stock tanks, pipelines, wells, and ponds.
  • Support ranch improvement projects and habitat management initiatives.
Safety and Compliance

  • Enforce ranch safety standards and policies.
  • Assist in maintaining required records related to livestock, equipment, maintenance, and employee activities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Respond to emergencies involving livestock, equipment, weather, or property.


Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 5 years of ranching experience, preferably in cattle operations.
  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of livestock handling and range management.
  • Experience operating agricultural and ranch equipment.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding outdoor work in varying weather conditions.
  • Valid California driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Preferred

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).
  • Experience with large-scale cattle ranch operations.
  • Welding, mechanical, or heavy equipment maintenance experience.
  • CPR/First Aid certification.


Skills

  • Physical stamina and endurance for outdoor work.
  • Basic mechanical skills for equipment maintenance.
  • Problem-solving and adaptability to changing conditions.
  • Commitment to environmental stewardship and conservation principles.
  • Basic welding skills
  • Familiarity with plumbing and water systems
Working Conditions

  • Full-time position with variable hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends.
  • Work performed outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Physical demands include lifting, standing, and walking on uneven terrain.

Non-Exempt position. Hourly Pay Range $26.00-$29.75

title: Baker
location: Rochester #4, Circle Dr. NW, Rochester, MN
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Baker

Department: Bakery

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our bakery is a destination for customers who expect freshness, quality, and something that feels homemade. As a Baker, you'll be responsible for preparing and baking the products that fill our cases and fulfill our customers' orders every day. From proofing and frying to pulling from the freezer and leading bakery clerks, your skill and attention to detail directly shape the quality our customers experience.

If you take pride in your craft, thrive in a fast-paced kitchen environment, and enjoy being part of a hardworking team, we'd love to have you on board.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile and assisting them with their needs throughout the store

  • Check orders for the day and set up a timeline and production schedule, prioritizing special and future orders as needed

  • Prepare, make up, bake, and fry all department products, proofing items as necessary and pulling product from the freezer or cooler

  • Review product for freshness and pull by stale date; anticipate product needs not only for the current day but for subsequent days

  • Inspect incoming products for quality and quantity, including identifying mispicks

  • Invoice and put away product as instructed by the Department Manager

  • Check signage for correct labels on ad items and review the department for potential safety issues

  • Understand the use and maintenance needs of bakery equipment and follow up on potential issues

  • Operate as a lead with bakery clerks, providing guidance and direction

  • Review current product on the shelf, re-merchandise as needed, and remove or recycle outdated products

  • Order supplies and merchandise items for the department as directed by the Bakery Manager

  • Write the department schedule and ensure coverage in the Bakery Manager's absence

  • Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking product orders

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer and team experience

  • Solve practical problems and make sound decisions with a variety of variables and limited standardization

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Lead and guide bakery clerks, providing direction and maintaining department standards

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Handle confidential information including sales with discretion

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Bakery Department Manager

Direct Reports: Apprentice Baker, Bakery Designer, Wrapper, Fryer

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience; department training is helpful

  • Over six months up to one year of similar or related experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines throughout your shift. You'll work in the bakery department and can expect continual exposure to flour, noise, and temperature extremes, as well as frequent exposure to dampness, vibrations, and equipment movement hazards, and occasional exposure to cleaning chemicals and solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $17.00 to $21.25 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Administrative/ Program Support Coordinator III, Global Cybersecurity Institute
description:
Position Highlights


The Administrative Program Support Coordinator III provides advanced administrative and operational coordination for the ESL Global Cybersecurity Institute, its leaders, programs, student organizations, events, and facilities. Reporting to the Manager of Academic Operations in the Cybersecurity Department, the Coordinator independently manages multiple priorities, applies working knowledge of RIT policies and systems, resolves non-routine operational issues, and coordinates with internal and external partners to ensure effective service delivery.


Leadership Support:

  • Independently coordinate purchasing, procurement card reconciliation, travel reservations, and reimbursements for GCI leadership and GCI guest speakers, applying RIT policies and procedures, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring accurate and timely completion.
  • Independently manage complex calendars and meeting requests for GCI leadership, primarily the Executive Director of the GCI and the Director of the Cyber Range and Training Center; assess competing priorities, resolve scheduling conflicts, and coordinate arrangements with internal and external participants.

Administrative Support:

  • Coordinate adjunct and student hiring for the GCI SAFE Lab and the GCI training center in accordance with RIT policies, independently tracking required documentation, monitoring process completion, resolving routine issues, and escalating exceptions as appropriate.
  • Onboard student employees to ensure they have necessary information regarding employment policies
  • Manage student employee timecards
  • Administer and track GCI faculty affiliations, monitor renewal timelines, verify required information, coordinate follow-up with faculty and stakeholders, and resolve discrepancies to maintain accurate affiliation records.
  • Keep faculty and graduate student mailing lists up to date.
  • Work with GCCIS Marketing & Communications Team to keep the information about current faculty and projects on GCI website up to date.
  • Provide administrative support to 60 GCI affiliated faculty in their use of GCI awarded financial support, coordinate with GCCIS IT and the college's financial team to procure equipment/services, hire student workers and process travel-related expenses.
  • Oversee any generic incoming inquiries by email, post-mail, in-person and redirection to GCI by independently assessing and prioritizing inquiries, responding within established guidelines, coordinating input from or routing to appropriate subject-matter experts, and tracking complex or sensitive matters through resolution.
  • Coordinate Ph.D. student workstation assignments by assessing space availability and program needs, resolving assignment conflicts, maintaining accurate records, and administering mailing lists for GCI-affiliated Ph.D. students. Assist with the administrative process of onboarding for the GCI Cybersecurity Clinic including soliciting, qualifying and contracting of new clients and projects.

Event Support:

  • Independently administer conference room and Cyber Range reservations through RIT's Event Management System; evaluate requests against space requirements, schedules, and established guidelines; resolve conflicts and non-routine issues; and coordinate exceptions with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Develop, document, and maintain procedures for use of GCI event spaces in alignment with RIT requirements; communicate expectations to requesting groups, interpret guidelines, and address exceptions or recurring operational issues.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for external entities renting GCI event spaces; assess event requirements, coordinate available services and resources, resolve routine and non-routine issues, and escalate matters outside established authority.
  • Independently coordinate comprehensive logistical support for GCI or CSEC hosted events, including space reservations, catering and hospitality procurement, parking, guest travel, and related services; monitor timelines and budgets, verify requirements, and resolve issues to support successful delivery.
  • Collaborate with the Advancement team and internal partners to coordinate prospective donor visits and corporate engagement days; assess logistical and program needs, develop event plans, and manage follow-through across participating units.
  • Plan and conduct tours for prospective students, corporate partners, internal stakeholders, and K -12 programs; assess constituent interests, tailor content and logistics, coordinate demonstrations with the Cyber Range Director, and adjust plans to address changing needs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Ensures the smooth operation of day-to-day office tasks by coordinating with other departments and assisting with various administrative functions as needed
  • Handles front desk activities by greeting visitors, answering phones, and providing customer support. Serves as the 1st point of contact for assigned area
  • Coordinates and manages calendars, scheduling appointments, interviews, travel, and events. Assisting with or coordinating the preparation/ turnover of meeting space or work/ desk space
  • Prepares and distributes communications, including emails, memos, and reports, to various internal and external stakeholders
  • Handles documents, files, and records, ensuring proper filing systems. Secures sensitive and confidential records. Collects data, maintains database records, and assists with data analysis as needed
  • Manages office supplies, track inventory, and coordinate purchasing to maintain adequate resources for office operations
  • Assists with HR-related functions, including employee hiring, onboarding, and payroll processing, ensuring adherence to institutional policies
  • Processes expense reports, recording and receipting payments, creating invoices, and monitoring budgets. Provides purchasing support and p-card processes. Supports budget tracking, assisting with financial record-keeping and ensuring compliance with departmental budget guidelines
  • Coordinates and assist with event planning and logistical support for meetings, conferences, and other departmental activities
  • Assists in the preparation and organization of documents, presentations, and reports, ensuring they are accurate and timely
  • Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Knowledge of administrative processes, including supply ordering, inventory tracking, and facilities management
  • Knowledge of human resources practices, including onboarding, payroll processing, and employee records management
  • Skill in scheduling, organizing, and coordinating meetings, appointments, and events for multiple stakeholders
  • Skill in handling and processing invoices, purchase orders, and expense reports with attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders, addressing inquiries and providing assistance
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, ensuring compliance with organizational and legal privacy standards

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Associate's degree in related field
  • 5 years of related experience
  • Equivalent combination of experience and education may be considered

Job Level Overview

Operations, Administrative, Service, or Technical Support Level 3 - Senior level role with considerable knowledge and skills. Performs complex tasks and project work. Work is typically not routine and requires troubleshooting and analysis. Mentors or guides less experienced staff.

Non-Exempt

title: Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Successful projects are not delivered by one function alone. They depend on bringing together customers, engineers, manufacturing teams, supply chain, quality, finance, and other specialists around the same priorities. As a Project Manager in NOV’s Subsea Production Systems (SPS) business, you will be the person who makes that happen.

You will lead complex international customer projects from contract handover through execution and close-out, ensuring they are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in line with contractual requirements and NOV’s business objectives.

Working in a matrix organization, you will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and other supporting functions. As these teams will not report directly to you, your ability to communicate effectively, build alignment, and influence across functions will be key to your success.

You will also serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution. We are looking for a Project Manager who is self-motivated, commercially aware, and confident taking ownership while building strong relationships with customers and colleagues alike.

About NOV

NOV is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced flexible pipe systems for demanding offshore energy applications. With manufacturing facilities in Denmark and Brazil and a global engineering and project organization, we combine technical expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined project execution to deliver high-quality solutions to customers around the world.

What We Offer

The opportunity to lead complex international customer projects from contract handover through successful delivery and close-out. Exposure to advanced flexible pipe technology and challenging offshore energy projects. A collaborative, multidisciplinary environment where you will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and other functions. Support and mentoring from experienced Project Managers as you develop your knowledge of NOV SPS products, processes, and customers. Direct interaction with international customers and opportunities to strengthen your commercial, leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities. Professional development and career progression opportunities within Project Management and the wider NOV organization.

  • Lead customer projects through all phases of execution, from contract handover to project close-out.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, opportunities, and changes throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Develop and execute project strategies that balance customer expectations, contractual commitments, commercial performance, and NOV business objectives.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and other supporting functions.
  • Build trusted customer relationships and act as a key point of contact throughout project execution.
  • Drive collaboration and resource alignment across a matrix organization, influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Drive project performance, provide accurate reporting, and implement corrective or recovery actions when required.
  • Manage commercial and contractual activities, including forecasting, variation orders, claims, and risk management.
  • Ensure projects are executed in accordance with NOV’s quality and HSE requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the Project Management organization.
  • Travel internationally as required to support customers and project execution.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, a technical discipline, Business, Commercial Studies, or a related field.
  • Around 5–7 years of relevant professional experience, including experience in a project management or operations-based role.
  • Experience managing customer projects within engineering, manufacturing, energy, offshore, EPC, construction, renewables, or a comparable industrial environment.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and resources in a matrix organization.
  • Solid understanding of project delivery, including schedule, cost, risk, change, and commercial management.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence across different functions.
  • Self-motivated, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of projects and driving actions forward.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to work effectively with international customers and colleagues.

Preferred

  • Experience within the oil & gas or offshore industry, particularly with complex engineering, construction, manufacturing, or customer projects.
  • Experience with commercial management and contract administration.
  • Experience with project management systems such as Oracle, Primavera P6, Unifier, or equivalent tools.
  • Professional project management certification such as PMI, IPMA, or an equivalent certification.

Why Join Us?

At NOV, Project Managers play a central role in bringing together customers, technology, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex projects successfully. You will have the opportunity to take real ownership while working alongside experienced colleagues who will support your continued professional development.

If you are passionate about bringing people together, navigating complex project challenges, and driving project execution from contract handover through successful delivery, we would like to hear from you.

title: Documentation Assistant

You will support production units by preparing documentation packages for use during manufacturing and assembly, collecting and managing completed documentation, and finalizing packages for customer delivery. This role may involve direct interaction with customers and their representatives.

This is a one-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension depending on the level of project activity and workload.

About the Company

At NOV, we deliver safe, high-quality, technology-driven equipment, services, and support that are essential to the global energy industry. Our mission is simple: we power the industry that powers the world.

At NOV’s business unit Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we empower the energy sector with passion, expertise, and forward-thinking solutions. We develop reliable and efficient subsea energy production products that enhance our customers’ energy portfolios. With strong roots in the offshore oil and gas industry, we are also at the forefront of future technologies such as water treatment, ammonia storage, carbon injection, and wind energy—helping to reduce CO₂ emissions and drive the energy transition.

SPS is headquartered in Brøndby, Denmark, with production sites in Kalundborg (DK), Porto do Acu (BR), and Glenrothes (UK), and offices in Stavanger and Oslo (NO), Rio de Janeiro (BR), and Houston (US). Globally, our team includes around 1,500 dedicated professionals, contributing to NOV’s workforce of approximately 34,000 employees.

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities to grow your expertise in documentation and quality assurance.
  • Exposure to advanced production and customer-facing processes.

Why Join Us?

Join us to be part of a collaborative team shaping the future of subsea energy products and solutions.

We offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment where growth, innovative thinking, and continuous improvement are core to how we operate. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally through diverse and challenging assignments, supported by experienced colleagues and a culture that values learning and development.

Joining NOV means becoming part of a purpose-driven organization committed to operational excellence, sustainability, and long-term development.

With us at NOV Subsea Production Systems, you’ll have an important role in delivering reliable and efficient subsea solutions, meeting today’s energy demands and shaping a more sustainable future.

Join us in going beyond to shape the future of energy. Because energy matters.

Soft Skills

title: Patient Services Coordinator
description:
Benefits:
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k)
  • Employee discounts
Employment type: Full-Time, On-Site (W2) | Location: Park City, UT | Reports to: Practice Manager
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:30am - 5:30pm

Who You Are
You are organized, responsive, and good with people, not just in person, but in writing. You can respond to a patient's worried email with warmth and clarity, triage a Zendesk ticket without losing track of five others, and make sure a lab result gets where it needs to go before anyone has to follow up twice.

You have worked in a patient-facing or customer-facing role and you know what it feels like when communication falls through the cracks. You do not let that happen. You are the kind of person who closes the loop, documents what happened, and moves to the next thing without being reminded.

You are comfortable with technology. You pick up new platforms quickly. You do not need someone to hold your hand through a software system — you explore it, figure it out, and build a rhythm. You understand that a clinical practice runs on communication and documentation just as much as it runs on procedures, and you take your piece of that seriously.

What you are tired of: jobs where the bar for responsiveness is low, where nobody notices when something slips, and where the work feels disconnected from anything meaningful. You want to work somewhere that takes patient experience seriously and trusts you to be a real part of making it happen.

About bVital
bVital is a regenerative medicine and brain health clinic in Park City, Utah. We work with patients navigating serious neurological conditions, chronic illness, and performance decline, people who are invested in their outcomes and expect a high level of care and communication. Our clinical team delivers advanced therapies and complex protocols. The communication and coordination work that supports that team is just as important as what happens in the treatment room. That is where this role lives.

The Role
This is a digital-first, communication-heavy support role that sits at the intersection of patient services, clinical coordination, and administrative operations. You are not the primary patient-facing presence in the treatment room, that is the clinical MA team. You are the person who makes sure everything else gets handled: the questions that come in through the portal, the labs that need uploading, the tickets in Zendesk, the messages that need a response before end of day.

You work closely with the clinical MA team, providers, and customer service team and concierges, serving as a key liaison between patients who have questions and the clinical team who has answers. You surface what needs attention, route it to the right person, and follow through until it is resolved.

Patient Communication
  • Respond to patient messages, emails, and portal inquiries with accuracy, warmth, and same-day turnaround.
  • Handle inbound patient calls: answer questions, route clinical inquiries to the appropriate provider or MA, and document every interaction.
  • Manage the Zendesk ticket queue: triage, respond, escalate, and close tickets with consistent follow-through.
Lab and Records Management
  • Upload lab results and patient records into Cerbo promptly and accurately.
  • Monitor the labs inbox and ensure results are routed to the correct patient file and flagged for
  • provider review when needed.
  • Send lab results and other clinical communications to patients as directed by providers.
Clinical Coordination Support
  • Act as a liaison between patients and the clinical team for non-urgent medical questions coming through the patient concierge — gathering context, addressing with the right provider or MA, and communicating the response back to the patient.
  • Support the clinical MA team with backend digital tasks that fall outside their patient care capacity.
  • Complete Cerbo tasks within 24 hours and maintain documentation standards across all patient communication.
Who Thrives Here
Must-haves:
  • Experience in a patient-facing, medical office, or customer service role — you understand what professional, empathetic communication looks like in a healthcare context
  • Comfort managing multiple communication channels simultaneously: email, phone, portal messages, and a ticketing system
  • Strong written communication skills — your emails and messages are clear, warm, and free of errors
  • EMR or health tech experience; Cerbo and Zendesk familiarity are a plus but not required
  • Reliable documentation habits — you record what happened and you do it the same day
Bonus points:
  • Background in medical office administration, medical assistant, patient services, or healthcare coordination
  • Experience with Zendesk, Cerbo, or similar ticketing and EMR platforms
  • Familiarity with lab result workflows or HIPAA-compliant communication standards
You thrive here if...
  • Staying on top of a busy communication queue feels satisfying, not overwhelming.
  • You can match your tone to the patient — clinical and precise when needed, warm and reassuring when that is what someone needs.
  • You follow through without being followed up with. Tasks do not sit in your queue waiting for a reminder.
This is not the right fit if...
  • You prefer in-person, hands-on patient care work. This role is digital-first and primarily behind the scenes.
  • Written communication is not a strength. A significant portion of this job is responding to patient messages in writing, and the quality of that communication reflects directly on the practice.
  • You need a slow or low-volume day to stay organized. This role has consistent daily volume across multiple channels.

How You'll Be Measured
1. Response time and follow-through — patient messages and Zendesk tickets handled same-day, nothing left open without a status
2. Documentation accuracy — lab uploads, Cerbo tasks, and patient records completed correctly and on time
3. Communication quality — patient interactions are clear, professional, and appropriately warm
4. Team reliability — the clinical MA team and providers can count on you to handle your piece without reminders

title: Senior Lifting Engineer
description:
PURPOSE OF JOB: The Lifting / Rigging Methods Engineer is responsible for developing, reviewing, and supporting safe and practical lifting, rigging, transportation, and installation methods for project operations. The role ensures that all lifting activities are properly engineered, planned, risk assessed, documented, and executed in accordance with project requirements, applicable regulations, company procedures, and recognized industry standards.

MAIN DUTIES: Method Statements and Work Packs

  • Prepare detailed method statements, rigging sketches, lift plans, task risk assessments, and job execution packs.
  • Ensure lifting procedures clearly define sequence of work, equipment requirements, personnel roles, communication methods, exclusion zones, hold points, and emergency arrangements.
  • Coordinate with construction, fabrication, marine, logistics, HSE, QA/QC, and operations teams to align the lifting method with site conditions and project schedule.
  • Support constructability reviews and provide practical engineering solutions for lifting, handling, and installation challenges.
  • Capture lessons learned and record into NOV’s Lessons Learned.

  • Provide MTOs for the required materials.

    Site Support and Execution

  • Provide technical support during lifting operations, including pre-lift checks, toolbox talks, site inspections, and verification of rigging arrangements.
  • Confirm that cranes, lifting appliances, rigging gear, lifting accessories, and temporary structures are certified and suitable for use.
  • Monitor critical lifts and ensure the approved lifting plan is followed during execution.
  • Assist in resolving site issues related to access, equipment positioning, lifting clearances, ground conditions, obstructions, and interface conflicts.
  • In Fabrication Construction Support Engineering, perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as , stackings, roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Ensure lifting plans comply with applicable standards, local regulations, company lifting procedures, and project HSE requirements.
  • Participate in HAZOP, JSA, SIMOPS, and constructability reviews related to lifting and rigging activities.
  • Identify hazards associated with lifting operations and define appropriate mitigation measures.
  • Ensure engineered lifts are reviewed and approved by the HSE PMT departments
  • Promote a strong safety culture and stop work where unsafe conditions or deviations from the approved plan are identified.

Documentation and Technical Review

  • Review vendor and subcontractor lifting plans, rigging studies, transport drawings, and installation procedures.
  • Maintain proper records of calculations, drawings, lift plans, approvals, inspection certificates, and close-out documentation.
  • Prepare as built or post-lift reports when required.
  • Support lessons learned reviews and contributed to continuous improvement of lifting and rigging practices.

Key Competencies

  • Strong safety mindset and attention to detail.
  • Practical problem-solving ability.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and support site execution.
  • Strong planning organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to challenge unsafe practices and ensure compliance with approved procedures.

Team-oriented approach with the ability to work across engineering, construction, HSE, and operations teams

Authority and Accountability

The Lifting / Rigging Methods Engineer is accountable for ensuring lifting methods are technically sound, properly documented, risk assessed, and suitable for safe execution. The role has the authority to recommend changes to lifting methods and to stop or escalate any lifting operation that does not comply with the approved plan or presents an unacceptable safety risk.

RESPONSIBILITY: Lifting and Rigging Engineering

  • Develop lifting plans, rigging studies, method statements, and execution procedures for routine, complex, and critical lifting operations.
  • Prepare and review lifting calculations, including crane capacity checks, rigging loads, sling angles, centre of gravity, pad eye/lug checks, spreader beam loads, ground bearing pressure, and load distribution.
  • Select suitable lifting equipment, including cranes, slings, shackles, spreader beams, lifting beams, chain blocks, winches, skidding systems, jacks, and temporary support arrangements.
  • Review drawings, load data, structural details, and site conditions to confirm lifting feasibility.
  • Identify lifting points, rigging configurations, and engineered controls required for safe execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architect, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant Heavy lifting and rigging engineering experience in construction, oil and gas, marine, fabrication sector
  • Formal training or certification in lifting operations, rigging planning, appointed person duties, or crane/lifting supervision is preferred.
  • Knowledge of crane operations, rigging equipment, lifting accessories, temporary works, and heavy transport methods.
  • Preferably Registered Engineer in Training (ElT) or member of a professional engineering society.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5 YEARS Experience preparing lift plans, rigging studies, method statements, and lifting calculations.
  • Minimum 5 YEARS Experience with mobile cranes, crawler cranes, overhead cranes, gantry systems, jack-up/skidding systems, and heavy load handling.
  • Min 5 YEARS Experience working with critical lifts, tandem lifts, Multiple crane lifts (more than 2) heavy module construction installation is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with crane load charts, rigging drawings, lifting equipment certificates, and site execution requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Ability to calculate sling loads, crane utilization, lifting beam forces, center of gravity, ground bearing pressure, and load stability.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, rigging drawings, and crane load charts.
  • Knowledge of relevant lifting standards and good industry practices.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar drawing software is preferred.
  • Knowledge of lift planning software, crane planning tools, or 3D model review software is an advantage (preferable SACS)
  • Good technical writing skills for method statements, procedures, and reports.
  • Familiar with the content and application of international standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable.
