title: DBS Project Manager
description:
About the Role

As a Project Manager within NOV Digital Services, you will be responsible for delivering customer projects involving Downhole Broadband Solutions and Wired Drill Pipe technology. Acting as the single point of contact for assigned customers, you will manage projects throughout their lifecycle, coordinating offshore operations, internal stakeholders and customer expectations to ensure successful delivery.

You will work closely with field engineers, project coordinators, operations, HSE, service quality, engineering and commercial teams to deliver safe, reliable and commercially successful projects. The role combines technical understanding of drilling operations with strong project management, customer engagement and stakeholder management skills.

About NOV Digital Services

NOV Digital Services is part of NOV's Energy Products & Services segment and delivers advanced digital technologies that improve drilling performance through real-time downhole data. Using Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) and Along-String Measurement (ASM) technologies, NOV enables customers to access high-speed downhole information that supports safer, more efficient and better-informed drilling operations.

As demand for these technologies continues to grow, we are expanding our project management team to support an increasing number of customer projects worldwide.

Why This Role Matters

This position plays a key role in ensuring customers receive high-quality project delivery while strengthening long-term customer relationships. Success in this role directly contributes to operational excellence, customer satisfaction and continued business growth.

What We Offer

At NOV, you'll join an international team developing technology that is transforming offshore drilling operations. We offer:

  • The opportunity to work with industry-leading digital drilling technology.
  • Long-term career opportunities within a growing business.
  • A collaborative and supportive international environment.
  • High levels of autonomy and ownership.
  • Flexible working arrangements where operationally appropriate.
  • Career development opportunities across Project Management, Operations, Sales and Digital Solutions.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

#LI-ZS1

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers throughout project execution.
  • Lead the technical, operational and commercial delivery of Downhole Broadband Solutions and Wired Drill Pipe projects.
  • Coordinate offshore operations, including personnel, equipment and logistics.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, drilling contractors and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with field engineers and provide guidance to ensure high-quality project execution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities with Operations, Engineering, HSE, Service Quality, Sales and other NOV business units.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience in drilling, well construction, or offshore operations.
  • Proven project management experience in the oil and gas industry.
  • Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the Norwegian and/or UK offshore industry.
  • Knowledge of completion operations.
  • Experience with digital drilling technologies, Wired Drill Pipe (WDP), or similar drilling systems.
  • Norwegian language skills.

title: NDT Development Engineer – UT/PAUT & Electromagnetic Inspection
description:
NOV is seeking an NDT Development Engineer to support the development, testing, validation, and continuous improvement of nondestructive inspection technologies used in steel and tubular-product applications.
This is a hands-on engineering and technology-development position for someone with experience applying ultrasonic and electromagnetic NDT methods to detect flaws in steel, combined with a strong engineering or physics foundation.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, evaluate, validate, and improve NDT inspection technologies for steel, steel pipe, tubular and related metallic products.
  • Apply Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), and Electromagnetic Inspection (EMI) to real-world flaw-detection problems.
  • Perform or support direct flaw detection in steel, including solid or hollow steel components and steel pipe.
  • Develop and optimize inspection techniques, scan plans, procedures, calibration methods, and inspection parameters.
  • Analyze ultrasonic and electromagnetic inspection data to characterize defects and improve detection capability.
  • Support laboratory and production testing of NDT equipment, probes, sensors, transducers, electronics, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Investigate inspection-system performance, sensitivity, repeatability, false calls, and defect detectability.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues involving NDT equipment, instrumentation, acquisition systems, and inspection processes.
  • Apply physics, materials, mechanical, electrical, and mathematical principles to solve NDT problems.
  • Support development and validation of NDE systems and inspection components from concept through implementation.
  • Perform analytical and experimental studies and document findings through engineering reports, technical procedures, and recommendations.
  • Work with engineering, manufacturing, software, quality, and operations teams to implement inspection improvements.
  • Use programming, simulation, modeling, signal processing, or data-analysis tools to support technology development.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience preferred; consideration may be given to candidates outside this range when the technical background is highly relevant.
  • Hands-on experience in Nondestructive Testing / Nondestructive Evaluation.
  • Experience with Ultrasonic Testing (UT).
  • Experience with Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT).
  • Experience with Electromagnetic Inspection (EMI) or closely related electromagnetic NDT technologies such as Eddy Current, MFL, EMAT, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience with flaw detection in steel, preferably steel pipe, tubular products, or comparable solid/hollow steel components.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials/Metallurgical Engineering, Mathematics with relevant NDT specialization, or a related technical field.
  • Strong engineering problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work hands-on with inspection equipment, instrumentation, and experimental systems.

  • Strong technical communication and documentation skills.

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with tubular products, OCTG, steel mills, pipe manufacturing, aerospace metal inspection, railroad inspection, or other steel inspection applications.
  • Experience developing or validating NDT inspection systems or inspection methodologies.
  • Experience with signal processing, image processing, data acquisition, sensors, probes, transducers, or instrumentation.
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, C/C++, C#, LabVIEW, or similar tools.
  • Experience with finite-element modeling or simulation, particularly involving ultrasound or electromagnetism.
  • Experience with defect characterization, probability of detection, inspection sensitivity, calibration, or system validation.
  • Familiarity with ASNT, ASTM, ASME, API, or comparable NDT standards.
  • Research, product development, advanced manufacturing, or laboratory experimentation experience.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Fisheries & Water Resources
description:
ICF’s Fish and Aquatic Science and Technology Team is in an exciting period of expansion and invites applications for a Senior Data Scientist position. The Senior Data Scientist will work closely with fish biologists, hydrologists, and project managers to assist water resource clients with quantitative analysis, decision support modeling, and publication of applied science. Most immediate assignments will focus on statistical and decision support modeling and publishing work on Chinook Salmon in California’s Central Valley, though there will be opportunities for future work in other regions. Generally, the Senior Data Scientist will manage data and conduct scientific analysis, develop and maintain models and data pipelines, and contribute to proposal writing, study planning, fieldwork, and final deliverables, including report and manuscript preparation.


This position is available in San Francisco, CA, with the flexibility to work remotely.


The successful applicant will demonstrate the following:

  • Fish Data Expertise with knowledge of and experience with key issues confronting fish management in Northern California, including Chinook Salmon population dynamics, endangered species recovery, habitat restoration, flow management, and monitoring program design.
  • Water Management Expertise with knowledge of and experience with key issues confronting water management in California, including reservoir and conveyance operations, water supply and allocation, environmental flows, and drought and flood management. Ability to understand and interpret water operations, hydrologic and hydraulic information, and their implications for fish populations, habitat, and management decisions. Familiarity with California water policy and the legislative process.
  • Quantitative and Problem-Solving Expertise: Knowledge and aptitude for quantitative analysis to evaluate the effects of clients’ proposed actions; ability to design and apply sophisticated, robust, and creative analytical approaches, including hierarchical and Bayesian statistical models and machine learning; ability to interpret hydrologic, hydraulic, and telemetry modeling outputs and integrate them into fish population and decision-support models; ability to conduct and interpret advanced statistical analyses; and proficiency in R, Python, and SQL.
  • Open and Reproducible Data Science: Demonstrated ability to design and implement transparent, reproducible, and collaborative scientific workflows consistent with U.S. federal Open Science and Open Data expectations. Experience developing documented, version-controlled analytical workflows; maintaining clear data provenance; automating data processing, analysis, and reporting; and producing reusable data, code, and analytical products. Ability to establish shared workflows and documentation that facilitate collaboration, scientific review, knowledge transfer, and reuse across interdisciplinary teams and agency partners.
  • Excellent Verbal and Written Communication Skills: Peer-reviewed scientific publication record and experience presenting at professional conferences. Strong ability to accurately and effectively translate scientific findings to inform policy recommendations in workshops and structured decision-making processes.
  • Ability to express results of analyses to technical and non-technical audiences, including multi-agency stakeholder groups, through technical reports, presentations, and interactive data visualization tools (e.g., R Shiny applications), sometimes in stressful and contentious settings.
  • Project Management Skills: Ability to manage several simultaneous long-term projects, including budget tracking, staff coordination, client relationship management, and completion of all required products/reports.
  • Team Leadership Skills: Demonstrated track record of setting high personal performance and quality standards and enabling the team to be successful; viewing all team members as critical and treating team members with respect and professionalism; collaborating and leveraging team member strengths; and mentoring/developing junior team members, including through code review and documentation practices.
  • Science-Business Balance: Expertise and passion for science, natural resources, and resolving complex fish problems while balancing the need for business acumen, marketing, and expansion opportunities.


Specific job duties will include:

  • Conducting analyses and leading or assisting with writing scientific documents, technical reports, and peer-reviewed manuscripts for fish-related projects
  • Developing, updating, and documenting statistical, population, and decision support models for fish and water resource management (e.g., Chinook Salmon recovery and flow decisions)
  • Building and maintaining reproducible codebases and automated data pipelines that connect monitoring data to models
  • Meeting with water resource clients to discuss technical aspects of planning, implementation, and monitoring of fish and water resource management projects
  • Describing projects and interpretation of analyses through written and oral communication and interactive visualizations to a broad audience, sometimes in contentious environments
  • Conducting scientific research leading to develop of knowledge to inform resource management.
  • Working with a team of technical staff from multiple disciplines to complete analyses and documentation on time and within budget
  • Developing scope and budget and writing proposals
  • Building and maintaining client relationships
  • Mentoring junior biologists


Education/Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in fisheries biology, fisheries and wildlife, quantitative ecology, or equivalent science-related field or
  • 5 years of increasingly complex assignments in fish data science


Additional Desired Qualifications

  • Ability to demonstrate expert-level integration of complex data sets to facilitate analyses
  • Demonstrated expertise in quantitative fish science field
  • Experience conducting scientific research using fisheries expertise
  • Peer-reviewed publication record in quantitative fisheries science
  • Experience applying hierarchical or Bayesian modeling tools (e.g., Stan, Template Model Builder) to fisheries data
  • Experience supporting structured decision making for California water and fish management

title: Automation Supporter (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you will be an integral part of our manufacturing organization, ensuring the reliability, safety, and continuous improvement of our production equipment. This is a practical engineering role where you'll combine electrical expertise with automation knowledge to support day-to-day operations while contributing to larger machine upgrade and modernization projects.

Working alongside experienced electricians, technicians, and external automation specialists, you'll help maintain and develop the electrical and control systems that support our manufacturing processes. Your work will directly contribute to improved equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and workplace safety.

About NOV Subsea Production Systems

At NOV, we deliver safe, high-quality, technology-driven equipment, services, and support that are critical to the global energy industry. Our mission is simple: we power the industry that powers the world.

Within Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we design and manufacture reliable subsea technologies that support offshore energy production worldwide. Building on decades of experience in the offshore oil and gas industry, we are also helping shape the future of energy through technologies supporting water treatment, ammonia storage, CO₂ injection, and offshore wind—contributing to a more sustainable energy future.

SPS is headquartered in Brøndby, Denmark, with manufacturing facilities in Kalundborg (Denmark), Porto do Açu (Brazil), and Glenrothes (United Kingdom), as well as offices in Stavanger and Oslo (Norway), Rio de Janeiro (Brazil), and Houston, USA. Together, approximately 1,500 colleagues are part of NOV's global workforce of around 34,000 employees.

What We Offer

At NOV, you'll join a technically strong manufacturing environment where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

We offer:

  • An exciting and varied engineering role close to production

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Close collaboration with experienced electricians, engineers, and external specialists

  • Hands-on work with modern Siemens automation and drive systems

  • A collaborative and supportive team environment with a strong safety culture

  • Competitive salary and employment terms based on your qualifications

  • A permanent position with flexible working hours

At NOV, you'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact while building a long-term career in a global technology company.

  • Support electricians in troubleshooting and resolving electrical and automation issues on production machinery and equipment

  • Perform fault finding, diagnostics, and root cause analysis to improve machine reliability

  • Develop and modify PLC and HMI programs for production equipment

  • Identify suitable replacement components for obsolete electrical and automation equipment

  • Participate in machine modification, upgrade, and retrofit projects in collaboration with external automation partners

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation performance, reliability, and machine safety

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, electrical drawings, and engineering records

  • Ensure electrical systems comply with applicable safety standards and internal engineering practices

  • Collaborate with production, maintenance, engineering, and external suppliers to deliver effective technical solutions

Essential Qualifications

title: Principal AI Transformation Consultant, CoCounsel
description:
Job Description

Principal AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services

Focus: AI Transformation Services for CoCounsel and Thomson Reuters solutions

Many in-house legal, tax, and trade teams now have access to AI. The harder question is what changes because of it: which work gets redesigned, what good looks like, what guardrails the work needs, and how leaders will know it is working.

As a Principal AI Transformation Consultant, you will help senior leaders answer those questions for the workflows that matter most, then lead the change and measure what it delivers — with CoCounsel Legal and CoCounsel for Tax and Trade at the center. You’ll work embedded with client teams, alongside Sales, our AI engineers, enablement specialists, and product teams, from the first client conversation through rollout and measured value.

Key Responsibilities:

In this opportunity as Principal AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services, you will:

· Lead complex transformation engagements from discovery and value hypothesis through workflow redesign where needed, proof of value adoption, and value realization.

· Advise senior leaders on priority AI-enabled workflows and the targeted changes to roles, skills, practices, controls, and ways of working needed to scale them.

· Shape transformation opportunities from early customer discovery through delivery planning, defining achievable outcomes, scope, approach, estimates, and statements of work with Sales and specialist teams.

· Own the hardest calls on your engagements: the approach when the path is unclear, the tradeoffs when stakeholders disagree, and the commitments we make to the customer on scope and outcomes.

· Set the adoption and activation strategy; diagnose and recover stalled or declining adoption, including barriers in workflow fit, confidence, risk, or customer ownership.

· Establish value hypotheses, baselines, measures, and evidence standards so customer-facing value claims match what the data supports.

· Work shoulder to shoulder with forward deployed AI engineers as they build against the customer’s real systems and data, shaping what gets built and turning technical possibility into workflow change that holds up in practice.

· Bring adoption, enablement, product, and customer-success specialists into one outcome; coach consultants on complex work; and turn field learning into reusable methods and value frameworks.

Required Qualifications:

You’re a fit for the Principal AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services role if you have:

· Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Organizational Transformation, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

· 10+ years in professional services, management consulting, transformation consulting, or complex AI or enterprise-technology delivery.

· Experience leading complex workflow redesign, targeted operating changes, technology-enabled adoption, and measurable customer outcomes.

· Ability to advise executives, structure ambiguity, facilitate difficult decisions, challenge assumptions, and translate strategy into practical plans.

· Commercial judgment in shaping opportunities, scoping work, estimating effort, and delivering against what was promised.

· Analytical ability to combine usage, survey, operational, and stakeholder evidence into defensible recommendations and value measures.

· Experience in legal, tax, trade, risk, compliance, or another complex regulated knowledge-work domain.

· Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, change and adoption, responsible-use considerations, and cross-functional delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Experience with CoCounsel or other Thomson Reuters AI solutions and professional workflows.

· Experience building consulting methods, playbooks, assessments, value frameworks, or service offerings.

· Relevant change, process-improvement, project-management, or responsible-AI certification.

title: Principal Clinical Database Programmer - eCOA
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Join Parexel as a Principal Database Programmer – eCOA (eCOA Study Designer), a fully home-based opportunity open to candidates across the UK!


Picture Yourself at Parexel:


The Principal Database Programmer – eCOA (eCOA Study Designer) provides technical expertise for the design, configuration, testing, deployment and maintenance of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions used in clinical trials. The role translates protocol, assessment and operational requirements into compliant participant, caregiver and clinician facing questionnaires, schedules and workflows within approved eCOA technologies. The eCOA Study Designer works independently across multiple projects, collaborates with sponsors and cross-functional study teams, and supports integration of eCOA configurations with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.


What You'll Do At Parexel:


Design, Set Up, Maintain, Revise and Close Out eCOA Studies:


  • Interpret protocols, schedules of assessments, eCOA specifications and licensed instrument requirements to design appropriate electronic data collection workflows.
  • Configure questionnaires, screens, field properties, code lists, schedules, activities, completion settings, branching logic, rules, reminders, alerts, notifications and study settings in the approved eCOA platform.
  • Apply established naming conventions and build standards, including clear identification of eCOA-specific forms, fields and code lists.
  • Coordinate the initial eCOA configuration and controlled push to EDC; maintain alignment among the eCOA configuration, EDC draft and applicable CRF versions.
  • Assess and implement approved protocol amendments, production revisions, translations and study maintenance changes while protecting data integrity and traceability.

Testing, Validation and Deployment:


  • Perform technical quality control of eCOA configurations against approved specifications, including screens, questionnaire workflows, rules, notifications and schedules.
  • Prepare system demonstrations, test evidence, questionnaire screenshots and other materials required for internal review and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Support pre-UAT meetings, UAT execution, defect triage and resolution; ensure issues are documented in the approved study issue-tracking process.
  • Coordinate deployment readiness and communicate completion of technical quality control and UAT prerequisites to applicable stakeholders.
  • Support post-production troubleshooting and controlled implementation of approved corrections.

Project and Stakeholder Support:


  • Collaborate with Clinical Database Programming, Data Management, eCOA Clinical Data Analysis, COA Science, Clinical Operations, and other study functions to finalize eCOA requirements and resolve design issues.
  • Lead or participate in recurring design and build meetings, provide configuration status, identify risks and dependencies, and escalate issues when required.
  • Interact with sponsors and vendors as a technical contact for eCOA design, specification, testing and deployment topics, as assigned.
  • Provide input to study timelines, monitor assigned work and communicate changes in scope, assumptions or resourcing needs.
  • Provide technical advice to internal project teams and support multiple projects simultaneously.

Documentation and Compliance:


  • Create and maintain eCOA specifications, configuration records, implementation checklists, test evidence, screenshots, issue records, version documentation, and other required study artifacts.
  • Maintain study documentation in accordance with SOPs, Work Instructions, and guidelines to support traceability, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Document deviations, decisions, risks, and configuration limitations and communicate them to the appropriate project stakeholders.
  • Follow system life cycle, access control, change control, validation and records-management requirements.

Support Technologies, Standards and Continuous Improvement:


  • Provide technical solutions to internal and external client inquiries relating to eCOA study design and its interaction with EDC and other clinical systems.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of standards, reusable libraries, templates, checklists, tools and processes that improve eCOA delivery quality and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring defects or process gaps, contribute to root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective or preventive improvements.
  • Act as a Trainer and/or Subject Matter Expert:
  • Provide role-relevant training, coaching, and technical guidance to project teams and less-experienced study designers, as appropriate.
  • Assist project teams in resolving complex configuration, workflow, and integration issues.

Support Business Development:


  • Provide technical input to proposals, assumptions, effort estimates, client presentations, and bid-defense meetings, as requested.

Required Experience, Knowledge, and Skills:


  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, computer science, health informatics, clinical research or a related discipline.
  • Written and oral fluency in English.
  • Proven experience with eCOA, ePRO, eDiary is required.
  • Strong clinical research industry experience (CRO/Pharma) is required.
  • Hands-on experience configuring an eCOA platform such as Medidata Designer eCOA, or comparable study-design technology, is preferred.
  • Knowledge of questionnaire design, schedules, branching logic, reminders, notifications, translations, version management, and participant workflows.
  • Experience with EDC systems, preferably Medidata Rave, and understanding of eCOA-to-EDC configuration dependencies and data flow.
  • Knowledge of SOPs, Work Instructions, system life-cycle methodologies, ICH-GCP, 21 CFR Part 11 and other applicable local and international regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with technical quality control, UAT, defect management, change control and validated clinical systems.
  • Experience supporting global studies, sponsors, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Strong ability to collaborate with global, cross-functional teams and work independently across multiple time zones and cultures.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to interpret clinical protocols, schedules of assessments, questionnaires and technical specifications and translate them into system configurations.
  • Proven problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis, risk identification and decision-making in ambiguous situations.
  • Customer focus and the ability to interact professionally with sponsors, vendors and internal colleagues.
  • Proficient presentation and system-demonstration skills.

Job Description:

Job Title: Baker

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our bakery is a destination for customers who expect freshness, quality, and something that feels homemade. As a Baker, you'll be responsible for preparing and baking the products that fill our cases and fulfill our customers' orders every day. From proofing and frying to pulling from the freezer and leading bakery clerks, your skill and attention to detail directly shape the quality our customers experience.

If you take pride in your craft, thrive in a fast-paced kitchen environment, and enjoy being part of a hardworking team, we'd love to have you on board.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile and assisting them with their needs throughout the store

  • Check orders for the day and set up a timeline and production schedule, prioritizing special and future orders as needed

  • Prepare, make up, bake, and fry all department products, proofing items as necessary and pulling product from the freezer or cooler

  • Review product for freshness and pull by stale date; anticipate product needs not only for the current day but for subsequent days

  • Inspect incoming products for quality and quantity, including identifying mispicks

  • Invoice and put away product as instructed by the Department Manager

  • Check signage for correct labels on ad items and review the department for potential safety issues

  • Understand the use and maintenance needs of bakery equipment and follow up on potential issues

  • Operate as a lead with bakery clerks, providing guidance and direction

  • Review current product on the shelf, re-merchandise as needed, and remove or recycle outdated products

  • Order supplies and merchandise items for the department as directed by the Bakery Manager

  • Write the department schedule and ensure coverage in the Bakery Manager's absence

  • Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking product orders

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer and team experience

  • Solve practical problems and make sound decisions with a variety of variables and limited standardization

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Lead and guide bakery clerks, providing direction and maintaining department standards

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Handle confidential information including sales with discretion

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Bakery Department Manager

Direct Reports: Apprentice Baker, Bakery Designer, Wrapper, Fryer

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience; department training is helpful

  • Over six months up to one year of similar or related experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines throughout your shift. You'll work in the bakery department and can expect continual exposure to flour, noise, and temperature extremes, as well as frequent exposure to dampness, vibrations, and equipment movement hazards, and occasional exposure to cleaning chemicals and solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Software Engineer - Machine Control Diagnostic Tool
description:
Vil du utvikle produktet som gir teknikere bedre oversikt, raskere feilsøking og tryggere drift av avansert boreutstyr?

Om stillingen
Maskin Control utvikler software og kontrollsystemer for boreutstyr, roboter og automatiserte prosesser. Vi søker nå en erfaren softwareingeniør som vil bidra til videreutviklingen av MCDT - Machine Control Diagnostic Tool, et produkt som kobler sammen kontrollsystemer, instrumentering, visualisering og operativ feilsøking.

MCDT gir riggelektroteknikere og hydraulikere sanntidsinnsikt i maskiner og komponenter. Produktet samler blant annet alarmer, I/O-data, trendkurver, P&ID-visning, komponentinformasjon, 3D-visualisering, kalibrering og veiledet diagnostikk i én helhetlig løsning. Målet er å gjøre det enklere å forstå hva som skjer, finne rotårsaken og gjennomføre riktige tiltak.

Som Software Engineer blir du en sentral del av et tverrfaglig produktmiljø. Du vil arbeide med videreutvikling av eksisterende moduler og nye funksjoner, og følge løsningene fra behov og design via implementasjon og testing til installasjon og bruk på boreutstyr.

Hvorfor NOV?
Hos NOV får du jobbe med et produkt som brukes til å gjøre komplekse maskiner enklere å forstå og vedlikeholde. Du blir del av et sterkt fagmiljø i Maskin Control, der softwareutviklere, automasjonsingeniører, robotprogrammerere og fageksperter samarbeider tett om løsninger som skal fungere i krevende operasjoner over hele verden.
Du får:
• Arbeide med et produkt i skjæringspunktet mellom software, automasjon og boreutstyr
• Mulighet til å påvirke produktarkitektur, brukeropplevelse og videre funksjonalitet
• Teknisk krevende oppgaver med tydelig verdi for drift, vedlikehold og sikkerhet
• Et tverrfaglig miljø med høy grad av samarbeid og faglig sparring
• Mulighet til å følge løsningen fra utvikling til bruk på virkelig utstyr
• Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter samt konkurransedyktige betingelser

Mangfold og inkludering

Vi ønsker å fremme mangfold og like muligheter. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller livssyn.

title: Production Improvement Engineer
description:
As a Production Improvement Engineer, you will have a practical role in improving manufacturing performance. Working closely with the factory floor and management, you will identify issues affecting production, investigate their causes, and help drive improvement and corrective actions through to completion.

You will support the development and standardisation of manufacturing processes, maintain clear process documentation and Standard Operating Instructions (SOIs), and help ensure measuring and monitoring equipment is appropriately controlled and calibrated.

This role suits someone who enjoys understanding how processes work, asking constructive questions, solving problems, and turning opportunities for improvement into practical changes.

The position is based onsite five days per week and works within the local business unit.

Why Join NOV?

This is a hands-on improvement opportunity where you can combine continuous improvement and problem-solving capability with broader manufacturing responsibility. You will have the opportunity to influence production processes, efficiency, standardisation and corrective actions while working closely with production teams and management.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe different perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and contribute to our success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency, productivity, process yield, workflow, and waste reduction.
  • Investigate recurring production issues and factory-floor feedback, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions through to completion.
  • Support new product introductions by establishing production processes, assessing production readiness, and developing the required process documentation and training.
  • Create, maintain, and update Standard Operating Instructions, procedures, and other controlled production documentation, including relevant SharePoint content.
  • Work with production, engineering, management, and support teams to identify process constraints, manufacturing risks, material or drawing issues, and improvement priorities.
  • Analyse production information and performance trends to identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify tooling, machinery, and equipment requirements and support the evaluation and justification of appropriate solutions.
  • Coordinate the identification, calibration, maintenance, and documentation of relevant measuring, monitoring, and production equipment.
  • Support production planning and improvement activities that contribute to efficient workflow and on-time delivery.
  • Develop and deliver training on relevant processes, procedures, SOIs, and technical topics.

Must-Have

  • Relevant experience in a manufacturing environment, with practical exposure to continuous improvement, process improvement, production engineering, or a comparable discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying process inefficiencies, investigating production problems, and supporting or implementing practical improvements.
  • Experience developing or maintaining procedures, work instructions, Standard Operating Instructions, or comparable process documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capability, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and follow actions through to completion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work effectively with production teams, management, and other stakeholders.
  • Good IT literacy and the ability to work with systems used to maintain production and process documentation.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous-improvement tools and techniques; Green Belt or Black Belt certification would be advantageous.
  • Experience supporting production planning, equipment calibration/control, quality-management processes, or new product introduction.

title: Pharmacy Clerk
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Pharmacy Clerk

Department: Pharmacy

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Pharmacy Clerks play a meaningful role in the health and wellbeing of our customers by supporting the day-to-day operations of the pharmacy with care and professionalism. In this role, you'll assist customers, stock and order supplies, handle cash transactions, and help keep the pharmacy running smoothly and looking its best.

If you are detail-oriented, trustworthy, and passionate about helping people, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and making every interaction a positive one

  • Answer the telephone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking refill orders

  • Gather patient information required to prepare prescriptions

  • Stock received product and supplies and mark stickers accordingly, and keep pharmacy supplies well stocked

  • Review prescriptions that have not been picked up as requested by the department manager

  • Order product and supplies at the department manager's request and review invoices on product received

  • Log invoices as necessary and complete cash transactions accurately

  • Prepare paperwork and compile medicine for delivery orders and mail-outs at the request of the department manager

  • Coordinate nursing home medicines as necessary

  • Administer vaccines as allowed by law, with required certification where applicable

  • Clean the pharmacy, empty garbage, and remove trash in a timely manner to ensure a clean and inviting appearance

  • Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information at all times

  • Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow written, verbal, or diagrammatic instructions with attention to detail

  • Add, subtract, multiply, and divide whole numbers accurately

  • File, post, and organize materials; copy data accurately between records; and gather basic information through customer interactions

  • Guide customers and provide clear, helpful direction in a professional and compassionate manner

  • Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient information

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Store Operations, and Perishables; Pharmacy Department Manager; Pharmacists

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience required

  • Over six months up to one year of similar or related experience preferred

  • Vaccination certification required if administering vaccines, as required by law

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions

  • Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations

  • Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration

  • Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This is a fast-paced role in a pharmacy environment with daily exposure to noise and significant pressure to meet deadlines. There is occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents during compounding, including chemotherapy drugs. This pharmacy handles and prepares hazardous drugs; personnel of reproductive capability should be aware that exposure may cause acute and chronic effects, and that following all pharmacy policies and procedures is essential to minimizing risk. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Elektriker til skiftehold – specialiseret produktionsjob i Kalundborg (m/f/d)
description:
På vores fabrik i Kalundborg producerer vi fleksible rør til offshore-industrien – produkter, der ikke findes magen til andre steder i Danmark. Vi søger nu en dygtig og engageret elektriker, der vil være med til at sikre drift, vedligehold og udvikling af vores unikke maskinpark. Er det dig?

Om rollen

Som elektriker bliver du en del af et fast hold, der arbejder på 12-timers skift (5-holdsvagtplan), hvor du får ansvaret for elektrisk vedligehold og fejlfinding på vores avancerede hel- og halvautomatiske produktionsanlæg. Du arbejder tæt sammen med både operatører og teknikere for at sikre en stabil og sikker drift.

Inden du starter i skifteholdsrotation, begynder du på daghold, hvor du får grundig oplæring og lærer vores anlæg at kende, indtil du er klar til at arbejde selvstændigt. Med vores vagtplan arbejder du kun 14 dage ud af en 35-dages periode – det giver dig god mulighed for både fleksibilitet og fritid.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med en god aldersspredning og en fri, uformel omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har fokus på både det faglige og det sociale. Din baggrund som elektriker er vigtig – men endnu vigtigere er det, at du har lyst til at arbejde med komplekse anlæg i en branche, hvor kvalitet og sikkerhed er altafgørende.

Om virksomheden

Hos NOV leverer vi sikre, højkvalitets- og teknologidrevne produkter, services og support, som er afgørende for den globale energibranche. Vores mission er enkel: vi driver den industri, der driver verden.

I NOV’s forretningsenhed Subsea Production Systems (SPS) styrker vi energisektoren med passion, ekspertise og fremadskuende løsninger. Vi udvikler pålidelige og effektive produkter til subsea energiproduktion, som styrker vores kunders energiprojekter. Med stærke rødder i offshore olie- og gasindustrien er vi samtidig i front inden for fremtidens teknologier såsom vandbehandling, ammoniaklagring, CO₂-injektion og vindenergi — og bidrager dermed til at reducere CO₂-udledningen og understøtte den grønne omstilling.

SPS har hovedkontor i Brøndby, Danmark, med produktionsfaciliteter i Kalundborg (DK), Porto do Açu (BR), Glenrothes (UK) samt kontorer i Stavanger og Oslo (NO), Rio de Janeiro (BR) og Houston (USA). Globalt består vores team af omkring 1.500 dedikerede medarbejdere, som er en del af NOV’s samlede arbejdsstyrke på cirka 34.000 ansatte.

Hvad vi tilbyder

· En spændende stilling i en nicheproduktion, hvor du kan udvikle dig fagligt.

· Grundig oplæring med opstart på daghold, indtil du er klar til at arbejde selvstændigt.

· Interne træningsprogrammer og mulighed for at udvide dit ansvarsområde.

· En arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og kvalitet er førsteprioritet.

· En attraktiv vagtplan, hvor du i en 35-dages periode kun arbejder 14 dage.

· Et team med god aldersspredning, stærkt sammenhold og en fri omgangstone.

· Gode kolleger og et uformelt, men professionelt arbejdsmiljø.

· Mulighed for deltagelse i en kantineordning med god og varieret mad.

· Vaskeordning – vi sørger for, at dit arbejdstøj bliver vasket.

· Firmabetalt pension, sundhedsforsikring og gruppelivsordning.

· En fast og gennemskuelig vagtplan lang tid frem.

Vi leder efter en, der:

· Har en elektrikeruddannelse og erfaring med industriinstallationer og automation.

· Er kvalitets- og sikkerhedsbevidst – og sætter en ære i sit arbejde.

· Kan arbejde selvstændigt og planlægge sin dag effektivt.

· Har interesse for og forståelse for komplekse tekniske anlæg.

· Har gerne erfaring med vedligeholdelsesprogrammet PM5 – men det er ikke et krav.

· Har gerne epoxy-kursus – men det er heller ikke et krav.

· Er glad for en hverdag med mange forskellige udfordringer.

Vi forventer også, at du:

· Har en positiv tilgang til arbejdet og bidrager til det gode arbejdsmiljø.

· Er mødestabil, ansvarlig og motiveret.

· Er åben for forandringer og nye arbejdsmetoder.

· Kan læse, tale og forstå dansk, samt forstå og kommunikere på engelsk.

· Har basale IT-færdigheder.

· Trives med at arbejde på skiftehold (efter oplæring).

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonas Larsen, Teamleader Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance, på telefon 29 65 57 38.

Hvorfor vælge os?

Vi tilbyder et dynamisk og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø, hvor vækst, nytænkning og løbende forbedringer er kernen i vores måde at arbejde på. Som en del af vores team får du mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt gennem alsidige og udfordrende opgaver, støttet af erfarne kolleger og en kultur, der værdsætter læring og udvikling.

At blive en del af NOV betyder at blive en del af en formålsdrevet organisation, der er dedikeret til operationel ekspertise, bæredygtighed og langsigtet karriereudvikling.

Hos NOV Subsea Production Systems får du en vigtig rolle i at levere pålidelige og effektive subsea-løsninger, der imødekommer nutidens energibehov og er med til at forme en mere bæredygtig fremtid.

Vær med til at gå længere og forme fremtidens energi. For energi betyder noget.

Ensure the reliable day-to-day operation of our factory in Kalundborg.

Qualified as an electrician or in a similar technical field.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:

Additionally, you will participate with your global team members in acquisitions, technology evaluations, design, and of course resolving intellectually challenging technical issues.

If you enjoy traveling and exploring cultures around the world, you are in luck. With 600+ locations in every time zone in over 65 countries on every continent except Antarctica, the sun never sets for NOV. We are a globally diverse happy family, driven to power the people who power the world.

  • Your deep understanding of network application protocols such as DNS, HTTP, encryption, and skills tackling problems solved with network packet capture make you an ideal team member. Deep understanding of IT security as a whole with proven focus on firewalls, application and endpoint security.
  • A rich understanding of wired or wireless network protocols. Required understanding of global wide area networking and impact of latency. What do you think of a wireless only office?
  • A proven knowledge of datacenter and cloud networking. Required knowledge of scripting/programming knowledge on automation, and concept of redundancy.
  • Solid grasp of optimization technologies including compression, caching, load balance, and distributed topology. Require experience working with business teams to dissect applications to facilitate understanding optimization opportunities.

Requirements:

  • NGFW, Cloud security, WAF, DNS RPZ, SDWAN, SDN, Microsegmentation using Zscaler or Cloudflare.
  • Current popular Network OSes, Network virtualization, Hybrid Clouds like Azure/AWS/Google, Linux, Docker, etc.
  • Datacenter technology EVPN/VXLAN, MP-BGP, MLAG, VARP, spine-leaf topology using Arista Networks.
  • IPSec, MB-BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, VRF, VXLAN, STP, IRF/Clustering, LACP, 802.1x, 802.1q, 802.11, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, SSL x509, QoS
  • DevSecOps, Rest API, Python, Perl, C, Javascript, Powershell, Bash scripting, Ansible, Terraform, etc
  • Zero Trust principles and least-privileges access.
  • WAN SD-WAN and Optimization using Versa Networks.
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Computer Engineering

Certifications:

  • Current CCNP or CCIE (must)
  • Aruba ACMP or ACSA professional certification (plus)
  • Azure solution architect expert (plus)
  • Zscaler certification (plus)
  • Palo Alto PCNSE / PCSAE (plus)
  • Wireshark WCNA (plus)

location: Marshall, E Main Street, Marshall, MN
description:

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Checker

Department: Grocery

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Checkers are often the last face a customer sees before leaving the store, which makes this role one of the most important ones we have. In this position, you'll operate the register, assist customers throughout the store, and help make sure every visit ends on a great note.

If you enjoy working with people, take pride in doing things right, and want to be part of a team that truly cares about customers, we'd love to have you join us.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and going out of your way to make every visit a great one

  • Operate the cash register accurately, scanning product and processing all payment types including cash, checks, credit cards, coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, rain checks, in-store charges, and lottery transactions

  • Count back change, issue receipts, and provide cash refunds or credit memorandums for returned merchandise as needed

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal guidelines regarding WIC, food stamps, and the sale of tobacco, liquor, and lottery tickets

  • Place merchandise in bags or boxes, assist courtesy personnel, and support drive-up and carry-out service

  • Stay knowledgeable of item look-up numbers, department numbers, item features, and weekly ad price changes and sale items

  • Stock, face, and rotate merchandise, clean shelves, understand shelf tags, and take customers to items when requested

  • Keep the register area clean, ensure adequate supplies are available, and report improper cash levels in the cash drawer

  • Verify register balances at the beginning and end of each shift where applicable

  • Communicate clearly on the intercom or telephone and answer customer questions, following up with appropriate personnel as needed

  • Stay aware of your surroundings to support store safety and security

  • Assist store management with displays and decorations for special promotions and events as needed

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

  • Perform arithmetic calculations involving fractions, decimals, and percentages

  • Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

  • Work effectively as part of a team to deliver a great customer experience

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of HWH, Perishables, and Store Operations; Service Managers

Education and Experience

  • No education or experience requirements; we will provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-paced role in a retail store environment where you will be on your feet throughout your shift. You will have frequent exposure to temperature extremes and possible dampness, as well as occasional exposure to equipment movement hazards and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $11.41 to $14.00 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

title: Painter / Coatings
description:
About the Role

As a Painter / Coatings, you will prepare, shot blast and apply protective coatings to precision-engineered components used in demanding industrial environments. Working on-site in our Kintore manufacturing facility, you will help ensure products are completed to the highest quality standards before progressing to assembly or dispatch.

This role has been created to support the expansion of NOV's in-house coatings capability following investment in new coating technologies and equipment. As part of a growing operation, you will contribute to increasing manufacturing capacity while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and delivery performance.

Why This Role Matters

The coatings process is one of the final stages of manufacturing, making quality, accuracy and responsiveness essential to meeting customer commitments. Success in this role means balancing throughput with attention to detail in a fast-paced production environment where priorities may change throughout the day.

About NOV

NOV delivers technology-driven equipment, systems, services and software solutions that support energy production and industrial operations worldwide. Through our global network of engineering, manufacturing and service teams, we help customers improve safety, efficiency, reliability and operational performance.

Why Join NOV

At NOV, you'll become part of a stable manufacturing business investing in people, technology and continuous improvement. We offer opportunities to develop your technical skills, gain experience with modern industrial coating systems and build a long-term career within a global organisation. As our coatings capability continues to grow, you'll have opportunities for further development across the wider business.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Prepare components for coating through cleaning, masking and surface preparation.
  • Carry out steel shot blasting to achieve the required surface finish prior to coating.
  • Apply protective coatings using industrial spray painting equipment in accordance with engineering specifications and quality standards.
  • Inspect coated components to verify compliance with quality requirements.
  • Operate, maintain and clean paint shop equipment to support safe and efficient production.
  • Maintain accurate production and quality documentation.
  • Follow all Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality procedures, using appropriate PPE at all times.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to Lean Manufacturing and 5S activities.
  • Work collaboratively with supervisors and colleagues to achieve production schedules and delivery commitments.
  • Carry out other reasonable duties in support of business requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Time-served apprenticeship or equivalent vocational qualification.
  • Previous experience in industrial spray painting within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience of steel shot blasting and component preparation.
  • Working knowledge of industrial spray-painting equipment.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing quality standards and Health & Safety requirements.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with changing priorities.
  • Reliable, flexible and willing to support production requirements, including overtime when business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Further education in a relevant technical discipline.
  • Experience with specialist industrial coating systems such as phosphate, Everlube/Everslik or molybdenum coatings.
  • Experience working within quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or 5S principles.
  • Relevant industrial coating certification, or willingness to complete company-supported training.

title: Acupuncturist
description:
Benefits:
  • Competitive salary
  • Employee discounts
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development

Acupuncturist – bVital


Who You Are
You are a skilled acupuncturist who has genuine respect for what integrative and regenerative medicine can do — not just as a philosophical stance, but as something you have seen work for patients. You do not need to be convinced that IV therapy, frequency-based protocols, and brain regeneration work belong alongside classical Chinese medicine. You find it interesting. You want to understand how the pieces fit together and what your contribution is to the larger clinical picture.

You are also honest with yourself about how you work best. You thrive in a structured environment. You can see 6 to 10 patients in a day, deliver quality care in each appointment, and keep the schedule moving. You know how to be fully present with a patient without losing track of time. Efficiency and care are not in conflict for you — you have figured out how to do both.

When leadership or clinical protocols set a standard, you follow it first and raise a question second. Not because you check your clinical judgment at the door, but because you understand that a well-run clinic requires alignment, and you are the kind of practitioner who earns the right to shape the process by demonstrating you can work within it. If something is not working, you say so directly. You do not quietly work around it.

What you are tired of: environments where you are isolated, unsupported, or not taken seriously as a clinician. You want to work alongside medical providers who respect what acupuncture does, in a setting where you are part of the care team, not a separate service down the hall.

About bVital
bVital is a regenerative medicine and brain health clinic in Park City, Utah. We offer IV therapy, brain regeneration protocols, and an evolving suite of integrative clinical services for patients dealing with serious neurological conditions, chronic illness, and performance decline. Our patients are motivated. They have often exhausted conventional options and come to us because they are serious about outcomes. Our team includes medical providers, NPs, and clinical specialists working from a shared patient record, meeting regularly to align on care. We take quality seriously at every layer, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.


The Role
You will carry a full outpatient caseload of 6 to 10 patients per day, supported by clinical and administrative staff. Appointments are structured and scheduled. You are expected to run on time, deliver quality care within each session, and keep the day moving. This is not an environment where sessions routinely run long — effective time management with patients is a core expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Clinical Care
  • Conduct patient assessments covering presenting conditions, health history, lifestyle factors, and treatment goals.
  • Develop individualized acupuncture treatment plans and adjust them as patients progress.
  • Integrate your clinical perspective into a broader care plan that may include IV therapy, regenerative protocols, and other modalities delivered by the team.
  • Collaborate directly with medical providers and other practitioners in case discussions and care coordination.
  • Educate patients on self-care, what to expect from their treatment plan, and how acupuncture works alongside the other modalities they are receiving.
Documentation and Team Integration
  • Complete accurate, timely session notes within our EMR system — same day, every day.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case reviews and contribute your clinical perspective on shared patients.
  • Follow established clinical protocols. If you have input on improving them, bring it through the right channel.
Who Thrives Here

Must-haves:

  • Active Utah L.Ac. licensure (required)
  • NCCAOM certification (required)
  • Demonstrated clinical experience treating chronic pain, nervous system conditions, fatigue, trauma, or emotional dysregulation
  • Comfortable carrying a caseload of 5 to 8 patients per day and managing time effectively within each appointment
  • Strong documentation habits — notes completed accurately and same day
  • Genuine belief in integrative and regenerative medicine as a clinical approach, not just a work setting
Bonus points:

  • Experience in an integrative, functional, or regenerative medicine clinical environment
  • Tan Balance method or other orthopedic acupuncture training
  • Chinese herbal medicine background or additional certification in complementary modalities
  • Experience with regenerative biologics and stem cell therapies
  • Comfort supervising MAs or clinical support staff during patient procedures
  • Background in an IV therapy or infusion clinic environment
You thrive here if...
  • You are genuinely interested in how acupuncture works alongside regenerative protocols, IV therapy, and frequency-based medicine — not just willing to tolerate that those things exist.
  • You follow the structure first and refine it later. You understand that working within a system is how you eventually get to shape it.
  • You can deliver quality care and keep the schedule. You have learned how to be fully present with a patient without losing 20 minutes per appointment.
This is not the right fit if...
  • You are skeptical of regenerative or frequency-based medicine and would find it difficult to speak about it with patients positively and honestly.
  • You prefer to practice on your own terms and find it frustrating when clinical protocols or scheduling structures do not accommodate your approach.
  • You need extended session time with every patient to feel like you are doing good work. The expectation here is 6 to 10 patients per day, and that is not negotiable.
  • You are newer to practice and looking for a mentored environment to build foundational skills. This role expects clinical independence from day one.
How You'll Be Measured

  1. Patient outcomes and retention — are patients progressing and continuing care as planned?
  2. Schedule adherence — appointments run on time, caseload managed without consistent overruns
  3. Documentation quality and timeliness — notes completed accurately and same day
  4. Team integration — active participation in case reviews, clear communication with clinical colleagues

Compensation and Details

  • Salary: $65,000–$85,000 DOE
  • Employment type: Full-time, salaried
  • Location: Park City, UT — in-person, outpatient only
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 6 to 10 patients per day. No weekends, no on-call.
  • Benefits: Access to bVital clinical services, discounts on wellness programs, mentorship, clinical development, and opportunities for teaching and speaking as the program grows

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

If you enjoy staying active, take pride in a job well done, and thrive working as part of a team, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

Your Skills

  • Follow written and verbal instructions carefully and with attention to detail

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Learn and apply proper sanitation, food safety, and department procedures

Education and Experience

  • Six months or less of similar or related work experience; we'll provide all the training you need to succeed

Physical Requirements

title: Foundry Worker
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Foundry Grinding Technician is responsible for cleaning, grinding, and finishing metal castings to meet quality standards and customer specifications. This role supports production by ensuring castings are properly prepared for shipment and may assist in other foundry operations as needed.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate hand-held and stationary tools including grinders, chippers, saws, and blasting equipment to remove excess material from castings
  • Grind, smooth, and finish castings to meet quality and dimensional standards
  • Inspect castings for defects and report issues to supervisors or leads
  • Perform routine maintenance and daily safety checks on tools and equipment
  • Safely move materials using hoists, cranes, forklifts, or other equipment
  • Support additional foundry operations as needed, including:
    • Core making (forming internal casting structures)
    • Mold making and closing (forming external casting shapes)
    • Melting (preparing molten metal from raw materials)
    • Pouring (filling molds with molten metal)
    • Shakeout (removing sand and cores from castings)
  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment
  • Comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures.
  • Perform other work-related tasks as assigned.

FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES (OPTIONAL)

  • Support casting operations across various foundry departments.
  • Assist with sand reclamation, pattern storage, and casting touch-ups as needed.
  • Actively contribute to safe and efficient daily operations.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Entry Level-High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience operating grinding or cutting equipment in a manufacturing or metalworking environment preferred
  • Experience operating forklifts, overhead cranes, or similar equipment preferred

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to pass a drug screen & background check.
  • Must have corrected vision to 20/20.
  • Willingness to work in environments with extreme temperatures, noise, dust, fumes, and moving equipment.
  • Must possess general knowledge of industrial applications in a manufacturing setting.
  • Must possess general knowledge of safety rules and regulations.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.
  • Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out written or oral instructions.
  • Required to wear PPE including hard hat, gloves, face mask, and steel-toed boots.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Able to work well in a team environment as well as self-directed when working independently.
  • Willingness to comply with all safety regulations and procedures.
  • Ability to adapt and be cross-trained to learn all job duties.
  • Ability to multitask in fast paced environment.
  • Factory environment with large range in temperature changes.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. and perform physically demanding tasks including walking, standing, bending, stooping, and reaching for extended periods of time.

description:
Position Summary

• Support the development, testing, and optimization of ultrasonic and electromagnetic inspection systems.

• Experience supporting, troubleshooting, testing, or developing NDT equipment and inspection systems.
• Familiarity with data acquisition systems, instrumentation, signal processing, or inspection data analysis.
• Working knowledge of Python, MATLAB, C++, C#, or similar programming tools is preferred.
• Experience with tubular products, OCTG, manufacturing inspection, oilfield equipment, or industrial inspection systems is preferred.
• Knowledge of industry standards such as API, ASTM, or ASNT is preferred.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with finite element modeling tools such as COMSOL, ANSYS, or similar software.
• Exposure to automation, machine vision, or advanced inspection technologies.
• Experience supporting field operations, manufacturing, or customer-facing technical activities.
• Hands-on experience with ultrasonic probes, sensors, electronics, and inspection instrumentation.

As a Quality Coordinator, you will maintain and continuously improve the division's Quality Management System while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001:2015, NOV quality standards, and customer requirements. You will partner with operations, leadership, and customers to promote a culture of quality, support audits and training, resolve quality concerns, and drive continuous improvement across the facility.

  • Maintain and improve the Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 9001:2015, the NOV Tuboscope Quality Manual, and company objectives.
  • Promote a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
  • Investigate nonconforming products or services and coordinate timely corrective actions.
  • Prepare, maintain, and distribute quality system documents, procedures, and revisions.
  • Coordinate internal audits, customer audits, supplier audits, and annual management reviews.
  • Manage the Quality Action Report (QAR) system and monitor quality performance trends.
  • Ensure customer specifications are communicated, implemented, and maintained.
  • Coordinate employee quality training, qualification records, and certification documentation.
  • Evaluate supplier performance and maintain supplier quality records.
  • Provide quality system updates and performance reports to facility leadership and the Quality & Technical Services (QTS) team.
  • Support compliance with NOV Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), and Quality policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate degree or two years of college coursework in a technical or engineering-related field preferred.
  • Experience with non-destructive testing (NDT) or oilfield inspection processes preferred.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and quality auditing principles preferred.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply technical documents, specifications, and procedures.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Basic math skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to work a 2 weeks on / 2 weeks off rotational schedule, including 12-hour shifts in Arctic weather conditions.

Veterans Welcome!

At NOV, we proudly support and hire U.S. military veterans. We recognize the value of your leadership, technical expertise, and dedication to mission success. Veterans from all branches are encouraged to apply and build a future with us.

Conditions of Employment

Offer of employment is contingent upon the completion of background and drug screenings, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.
