title: Health Beauty Care Department Manager
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Health Beauty Care Department Manager

Department: Health Beauty Care

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

As the Health Beauty Care Department Manager at Hy-Vee, you'll lead a department that helps customers look and feel their best. You'll stay ahead of trends, build a team that delivers exceptional service, and create a department experience that stands out through great merchandising, knowledgeable staff, and a welcoming environment.

If you're passionate about beauty and health products, love helping customers find what they need, and thrive in a leadership role, this is a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Set and uphold department standards for customer service, cleanliness, sanitation, team relations, and overall profitability

  • Build a friendly, welcoming atmosphere by encouraging your team to greet and engage with customers and leading by example

  • Stay current on trends across all product categories and educate customers by offering suggestions and answering questions

  • Assist customers with finding products, reaching items, carrying heavy purchases, and going the extra mile to make their visit a great one

  • Recruit, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate department employees, and handle performance and disciplinary matters as needed

  • Coordinate scheduling, daily work plans, and department goals in partnership with store leadership

  • Set and maintain department experience standards with a focus on impactful signage and merchandising displays

  • Track product rotation, check for expired code dates, and manage ordering and replenishment

  • Oversee pricing, ensure competitive pricing in the market, and analyze weekly and monthly sales trends

  • Plan displays, promotions, and pre-orders; prepare ad projections and write ads

  • Determine sanitation guidelines and ensure compliance throughout the department

  • Operate the cash register accurately and report any cash drawer discrepancies as needed

  • Maintain compliance with Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all company policies

  • Assist in other store areas and take on special projects as needed

  • You'll receive direction and support from: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Store Operations, and Perishables, and Fashion Beauty Basin Director

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service and inspire your team to do the same

  • Lead, motivate, and develop a team in a fast-paced retail environment

  • Stay curious and keep up with trends in health, beauty, and personal care products

  • Use basic math skills, including fractions, decimals, and percentages

  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with customers, employees, and vendors

  • Handle confidential information including item costs and margins with discretion

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; one to three years of similar or related work experience preferred

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Store Operations, and Perishables, and Fashion Beauty Basin Director

Direct Reports: Department Employees

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • One or more years of similar or related work experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, or pull objects weighing 100 pounds or more, with or without mechanical assistance

  • Continuously stand and walk on hard surfaces for extended periods

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate pallet jacks, forklifts, or similar material-handling equipment (required operator certification must be completed prior to independent use)

  • Work in cooler or freezer environments for extended periods

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades to cut, trim, or grind product

  • Where applicable to the role, and in accordance with applicable age and legal requirements: operate a cardboard baler or compactor

  • Where applicable to the role: perform repetitive motions associated with dough mixing, scaling, and proofing

  • Ability to unload, lift, stock, and rotate incoming truck freight and merchandise

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role where things stay busy and engaging. You may encounter daily exposure to dirt, noise, and equipment movement hazards, with occasional exposure to temperature extremes, dampness, electrical shock, and cleaning chemicals or solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $18.00 to $22.50 depending on experience.

For information on company benefits visit Benefits | Hy-Vee.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: General Manager (Sumter, SC)
description:
What You'll Do

You will oversee all warehouse functions including operations, transportation, personnel, and customer service, ensuring alignment with company objectives and compliance with regulations. You will manage budgets, assign work, monitor departmental performance, and maintain positive relationships with customers and union representatives. You will also implement safety measures and procedures to prevent loss and support continuous improvement and disaster recovery planning.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and manage the annual facility budget and ensure adherence across warehouse departments.
  • Direct and assign work, set performance objectives, and monitor progress toward departmental goals.
  • Oversee all warehouse activities, costs, operations, and forecasts, ensuring operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and all federal, state, and local OSHA regulations.
  • Represent the company to warehouse customers, secure additional business, and maintain positive customer relationships.
  • Negotiate labor contracts with union representatives and implement desired changes.

  • Develop and maintain plans for disaster prevention and recovery and identify safety concerns and cost-saving opportunities.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • College degree in business, logistics, or management plus minimum 5 years of experience required in warehousing or logistics management or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of supervisory or management experience required.
  • Proven ability in planning, staffing, budgeting, and organizing warehouse operations.
  • Experienced with AS/400 and Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
  • Demonstrated experience in analyzing operational challenges and implementing effective solutions in a warehouse or logistics environment.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in both written and verbal formats with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Radio Frequency (RF) technology.
  • Ability to develop effective relationships and provide leadership to integrate diverse functions and individuals toward profitability objectives.
  • Ability to interpret safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedures manuals.
  • Experience promoting an open door policy and team environment.
  • Experience supporting performance management programs.
  • Experience developing and maintaining disaster prevention and recovery plans.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work in spaces with 55 inches (1.4 meters) of headroom.
  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures varying from 32 degrees Fahrenheit (0 degrees Celsius) to minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius), as well as outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold, and precipitation).
  • Able to climb ladders or step ladders.
  • Able to tolerate heights up to 30 ft. (9 meters) and be able to access elevated products from inside safety cage.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for working at heights and in cold temperatures.
  • Able to stand and/or walk continuously or frequently over an 8-10-12 hour shift. Occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Depending on specific role, must be able to lift boxes of varying weights up to 80 lbs. (36 kg) and carry product a distance of up to 6 ft. (2 meters) without mechanical assistance.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job, including close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

  • Able to hear and speak in order to comprehend, respond to, and provide instructions and safety warnings, as well as able to read and understand packaging, shipping documents, and safety guidelines.

3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description

Dein Schülerpraktikum bei 3M

Du bist neugierig und möchtest erste Einblicke in die Arbeitswelt eines globalen Multitechnologiekonzerns gewinnen? Dann nutze die Gelegenheit, spannende Aufgabenbereiche an einem unserer Standorte in Neuss, Hilden oder Jüchen kennenzulernen.

Starte mit uns in eine abwechslungsreiche Praktikumszeit und erfahre, wie die Arbeit in einem internationalen Großunternehmen aussieht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Mindestqualifikationen

  • Es handelt sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen deiner Schulzeit.

  • Du bist kommunikativ, gehst offen auf andere Menschen zu und bist bereit, Neues zu lernen.

Bitte lade folgende Unterlagen hoch

  • Lebenslauf

  • Letztes Schulzeugnis

  • Bescheinigung deiner Schule

Bitte gib außerdem den gewünschten Standort, den gewünschten Einsatzbereich sowie den gewünschten Praktikumszeitraum an.

Ein Schülerpraktikum können wir nur dann anbieten, wenn der jeweilige Fachbereich der Betreuung zugestimmt hat und - sofern erforderlich - vorab eine Gefährdungsbeurteilung durchgeführt wurde.

title: Asociado de Ventas
description:
Marshalls

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for delivering a highly satisfied customer experience proven by engaging and interacting with all customers, embodying customer experience principles and philosophy, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. Adheres to all operational, merchandise, and loss prevention standards. May be cross-trained to work in multiple areas of the store in order to support the needs of the business.

  • Role models established customer experience practices with internal and external customers
  • Supports and embodies a positive store culture through honesty, integrity, and respect
  • Accurately rings customer purchases/returns and counts change back to customer according to established operating procedures
  • Promotes credit and loyalty programs
  • Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and follows established merchandising procedures and standards
  • Accurately processes and prepares merchandise for the sales floor following company procedures and standards
  • Initiates and participates in store recovery as needed throughout the day
  • Maintains all organizational, cleanliness, and recovery standards for the sales floor and participates in the maintenance/cleanliness of the entire store
  • Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
  • Adheres to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
  • Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
  • Participates in safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
  • Other duties as assigned

Who We’re Looking For: You.

  • Possesses excellent customer service skills
  • Able to work a flexible schedule to support business needs
  • Possesses strong communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Capable of multi-tasking
  • Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
  • Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Works effectively with peers and supervisors
  • Retail customer experience preferred

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

Address:

1400 Av. Miramar - Suite D

Location:

title: Commercial Lines Producer
description:
The Commercial Lines Producer at Evans Ewan and Brady is responsible for maintaining and maximizing profitable relationships with commercial lines clients and growing the book of business through new client sales.
Benefits/Perks
  • Competitive Pay
  • Professional Development
  • Job Stability in a growing industry
Responsibilities
  • Identify, qualify, and develop commercial insurance opportunities with new and existing clients in person, online, by phone, and through written communication.
  • Foster and maintain excellent relationships with clients and prospects through regular follow-up, accurate and timely quotations, and general account support. Anticipate, respond to, and follow up on all existing client needs.
  • Actively partner, network, and plan for new clients and business opportunities.
  • Monitor, review, and report on key metrics to ensure sales targets are achieved and execute sales activity documentation quickly, accurately, and professionally.
  • Collaborate with team members, mentor staff, provide expertise and answer questions, and participate in formal and informal meetings as needed.
  • Support and prepare clients for renewal and retention and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Maintain CE and participate in ongoing education and keep informed regarding industry information, new product information, legislation, coverages, and technology to continuously improve knowledge and performance.
  • Review client audits, verify and facilitate corrections as needed and maintain A/R and billing
Qualifications
  • Hold the insurance license required by your state and have a minimum of two years personal and commercial lines insurance account management experience.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and a source of reliable transportation.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of insurance products and usages, rating procedures, underwriting procedures, coverages, and industry operations to effectively secure new business and maintain an existing client base.
  • Have a proven track record of business-to-business sales success. Possess strong presentation, persuasion, and negotiation skills with the ability to close sales.
  • Be people-oriented, customer-focused, and professionally assertive in developing new client relationships and servicing existing clients.
  • Possess outstanding organizational skills with an ability to complete difficult assignments without supervision, sound business judgment, strong decision-making, and superior written and verbal communication skills.
  • Have excellent time management skills, thrive in a team environment, and Technology and Computer proficiency including agency management systems.

title: Project Manager
description:
The Fabrication Project Manager is responsible for the planning, procurement, scheduling, and execution of fabrication projects to ensure on-time delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction. This position serves as the primary coordinator between engineering, production, supply chain, vendors, customers, and operations to ensure fabrication jobs progress efficiently from order release through completion and coordinating of shipments with freight forwarders and end users.
Based in Odessa, Texas, this role will also provide planning, procurement, and project support for the company's sister fabrication operation in Dubai, helping to standardize processes, improve communication, and support global project execution.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple fabrication projects simultaneously while maintaining strong relationships with vendors, internal stakeholders, and manufacturing personnel.

Project Management

  • Manage fabrication projects from order release through final completion and coordinating shipments.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project schedules and monitor progress daily.
  • Coordinate project priorities with production, engineering, quality, customers, vendors, freight forwarders, and operations.
  • Identify schedule risks and implement corrective actions to minimize delays.
  • Lead daily project reviews and provide status updates to management.
  • Monitor project milestones and ensure customer commitments are achieved.
  • Track project costs and communicate potential budget impacts with customers and or managements.
  • Procurement & Planning
  • Create, issue, and manage vendor purchase orders for fabricated components, raw materials, machining, coatings, and outside processing.
  • Coordinate purchasing activities to ensure material availability aligns with production schedules.
  • Monitor supplier performance regarding delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
  • Expedite critical materials and services when necessary.
  • Maintain accurate purchase order status and communicate material availability to production.
  • Develop and maintain supplier relationships while identifying opportunities for cost savings and improved delivery performance.
  • Fabrication Coordination
  • Work closely with fabrication supervisors to ensure efficient workflow through the shop.
  • Monitor fabrication progress and resolve production constraints.
  • Ensure engineering drawings, BOMs, and work orders are complete prior to fabrication.
  • Coordinate inspection requirements and quality hold points.
  • Global Operations Support
  • Provide procurement support for the Dubai fabrication facility.
  • Coordinate vendor sourcing and purchasing activities between Odessa and Dubai when appropriate.
  • Participate in regular coordination meetings with the Dubai operations team if needed.
  • Support global project execution to improve delivery performance and operational consistency.
  • Communication & Reporting
  • Serve as the primary communication link between Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, Production, Quality, Customers, and Sales.
  • Prepare weekly project status reports.
  • Communicate project risks, schedule changes, and mitigation plans to management.
  • Maintain accurate ERP system data for purchase orders, job status, work order management, and project milestones.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, manufacturing, or related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in fabrication, manufacturing, project management, production planning, customer relations, and supply chain.
  • Experience managing multiple fabrication or manufacturing projects simultaneously.
  • Strong purchasing and vendor management experience.
  • Experience working within an ERP/MRP system (JD Edwards experience preferred).
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project.

Preferred

  • Experience in oil & gas manufacturing or industrial equipment fabrication.
  • Knowledge of welding, machining, fabrication, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience supporting multiple manufacturing locations.
  • APICS/CPIM, PMP, or other project management certification.
  • Experience working with international suppliers or global operations.

Key Competencies

  • Project Planning & Scheduling
  • Procurement & Supply Chain Management
  • Vendor Relationship Management
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Production Planning
  • Cost Control
  • Schedule Management
  • ERP Systems (JD Edwards preferred)
  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Customer Relationships
  • Decision Making
  • Attention to Detail

Working Environment

  • Office environment with frequent interaction in a manufacturing/fabrication facility.
  • Regular communication with domestic and international suppliers.
  • Occasional travel to support operations, vendors, Customers, fabrication facility.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

title: Project Manager
description:
About NOV and Rig Technologies

NOV is a leading provider of technology, equipment, and services to the global oil and gas industry that supports customers’ full-field drilling, completion, and production needs. Since 1862, NOV has pioneered innovations that improve the cost-effectiveness, efficiency, safety, and environmental impact of oil and gas operations. We're continually pushing our own standards higher to deliver the safest, most efficient, and most reliable drilling solutions in the world. Join us as we continue to power the industry that powers the world.

NOV Rig Technologies makes and supports the world’s most advanced drilling solutions. To learn more about Rig Technologies products and services, please visit us at

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide customer / subcontractors and customer suppliers with a single point-of-contact and assume the role of communications coordinator for assigned major projects, which includes coordinating within the various departments.
  • Assure preparation of customer documents and project drawings are completed as required by the contract.
  • Represent Company at customer / subcontractor coordination status meetings.
  • Monitor all activities to assure costs and gross margins are met.
  • Track and control the major components of project cost.
  • Take responsibility for the overall project schedule.
  • Follow administrative procedures as necessary to assure the success of the project.
  • Monitor all project activities, report progress against plans and take corrective action as required to meet plans.
  • Perform other work related tasks as assigned.
  • Comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures.

FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Project management and customer focal point for all NOV associated project work scopes: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) programs, Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) programs, recertifications, upgrades, reactivaitions, capital equipment exchanges, OEM repairs, rig/ship yard based inspections and other internal projects.
  • Follow standardized processes, policies and operational procedures from a global operations perspective.
  • Responsible for all project planning activities including scope identification, creation of the Project Execution Plan (PEP) and documentation gathering.
  • Create and document required work scopes of the project such as quotations, proposals, purchase orders and change orders as required through the duration of the project.
  • Issue and track purchase orders for parts and services for internal and 3rd party requirements.
  • Responsible for project execution including scope execution and issuance of project certifications.
  • Collaborate with both regional and local Aftermarket representatives (Service, Spares, Repair, Engineering, Sales, Accounting/Finance, etc) to maximise support, planning, project execution and customer experience.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with customer, suppliers and vendors.
  • Responsible for monitoring and controlling projects which includes risk management, change management and progress management, reporting and project close out.
  • Maximize financial results by monitoring / reporting all activities to ensure accurate costing and forecasting of gross margins.
  • Maintain awareness of critical path activities affecting customer sensitive project deadlines; build contingency plans and implement recovery plans.
  • When required, deploy to job site and lead project from site.
  • Responsible for project close out including invoicing, handovers and after action reviews.
  • Perform other work as assigned.
  • Comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business Management is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and project management experience.
  • 5+ years within a project management role.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
  • Experience handling customers and internal stakeholders professionally throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Responsible for all operational activities of assigned projects.
  • Travel to on-site locations to meet with internal and external customers.
  • Maintain a high degree of situation awareness to track and manage issues.
  • Strive to achieve on time delivery.
  • Follow NOV PM procedures and processes.
  • Create customize reports when required.
  • Create, store and find documents in RigOffice.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  • Communicates effectively.
  • Interpersonal skills.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Planning / Organization.
  • Team oriented.
  • Self motivated.
  • Adaptable to change.

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

  • Knowledge of oil and gas industry drilling, pressure control and/or lifting and handling equipment.
  • Strong understanding of PMI principals and methodology.
  • Understanding of technical documentation packages/drawings.
  • Fluent in Aftermarket systems, such as, RigOffice, Compass, Tracker, PIMS, and other system
  • Fluent in MS Office products, specifically Project, Excel, Word, Powerpoint.

title: Repair Engineer - Electrical
description:

  • Repair and/or rebuild NOV equipment at the NOV- Mumbai Workshop and any assigned job as directed by the management.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities, high discipline, ability to work independently, and a strong focus on safety.
  • Knowledge on Microsoft office suite.
  • Ability to troubleshoot electromechanical equipment and interpret technical diagrams.

title: Pre FAB Operator
description:

In this role, you will be responsible for handling raw materials and operating various machines (Plasma cutter, Water Jet, Saws, Shears, Press Brake, Punch Press, Roller or similar machines) to create finished parts according to blueprints. Your work will directly support our welding group, ensuring a smooth and safe workflow. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of our dynamic team and contribute to our manufacturing processes.

  • Operate multiple machines to produce finished parts as per blueprints.
  • Ensure a steady supply of raw materials for the welding group.
  • Maintain a safe and organized work environment, adhering to all safety protocols.
  • Perform regular maintenance and cleaning of machinery to ensure optimal performance.
  • Collaborate with the welding team to understand their requirements and adjust production accordingly.
  • Monitor and control the quality of finished parts, ensuring they meet specified standards.
  • Keep accurate records of production data and report any issues or deviations.
  • Assist in training new operators and sharing best practices.
  • Work closely with the maintenance team to address any machinery-related concerns.
  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a machine operating role, preferably in a fabrication or manufacturing setting.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to read and interpret blueprints.
  • The ability to read and interpret multiple measuring devices. (Tape Measure, Calipers and possibly micrometers)
  • Knowledge of basic machine maintenance and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to lift and move heavy materials as needed up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand/stoop/sit for 8 hours
  • Ability to pass a Physical Exam
  • Good communication skills for effective collaboration with team members.
  • Willingness to undergo training and adapt to new technologies.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
About the Role

As an Operations Coordinator, you will support the end-to-end fulfilment of aftermarket spare parts orders, helping move customer requirements efficiently from order through picking, dispatch and collection. You will monitor order progress, coordinate with internal teams, communicate updates to customers and help ensure urgent requirements are prioritised effectively.

About NOV

NOV delivers technology-driven equipment, systems, services and solutions supporting energy production and industrial operations worldwide. Through our global engineering, manufacturing and service capabilities, we help customers improve safety, reliability, efficiency and operational performance.

About the Team

You will join a close-knit and collaborative team within a busy, fast-paced operational environment. The Operations team works closely with colleagues across Stores, Purchasing and Sales, with regular communication and a shared focus on meeting customer requirements and departmental targets.

Why This Role Matters

Spare parts are often required when customers need them most, making effective prioritisation and communication critical. Your contribution will help keep orders moving, provide customers with clear and timely updates and support the team in achieving delivery and monthly performance targets.

What We Offer

This role provides broad exposure to operational processes, shipping and customer coordination, supported by structured initial training and a collaborative team environment. You will have the opportunity to build your knowledge across the aftermarket operation and develop transferable skills that can support future career progression within the department and wider organisation.

Why Join NOV

If you enjoy a varied role where priorities move quickly and teamwork makes a visible difference, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute directly to customer delivery and team performance. Previous experience in planning or an office-based environment is not essential; transferable experience from customer service, retail, logistics, dispatch or other fast-paced environments can provide a strong foundation for success.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Coordinate the progress of spare parts orders through picking, dispatch and customer collection.

title: Manager, Cloud Engineering
description:
At Children’s Wisconsin, we believe kids deserve the best.

Children’s Wisconsin is a nationally recognized health system dedicated solely to the health and well-being of children. We provide primary care, specialty care, urgent care, emergency care, community health services, foster and adoption services, child and family counseling, child advocacy services and family resource centers. Our reputation draws patients and families from around the country.

We offer a wide variety of rewarding career opportunities and are seeking individuals dedicated to helping us achieve our vision of the healthiest kids in the country. If you want to work for an organization that makes a difference for children and families, and encourages you to be at your best every day, please apply today.

Please follow this link for a closer look at what it’s like to work at Children’s Wisconsin:

**This is a full time, salaried, hybrid position, based out of Milwaukee, Wisconsin.


Job Summary
This job will establish and build the cloud engineering capability at Children's Wisconsin, beginning with Microsoft Azure and extending to AWS as organizational priorities develop. This hands on functional manager will drive the architecture and engineering of cloud foundations, build infrastructure automation, and establish the team and operating practices needed to deliver and support cloud services. The role will create secure, reliable, recoverable, and financially accountable cloud platforms that enable clinical, business, and analytics initiatives.

Essential Functions

  • Cloud architecture and foundation build. Designs, builds, and validates the initial Azure platform and landing zones. Establishes subscription organization, identity integration, access controls, networking, policy, logging, and resource standards with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and Infrastructure. Documents design decisions, dependencies, and tradeoffs and implements approved designs through working code.
  • Analytics platform enablement. Leads the architecture and hands on implementation of the Azure infrastructure and supporting services needed for CW’s analytics environment, including integration with Microsoft Fabric. Partners with Analytics, Network Engineering, and Information Security to establish private connectivity, identity and access integration, DNS, monitoring, deployment automation, and cost controls. Establishes clear support responsibilities and production readiness for development, test, and production environments.
  • Automation and infrastructure as code. Authors and maintains reusable infrastructure modules, deployment pipelines, and configuration automation using Terraform, GitHub, Ansible, or equivalent tools. Establishes version control, pull request review, automated validation, environment promotion, infrastructure state management, and secure handling of secrets. Creates repeatable provisioning and change processes that reduce manual configuration and drift.
  • Data center migration. Develops and executes a phased approach for moving selected workloads from on premises data centers to cloud platforms after the initial analytics foundation is established. Assesses workload dependencies, technical suitability, operating costs, security, and recovery requirements with infrastructure and application owners. Leads migration engineering, testing, cutover, rollback planning, and operational transition, including retirement of replaced infrastructure when appropriate.
  • Hands on engineering and delivery. Builds, configures, tests, and troubleshoots cloud infrastructure and platform services. Takes work from incomplete requirements through design, implementation, and operational readiness. Establishes practical engineering patterns and onboarding methods that other teams can use. Remains directly involved in complex engineering and code review as the team grows.
  • Hybrid connectivity and workload enablement. Partners with network engineers on private connectivity, routing, DNS, segmentation, and access between CW and Azure. Works with application, analytics, and security teams to establish platform requirements, dependencies, and support boundaries. Engineers approved foundations for workload deployment and migration, including connectivity for analytics and data services.
  • Operational readiness. Builds monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, patching, and incident response into platform delivery. Defines service ownership, support procedures, escalation paths, and coverage with partner teams before production use. Tests restoration and recovery, resolves platform incidents, and addresses recurring failures through engineering improvements.
  • Team formation and people leadership. Develops staffing and skills plans and recruits and onboards engineers as positions are approved. Establishes expectations, coaches staff, evaluates performance, and addresses development needs. Builds shared ownership, peer review, and accountability for production outcomes.
  • Security and governance. Implements approved access, encryption, network, logging, and policy controls with Information Security. Establishes secure deployment defaults, maintains audit evidence, and remediates findings. Aligns cloud delivery with enterprise ITSM and architecture standards.
  • Planning and financial accountability. Develops the platform roadmap and prioritizes work against demand, risk, and capacity. Estimates implementation and consumption costs; establishes tagging, budgets, reporting, and optimization. Recommends staffing and investments and manages assigned spending and vendor deliverables within delegated authority.


Education

  • Bachelor's Degree Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field required
  • or relevant experience


Experience

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering experience, including substantial recent hands on architecture and engineering of production Azure environments. required
  • 5+ years prior experience personally taking an enterprise cloud environment from initial design through production operation, with direct responsibility for Azure foundation engineering. Experience must include establishing identity and access integration, network connectivity, governance controls, automated provisioning, monitoring, and operational support where those foundations were not already mature. required
  • 7+ years substantial hands on experience building and maintaining infrastructure as code, reusable modules, automated deployment pipelines, and configuration automation. Experience must include authoring and troubleshooting code, version control, review, testing, secure credential handling, and controlled deployment to production. required
  • 5+ years experience leading technical delivery and mentoring engineers. required
  • 5+ years experience building and managing engineering teams; direct use of Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Ansible; AWS engineering; cloud cost management; or support for analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric. required
  • Healthcare experience preferred


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to integrate cloud services with enterprise networks and identity systems, diagnose complex failures and explain design choices, risks and cost implications.
  • Ability to assume people management responsibilities as staffing grows and collaborate across architecture, security, operations and workload teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally design, implement, troubleshoot and operate cloud platforms
  • Proficiency with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code tooling GitHub or an equivalent Git based collaboration and pipeline platform and Ansible or equivalent configuration automation.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure resource organization, identity and access, networking, compute, storage, policy, monitoring and recovery.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous needs into build plans, document decisions and deliver working services with limited established processes.
  • Relevant Azure, AWS, DevOps or automation certifications are preferred

title: Solids Control Supervisor
description:
NOV Well Site Services (Nigeia) is looking for a Solids Control Supervisor to oversee the operation, maintenance, and optimisation of solids control equipment on customer drilling rigs. This is an exciting opportunity to work with industry-leading technology while supporting safe and efficient drilling operations.

What You'll Do

As a Solids Control Supervisor, you will:

    • Cuttings Dryers

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and equipment inventories.

We're looking for someone who combines technical expertise with a proactive, customer-focused approach.

  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office and email.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining excellent relationships with clients and colleagues.

About the Role

As a Technical Sales Engineer, you will support the Regional Account Manager in developing customer relationships, managing sales opportunities, and delivering commercial and technical support.

This role has been created to strengthen NOV’s local presence as our business continues to grow in Kazakhstan. You will play an important role in supporting customers, developing new business opportunities, and contributing to the expansion of our local operations, including the planned development of a local workshop.

Working closely with experienced Sales and technical professionals, you will gain hands-on experience across the full sales cycle and develop the skills required to progressively take on greater responsibility for customer accounts and sales opportunities.

As part of NOV, a global leader in energy technology, NOV Downhole Technologies provides advanced drilling, directional drilling, intervention, and completion technologies.

With a broad portfolio of downhole tools, equipment, and services, we work closely with customers throughout the well lifecycle to solve complex operational challenges and deliver reliable, fit-for-purpose solutions.

Why join NOV?

Join a well-established global company with a strong reputation in the energy industry. You will work closely with experienced Sales professionals, providing an excellent opportunity to learn the business, develop your skills, and build valuable industry experience.

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. title: Associate Software Engineer - Pathway (June 2027 & January 2027)
description:
NOV is actively recruiting ambitious college/university graduates for a Software Engineer role to be part of our Pathway Rotational Program within the Rig Technologies business unit located in Houston, Texas.

The NOV Pathway Rotational Program offers recent college graduates the opportunity to obtain meaningful work experiences through a structured one-year rotational program. The program is designed to help participants develop strong functional/technical expertise and business knowledge through challenging, hands-on assignments and exposure to various groups across NOV. Towards the end of the program, participants will work with their management support team to identify full-time positions that best suit individual skill sets as well as company needs.

Participants remain on one career track based on education and career interest. Each career track has its own training and experience-based learning objectives, and knowledge and performance are evaluated following each rotation. title: Allround Warehousemedewerker
description:
Over de functie

Ben jij iemand die graag werkt in een praktische omgeving waar nauwkeurigheid, teamwork en verantwoordelijkheid echt verschil maken?

Varco BJ B.V., onderdeel van NOV Inc., is op zoek naar een allround magazijnmedewerker om ons Supply Chain-team in Etten-Leur te versterken. In deze functie speel je een belangrijke rol bij het waarborgen dat materialen en componenten nauwkeurig worden ontvangen, opgeslagen en verwerkt ter ondersteuning van onze productieactiviteiten.

Als onderdeel van een hecht magazijnteam van vier collega's ben je betrokken bij een breed scala aan logistieke activiteiten, waaronder goederenontvangst, voorraadbeheer, materiaalbehandeling, orderpicken, verpakken en verzending. Deze functie is ideaal voor iemand die van afwisseling houdt, trots is op nauwkeurigheid en een carrière wil opbouwen binnen logistiek en supply chain-activiteiten.

Pas afgestudeerden met de juiste instelling en de bereidheid om te leren worden aangemoedigd om te solliciteren.

Over NOV

NOV (NYSE: NOV) levert technologiegedreven oplossingen voor de wereldwijde energiesector. Met aanwezigheid in meer dan 60 landen ontwerpt, produceert en ondersteunt NOV apparatuur en technologieën die klanten helpen om wereldwijd veilig en efficiënt energie te produceren.

Varco BJ B.V., gevestigd in Etten-Leur, is gespecialiseerd in de productie van hijs- en klemapparatuur voor de olie- en gasboorindustrie. Onze locatie combineert internationale expertise met een samenwerkende lokale cultuur waarin teamwork, veiligheid en voortdurende verbetering zeer gewaardeerd worden.

Wat wij bieden

  • De mogelijkheid om deel uit te maken van een stabiele, internationale organisatie met een sterke marktpositie.
  • Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma met praktische training door ervaren collega's.
  • Een ondersteunende en samenwerkende teamomgeving.
  • Kennismaking met internationale productie- en supply chain-activiteiten.
  • Mogelijkheden om vaardigheden te ontwikkelen op het gebied van magazijnwerk, logistiek, ERP en voorraadbeheer.
  • Een werkplek waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, teamwork en verantwoordelijkheid elke dag gewaardeerd worden.

Waarom bij ons werken?

  • Deze functie biedt meer dan alleen een magazijnfunctie: het is een mogelijkheid om je carrière op te bouwen binnen een wereldwijde organisatie die ontwikkeling, teamwork en operationele uitmuntendheid waardeert.
  • Of je nu een ervaren magazijnprofessional bent of een gemotiveerde afgestudeerde die op zoek is naar een eerste stap in de logistiek, je krijgt training, ondersteuning en mogelijkheden om te groeien. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega's, draagt rechtstreeks bij aan ons productiesucces en wordt onderdeel van een bedrijf dat investeert in zijn mensen en hun toekomst.
  • Klaar om de volgende stap in je logistieke carrière te zetten? We horen graag van je.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

  • Binnenkomende goederen ontvangen en hoeveelheden controleren aan de hand van pakbonnen en inkooporders.
  • Visuele inspecties uitvoeren van binnenkomende materialen en gereedschappen.
  • Goederen nauwkeurig en binnen de vastgestelde termijnen in het ERP-systeem verwerken en registreren.
  • Materialen veilig en correct in het magazijn opslaan.
  • Materialen voor interne en externe klanten verzamelen, verpakken en gereedmaken.
  • Ondersteunen bij voorraadbeheeractiviteiten, waaronder cyclustellingen en voorraadcontroles.
  • Voorraadverschillen onderzoeken en rapporteren.
  • Kits samenstellen met kleine onderdelen en materialen voor productiebehoeften.
  • Magazijnmaterieel, waaronder heftrucks, veilig bedienen.
  • Een schoon, georganiseerd en veilig magazijn onderhouden.
  • Alle bedrijfsbeleidsregels, kwaliteitsnormen en HSE-procedures volgen.

Aanvullende verantwoordelijkheden

  • Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen de magazijnactiviteiten ondersteunen.
  • Collega's binnen logistieke en supply chain-activiteiten helpen wanneer dat nodig is.
  • Bijdragen aan het handhaven van een hoge voorraadnauwkeurigheid en operationele efficiëntie.

Essentiële kwalificaties

  • Opleiding op LBO/MBO-niveau, bij voorkeur in logistiek, of een gelijkwaardige combinatie van opleiding en ervaring.
  • Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal.
  • Sterke aandacht voor detail en toewijding aan nauwkeurigheid.
  • Proactieve instelling met de bereidheid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.
  • In staat om zelfstandig te werken en tegelijkertijd effectief binnen een team samen te werken.
  • Voelt zich prettig bij het werken in een magazijn- en productieomgeving.

Gewenste kwalificaties

  • Geldig heftruckcertificaat.
  • Ervaring in een magazijn-, logistieke, productie- of supply chain-omgeving.
  • Ervaring met Oracle E-Business Suite (Oracle EBS) of andere ERP-systemen.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Ervaring met voorraadbeheer, goederenontvangst, voorraadcontrole en processen voor cyclustellingen.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden

Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie, toon je het volgende:

  • Sterke aandacht voor detail en nauwkeurigheid.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
  • Een praktische en hands-on aanpak.
  • Goede organisatorische vaardigheden.
  • In staat om effectief onder druk te werken en tegelijkertijd de kwaliteit te handhaven.
  • Teamgerichte houding met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Toewijding aan veiligheid en voortdurende verbetering.

title: Test Engineer
description:
As a Test Engineer, you will be part of our seven-person QC/Test team supporting the inspection, testing and quality assurance of equipment at our repair facility in Søgne and at supplier locations.

This is a practical, technically focused role combining mechanical and hydraulic knowledge with inspection, testing, documentation and stakeholder interaction. You will work both independently and as part of an experienced multidisciplinary team, collaborating with customers, suppliers and third parties such as classification societies.

Your development will be primarily hands-on. You will build knowledge of NOV equipment, procedures and applicable standards by working alongside experienced colleagues and participating in equipment overhaul and testing activities. Our aim is for you to develop toward independently acting as a Test Lead for equipment you have been trained on, taking responsibility for conducting tests with customers and third parties.

The team offers broad technical exposure across quality, mechanical and hydraulic systems, electrical systems, PLC/software and engineering. Previous team members have developed further into areas including technical engineering, hydraulics, PLC/software and project engineering.

  • Perform inspections and quality-control activities on equipment at our Søgne repair facility and at supplier locations.
  • Prepare equipment for testing and perform testing in accordance with relevant procedures and requirements.
  • Develop toward independently leading equipment tests involving customers and third-party/classification representatives.
  • Follow up with customers, suppliers and classification societies throughout inspection and testing activities.
  • Prepare clear and accurate inspection and test documentation and reports.
  • Support equipment overhaul activities where required to build and apply practical equipment knowledge.
  • Maintain a strong focus on quality, accuracy and HSE throughout all activities.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of the QC/Test team, with occasional travel primarily within the local region and, when required, internationally.
  • Bachelor’s degree or other higher education, preferably with experience from the offshore industry. Extensive relevant experience/practical competence may compensate for formal education.
  • Forklift and overhead crane certification and experience would be an advantage.
  • Strong technical understanding and know-how.
  • Good ability to read and understand technical drawings, along with good computer skills.
  • Good written and spoken Norwegian and English.
  • PLC experience would be an advantage.
  • Trade certification in mechanics and/or hydraulics, as well as welding, would be an advantage.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience.

What we offer

  • Hands-on learning alongside a highly experienced, multidisciplinary technical team.
  • Broad exposure to NOV equipment, testing procedures and industry standards.
  • Opportunities to develop deeper expertise in areas such as hydraulics, PLC/software and technical engineering.
  • Potential career development into technical engineering, project engineering and other technical roles within NOV.

title: HR Central Supervisor
description:
The role focuses on leading the delivery of HR administrative services across the employee lifecycle within the HR Shared Services function, ensuring service delivery to internal and external customers is accurate, efficient, and aligned with agreed SLAs, performance metrics, and service standards.

The HR Central Supervisor will oversee day-to-day HR service delivery activities, including employee onboarding, employee lifecycle transactions, and terminations. Responsibilities include team leadership, workload management, process governance, stakeholder engagement, Help Desk ticket management, HR systems administration, data reporting, and continuous process improvement.

The Supervisor will work closely with HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Benefits teams, and other business stakeholders to ensure employee data is maintained accurately within HR systems and that all employee lifecycle transactions are processed in line with payroll deadlines, compliance requirements, and organizational standards.

The role requires strong leadership, operational oversight, problem-solving ability, and customer service focus. The successful candidate will be responsible for coaching and developing HR Central Representatives, monitoring operational performance, managing escalations, and driving consistency across HR administrative processes while supporting the ongoing development of the HR Central function.

The HR Central Supervisor will report directly to the Regional HR Central Manager.

  • Lead a team of administrators to deliver key HR processes as part of the Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle and Termination activities.
  • Coordinate the day-to-day activities of the HR Central Representative roles.
  • Ensure Help Desk requests are monitored and distributed across the team to achieve optimum performance against SLAs.
  • Ensure the team is appropriately staffed and upskilled to meet service delivery demands, including supporting training activities and onboarding documentation for new team members.
  • Provide direction, coaching, mentoring, and performance oversight to administrators.
  • Ensure team performance is measured and monitored in line with service delivery SLAs and KPIs, and take appropriate action where performance does not meet expectations.
  • Act as the second-level escalation point for urgent requests, customer issues, and service delivery concerns, providing support and resolution as required.
  • Manage relationships between HR Central, Regional Payroll, and other key stakeholders through regular communication and feedback mechanisms.
  • Work with In-country HR, Regional Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Benefits teams to monitor and streamline HR administrative processes in line with the wider HR service offering.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure contractual templates, job-specific checklists, work instructions, and documentation are compliant and controlled in accordance with company standards.
  • Oversee improvements and implement best practices across HR Central and wider HR administrative processes.
  • Partner with other HR Central leads to share best practices and promote consistency and alignment of activities globally.
  • Utilize HR Help Desk reporting and analytics to identify trends, investigate issues, and recommend improvements to the employee experience.
  • Prepare and distribute operational and status reports to stakeholders, highlighting progress, risks, and blockers where appropriate.
  • Ensure HR system data integrity procedures are followed through regular audits, reviews, and adherence to established processes.
  • Provide operational input and support decision-making for projects, transition activities, and business-as-usual operations.
  • The successful candidate will work under the guidance of the Regional HR Central Manager, who will oversee workload priorities, operational objectives, and team performance expectations.
  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Up to 7 years of overall HR experience, including at least 2 years of experience within an HR Shared Services, HR Operations, HR Services, or HR Administration environment.
  • Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee changes, and termination activities.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced corporate environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience working within HR service delivery, shared services, help desk, or administrative support functions is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating team activities, mentoring colleagues, or supporting team performance objectives is preferred.
  • Experience working with KPI-driven service delivery environments and meeting performance targets and service standards.
  • Working knowledge of HRIS platforms, preferably Oracle HCM, or other enterprise HR systems.
  • Experience working with Help Desk, CRM, Service Management, or Ticket Management systems is preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience handling, validating, and reporting HR-related data.
  • Excellent attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with employees, stakeholders, and senior management.
  • Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for service delivery outcomes, resolving issues, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to coach, mentor, and support team members while fostering a collaborative and customer-focused work environment.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English language skills; additional language skills such as Spanish are advantageous.
  • Maintains a customer-centric mindset while ensuring service quality, operational excellence, and compliance with company procedures.

About Hy-Vee

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our Aisles Online program is one of the most important ways we make our customers' lives easier, and the Aisles Online Manager is the person who makes it run. In this role, you'll oversee the planning, staffing, and day-to-day operations of the store's online shopping fulfillment process, ensuring every order is picked, packed, and delivered on time and to the highest standard. You'll lead and develop your team, resolve customer service issues, and continuously look for ways to improve the experience.

If you're a strong organizer, a natural leader, and passionate about delivering a seamless customer experience, we'd love to have you on board.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting customers warmly, addressing their needs, and taking any steps necessary to resolve customer service issues

  • Oversee the order fulfillment process from start to finish, continually monitoring incoming online orders to ensure prompt, on-time fulfillment

  • Recruit, train, schedule, and develop department employees to maintain a high-performing, customer-focused team

  • Provide ongoing education to employees regarding new policies, procedures, and best practices

  • Ensure all food safety guidelines are followed and products are kept at proper temperature throughout the fulfillment process

  • Instruct, assign, and review the work of others; coordinate activities and address employee concerns as needed

  • Have authority to recommend employee discipline

  • Answer phones and emails promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer and team experience

  • Lead, motivate, and develop a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, team members, and vendors through verbal and written correspondence

  • Identify problems and develop practical, timely solutions

  • Navigate computer systems confidently, including word processing, spreadsheet, email applications, and job-specific programs

  • Stay highly organized and manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously

  • Handle confidential information including sales reports, pricing, profit and loss data, and operational information with discretion

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, Health Wellness Home

Direct Reports: Department Employees

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred

  • Strong computer and internet skills required

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with constant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple projects throughout your shift. You'll work primarily in a retail store setting and may be exposed to dust, noise, temperature extremes, moving equipment hazards, and electrical equipment. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: ITGC SOX Lead
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description

ITGC SOX Lead

As a member of IT GRC, you will play a key role in maintaining 3M’s SOX compliance. It will challenge you to quickly learn new technologies and processes, cultivate partnerships across the organization, critically think through risks and controls, assess effectiveness of those controls, and influence others to take action. Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • SOX ITGC Compliance:
    • Conduct controls rationalization for IT assets to identify areas of non-compliance.
    • Support the design of SOX IT controls and application controls.
    • Assist control owners with the documentation of SOX IT controls related to systems and processes.
    • Assist control owners in ensuring control deficiencies have been remediated.
  • Policies, Standards and Procedure Development:
    • Contribute to the development and maintenance IT policies, standards, procedures, and control matrices to support SOX compliance.
    • Provide support and training to IT and business units on SOX IT control requirements and best practices.
  • Documentation and Reporting:
    • Track the progress of SOX IT control execution and testing results.
    • Support monitoring the status of SOX IT compliance efforts and identified control deficiencies.
    • Support tracking of the remediation efforts for control deficiencies and ensure timely resolution.
  • Collaboration and Coordination:
    • Collaborate with the control owners to support the implementation of effective SOX IT controls across relevant IT assets.
    • Assist in coordination with internal audit and external auditors to facilitate SOX IT testing.
    • Support facilitation between IT, business, and external auditors to ensure clear communication and effective audit coordination.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Support control owners to enhance SOX IT control and processes while ensuring risks are mitigated.

Qualifications:

  • Education:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
    • Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC) preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT audit, IT compliance, or a related field with a focus on SOX compliance.
    • In-depth knowledge and experience in SOX programs and application of ITGC and IT application controls.
    • Experience using the GRC tool preferred, such as, Archer, Workiva, Audit Board.
  • Skills:
    • Strong understanding of ITGC frameworks and best practices (e.g., COSO, COBIT, ITIL).
    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Proficiency in IT auditing tools and technologies used for control monitoring and assessment.
    • Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop trusted business relationships.
    • Ability to identify problems, analyze data and present conclusions.
    • Ability to lead down, across, and up, in order to influence desired outcomes.

Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Twitter @3M.

title: Manager, Business Continuity
description:
What You’ll Do

The Manager, Business Continuity, is responsible for supporting Americold’s enterprise-wide business continuity. Operational resilience, crisis management, and IT disaster recovery programs. This role develops and executes strategies that enable the organization to prevent, prepare for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions across a global network of temperature-controlled facilities, transportation operations, and corporate functions. The position partners closely with executive leadership, technology, operations, safety, security, and risk management teams to strengthen organizational resilience, protect critical business processes, and ensure continuity of service for customers.

Essential Functions

  • Support the enterprise Business Continuity Management (BCM)/Business Resiliency program, including governance, policies, standards, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience building or maturing a BC/DR program in a complex, multi-site, or global operations environment (e.g., supply chain, logistics) preferred
  • Facilitate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and enterprise risk assessments.
  • Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster recovery plans.
  • Establish and monitor Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
About the Role

As a Mechanical Technician, you will support our repair operations in Montrose by disassembling, inspecting, rebuilding, assembling, and testing mechanical equipment. You will work from engineering documentation and established procedures to ensure equipment is completed safely, accurately, and to the required quality standards.

Your contribution will help us deliver reliable equipment to our customers while supporting operational performance across safety, quality, cost, and delivery.

About NOV

NOV is a global provider of technology, equipment, and services supporting energy production and industrial operations. Through our engineering, manufacturing, service, and digital capabilities, we help customers improve operational performance, safety, reliability, and efficiency across drilling, offshore, marine, industrial, and energy applications worldwide.

What We Offer

At NOV, you will work in a practical, team-oriented environment where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are central to how we operate. You will have opportunities to develop your technical capability through hands-on experience, our competency programme, and exposure to a range of NOV equipment and repair activities.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Disassemble, inspect, rebuild, assemble, and test mechanical equipment in accordance with NOV procedures and engineering requirements.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, bills of materials, work instructions, and other technical documentation.
  • Use engineering measuring equipment, including micrometers, Vernier gauges, and dial indicators, to verify components and assemblies.
  • Complete equipment testing and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) in accordance with applicable procedures.
  • Maintain accurate job documentation, including QA plans, workscopes, inspection and test reports, build sheets, and other required records.
  • Identify product defects and non-conformances, complete the appropriate documentation, and support troubleshooting and root-cause problem solving.
  • Rework or repair equipment and components in accordance with approved engineering specifications and changes.
  • Safely operate designated workshop equipment and ensure components move correctly through the workflow and designated staging areas.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement activities supporting safety, quality, cost, delivery, and operational performance.
  • Maintain high standards of housekeeping and actively participate in team briefings, toolbox talks, safety activities, and the NOV competency programme.

Essential Qualifications

  • A time-served apprenticeship, HNC, or equivalent relevant mechanical qualification or practical experience.
  • Relevant hands-on mechanical experience gained within an industrial, manufacturing, heavy equipment, energy, aerospace, or comparable technical environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical instructions.
  • Practical experience using precision measuring equipment such as micrometers, Vernier gauges, and dial indicators.
  • Ability to inspect, assemble, repair, and troubleshoot mechanical equipment or components.
  • Strong commitment to safe working practices, quality standards, and accurate documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a workshop team and communicate clearly with colleagues and supervisors.
  • Practical problem-solving capability and willingness to contribute to continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with pressure equipment or hydraulic systems.
  • Experience with equipment testing or Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).
  • Previous experience within oil and gas, energy equipment, heavy machinery, industrial manufacturing, or another relevant engineering environment.
  • Experience with structured problem-solving or root-cause analysis techniques.
  • Working knowledge of standard computer applications used for documentation and reporting.

title: Principal Drill String Advisor
description:
As a Principal Drill String Advisor, you will play a key role in NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions' global Wired Drill Pipe strategy, supporting the safe, reliable and efficient deployment of WDP assets.

This is a highly customer-facing technical advisory position, combining extensive drill string knowledge with a practical understanding of drilling operations and customer requirements. You will work directly with drilling operators and contractors to evaluate equipment performance, investigate failures and provide objective technical recommendations that improve operational reliability and asset utilization.

An important part of the role involves navigating technically complex and sometimes sensitive customer discussions, particularly when recommendations require changes to established procedures or ways of working. Your ability to understand operational challenges from the customer's perspective, communicate findings clearly and build confidence in technical recommendations will be essential.

Initially, your focus will be on supporting key customers, including Aker BP and Equinor, while contributing to the longer-term strategy for managing and optimizing NOV's global Wired Drill Pipe fleet. Based in Stavanger, the role involves primarily domestic travel, with occasional international travel to locations such as the US and Middle East.

  • Serve as a principal technical advisor for Wired Drill Pipe assets, providing expert guidance to customers and internal teams on drill string performance, reliability and operational best practices.
  • Advise drilling operators and contractors on pipe selection, drill string configurations, deployment strategies, torque and drag considerations, and operational risk management.
  • Lead technical investigations into drill pipe failures, fatigue, wear, conductor issues and other reliability concerns, identifying root causes and recommending practical corrective actions.
  • Work closely with customers to assess equipment performance and recommend improvements to operational procedures, inspection practices and ways of working, including in technically sensitive situations.
  • Support WDP fleet management and asset lifecycle optimization, including utilization, inspection, maintenance, repair and long-term fleet planning.
  • Promote the effective adoption and use of NOV asset management solutions, including Max Tracker and TallyMaster, to improve asset visibility and operational decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Grant Prideco, engineering and product development teams to provide structured feedback on product performance, field experience, technical challenges and potential design improvements.
  • Support customer workshops, technical reviews, training and business development activities, communicating complex technical information clearly to both technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Act as a key technical link between customers, drilling operations, project teams, engineering and product specialists to ensure consistent application of best practices and lessons learned.

Required

  • Extensive experience in drill pipe operations, drilling, fleet management or asset integrity.
  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of drill string mechanics, pipe performance, inspection standards and failure mechanisms.
  • Ability to investigate equipment failures and provide practical, objective technical recommendations.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to influence operational decisions and changes to procedures.
  • Professional English proficiency and willingness to travel.

Preferred

  • Experience with drilling operators, contractors, drill pipe owners or inspection companies.
  • Knowledge of Wired Drill Pipe technology and drill pipe manufacturers' products.
  • Experience in subsea drilling operations, regardless of geographical region.
