title: Refrigeration Technician I
description:
What You'll Do

You will perform refrigeration operations and preventative maintenance throughout the warehouse to support operational objectives. Responsibilities include troubleshooting and repairing industrial mechanical and electrical systems as needed, as well as providing general maintenance support to ensure equipment reliability and safety. Flexible shifts and on-call work may be required.

Essential Functions

  • Operate and perform repairs and adjustments on refrigeration systems.
  • Monitor system performance and identify operational issues.
  • Conduct routine maintenance on warehouse equipment in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Troubleshoot equipment and recommend corrective actions.
  • Test, maintain, and evaluate equipment performance using appropriate instruments.
  • Maintain tools and machinery in good condition and ensure proper use.
  • Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records and uphold housekeeping standards in the work area.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • Minimum 2 years of refrigeration or maintenance experience required.
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • HVAC/R certification or technical degree required if experience is not met.
  • Successful completion of assigned industrial refrigeration or mechanical-electrical courses required.
  • HAZMAT training and certification required.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working in a cold storage environment.
  • Experience using testing equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose refrigeration equipment at the component level.
  • Experience using Oracle Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Technical certification or degree preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Adaptability to flexible shifts including on-call assignments.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures of minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius) and outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold, and precipitation).
  • Able to work at heights in excess of 30 ft. (9 meters) and access elevated platforms, catwalks, and roofs.
  • Able to work in confined areas.
  • Able to climb ladders and stairs.
  • Able frequently to stand, walk, push, pull, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, and/or crouch.
  • Able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds (23 kg) frequently.
  • Able to operate hand and power tools safely.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job including close vision, distance vision, color vision, and depth perception. (Use of contacts are prohibited when working with ammonia.)
  • Depending on specific role, able to pass a physical and respiratory/respirator fit exam.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for any/all tasks.

title: System Engineer - Solution Integrations
description:
Responsibilities

Reference Architecture and Technical Baseline

  • Own technical readiness across DaaS and partner application integrations.
  • Define repeatable architecture patterns for industrial data services across edge systems, control system data, cloud services, partner platforms, customer endpoints, and platform services.
  • Create reference architectures, integration diagrams, data flow views, deployment patterns, validation plans, and technical readiness checklists.
  • Define the technical baseline for secure data acquisition, buffering, monitoring, cloud processing, customer delivery, and steady state support.
  • Identify integration gaps, network constraints, cybersecurity requirements, vendor dependencies, and operational risks before PoCs or pilots begin.

Cybersecurity and OT Readiness

  • Create reusable cybersecurity and OT evidence packages for customer IT and OT reviews.
  • Maintain standard topology diagrams, data flow diagrams, firewall rule templates, DMZ, VLAN, VPN, and routing patterns, identity and access assumptions, logging evidence, and remote access patterns.
  • Support customer cybersecurity, MoC, and OT approval processes with clear technical documentation and repeatable review artifacts.
  • Ensure integration patterns account for segmentation, auditability, hardening, patching, remote access, change control, and customer approval expectations.

Data Standards and Assurance

  • Define standards for source to target data assurance, data mapping, customer naming conventions, unit handling, latency, completeness, frequency, validity, and source versus target comparison.
  • Define how data quality signals are monitored, surfaced, alerted, and acted on across internal teams and customer facing workflows.
  • Support standards for historical backfill, replay, corrected history workflows, local versus cloud historian boundaries, and customer delivery validation.
  • Create reusable templates for customer standards management, data mapping, endpoint setup, and delivery validation.

Pre PoC Validation and Technical Gates

  • Define pre PoC validation gates for customer and partner opportunities.
  • Validate that required systems, data sources, endpoints, access paths, network assumptions, and support expectations are understood before delivery begins.
  • Create repeatable technical validation plans for PoCs, pilots, partner integrations, and production deployments.
  • Develop repeatable validation procedures, troubleshooting methodologies, and diagnostic playbooks that improve deployment success, reduce integration risk, and accelerate issue resolution.
  • Provide clear go or no go input when technical readiness is incomplete or customer commitments create delivery risk.

Vendor and Partner Coordination

  • Work with vendors and partner engineering teams to define integration responsibilities, data handoffs, technical boundaries, support expectations, and escalation paths.
  • Define how partner platforms fit into the NOV service wrapper for industrial data acquisition, data delivery, video, file workflows, operational communications, analytics, and customer endpoints.
  • Translate partner capabilities and constraints into practical implementation plans for NOV teams and customer facing stakeholders.
  • Track vendor readiness risks and make unresolved dependencies visible early.
  • Help turn recurring partner integration patterns into reusable templates and documented standards.

Edge to Cloud Flow and Customer Delivery

  • Support architecture and readiness for data movement from edge environments into cloud services, platform APIs, customer applications, partner systems, or external delivery endpoints.
  • Validate end to end data flows, connectivity, access, authentication, security, monitoring, and operational handoff requirements across edge systems, networks, cloud services, APIs, partner platforms, and customer environments.
  • Lead technical investigations and troubleshooting activities across edge, network, cloud, partner, and customer environments to identify and resolve integration, connectivity, deployment, and data quality issues before and during customer delivery.
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations, implementation, support, SRE, cybersecurity, and customer facing teams to make deployments repeatable and supportable.
  • Reduce one off delivery by documenting common integration patterns, technical assumptions, and deployment requirements.
  • Drive technical improvements that reduce dual stack complexity, manual mapping, custom connector work, and one off deployment risk.

Technical Documentation and Governance

  • Maintain integration documentation, readiness checklists, technical decision records, and reusable implementation templates.
  • Define standards for what technical evidence is required before customer or partner execution begins.
  • Turn lessons from PoCs, pilots, and partner deployments into improved architecture patterns, validation gates, and implementation guidance.
  • Maintain reusable artifacts for customer reviews, internal readiness checks, partner onboarding, and steady state support.

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Technology, Data Systems, or related field.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, integration engineering, solution engineering, technical architecture, industrial digital systems, or customer facing technical delivery.
  • Experience designing or validating integrations across edge systems, cloud services, APIs, data flows, partner systems, and customer delivery endpoints.
  • Experience with industrial data systems, operational data flows, OT and IT integration, industrial edge and cloud platforms, or rig and site data environments.
  • Experience working with vendors, partners, engineering teams, implementation teams, support teams, and customer facing stakeholders.
  • Strong technical fluency across edge to cloud architectures, networking, APIs, authentication, observability, cybersecurity, and operational data systems, including experience troubleshooting connectivity, security, data quality, and integration issues in distributed OT and IT environments.
  • Working knowledge of networking and OT and IT concepts such as TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, VPNs, DMZ design, segmentation, and secure remote access.
  • Working knowledge of industrial data protocols and interfaces such as WITSML, ETP, WITS, OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, REST APIs, customer historians, or industrial data platforms.
  • Experience with data quality concepts such as latency, completeness, frequency, validity, source versus target comparison, mapping, units of measure, and real time data workflows.
  • Strong Linux administration and command line troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience using API and network diagnostic tools such as Postman, curl, Wireshark, tcpdump, and related troubleshooting utilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze logs, validate end to end data flows, isolate root causes, and drive technical issues to resolution across complex distributed systems.
  • Experience identifying technical readiness risks before customer PoCs, pilots, or deployments begin.
  • Ability to create reference architectures, data flow diagrams, validation plans, integration checklists, and technical decision records.
  • Strong understanding of network, cybersecurity, access, data quality, auditability, service operations, and supportability considerations in integration heavy environments.
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to technical teams, commercial stakeholders, partners, and customer facing teams.
  • Strong bias toward repeatable patterns, documentation, validation, and reducing one off integration work.
  • Experience leveraging AI assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting, architecture reviews, integration design, documentation, and solution validation while applying sound engineering judgment to validate results.

title: Customs Compliance Specialist
description:
Job Requisition: U.S. Customs Compliance Specialist

Position Overview: We are seeking a knowledgeable and detail-oriented U.S. Customs Compliance Specialist with expertise in policy and procedure implementation. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that our company's import activities comply with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) regulations. This role requires an ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing an openness to learn and understand new concepts and evolving frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Policy & Procedure Implementation: Implement NOV’s customs compliance policies & procedures across all relevant departments, ensuring adherence to regulations and minimizing the risk of non-compliance.
  2. Customs Entry Processing: Oversee the timely and accurate preparation & submission of customs entries, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and requirements.
  3. Entry Review & Monitoring: Conduct regular post entry reviews and assessments to evaluate accuracy of our Customs brokers, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as necessary.
  4. Broker Management: Manage relationships with customs brokers and other service providers, ensuring that they meet established performance standards and comply with all contractual obligations.
  5. Training and Education: Provide training and education to employees involved in import activities to ensure awareness of customs compliance requirements and promote a culture of compliance throughout the organization.
  6. Documentation Management: Oversee the maintenance of accurate and complete customs documentation, including import records, classifications, valuation, and duty calculations.
  7. Regulatory Compliance: Implement procedural changes in response to instructions from management regarding regulatory policy shifts.
  8. Collaboration: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including supply chain, legal, finance, and operations teams, to ensure alignment of customs compliance efforts with overall business objectives.
  9. Other: Other duties as deemed necessary by the Customs Compliance Manager and/or Director

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years of working experience, preferably in a Compliance role.
  • Understanding of U.S. Customs regulations, including Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification, valuation, country of origin rules, and free trade agreements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex customs compliance concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Customs Specialist) are a plus.
  • Intermediate level Excel
  • Experience navigating ERP and Work Management systems.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Must be willing to work flexible hours to accommodate business needs.

title: Cybersecurity IAM Engineer
description:
Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina
Language requirement: Fluent English (spoken and written)

We are seeking a Cybersecurity IAM Engineer to design, implement, and optimize identity and access solutions across our global infrastructure. This role plays a key part in securing user and system identities across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM, enabling secure digital operations while enforcing Zero Trust and least privilege at scale.

As an IAM Engineer, you'll go beyond processing tickets—you'll build automations, optimize SSO and federation integrations, enforce policy controls through scripting, and work with cross-functional teams to secure identity lifecycles across IT and OT environments. Come and join a great team who are driving tomorrow’s cybersecurity.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain IAM solutions across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM
  • Integrate and manage SSO and MFA for cloud and on-prem applications using SAML, OAuth, WS-Federation, and SCIM
  • Automate identity workflows, group assignments, access revocations, and certification campaigns using tools like PowerShell, Python, or Okta Workflows
  • Enforce access controls aligned to Zero Trust, RBAC, and JML (Joiner-Mover-Leaver) lifecycle policies
  • Harden IAM configurations in hybrid environments (e.g., password policies, conditional access, privileged account handling)
  • Participate in the evaluation and integration of IAM-related technologies and security enhancements
  • Collaborate with IT, cloud, HRIS, and security engineering teams to embed identity governance in enterprise systems
  • Assist with privileged access management (PAM), identity federation design, and directory service integrations
  • Support audit and compliance efforts by maintaining evidence, resolving control gaps, and improving access visibility
  • Other duties as assigned by organization leadership

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 4–8 years of professional experience.
  • Possess strong communications and interpersonal skills in English
  • Self-directed, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Strong ability to work collaboratively with others, to influence based on knowledge and experience
  • Strong experience with identity platforms: Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, AWS IAM
  • Hands-on knowledge of authentication standards: SAML, OAuth, OIDC, WS-Federation
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Experience with identity lifecycle automation, group policy management, and access governance tooling
  • Working knowledge of federated identity, MFA, conditional access, and directory sync processes
  • Familiarity with IAM-related components of frameworks like NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Okta, Azure, CompTIA Security+, or similar
  • Experience with identity governance platforms
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or SOX
  • Experience with identity governance platforms and PAM solutions
  • Familiarity with AI or LLM tooling for identity analytics, automation, or anomaly detection

Why NOV?

  • Build identity security controls at global scale for a diversified energy and technology leader
  • Be part of a security team driving Zero Trust transformation across IT and OT
  • Use modern IAM platforms with the freedom to innovate and automate

About NOV

NOV delivers technology-driven solutions to empower the global energy industry. For more than 150 years, NOV has pioneered innovations that enable its customers to safely produce abundant energy while minimizing environmental impact. The energy industry depends on NOV’s deep expertise and technology to continually improve oilfield operations and assist in efforts to advance the energy transition towards a more sustainable future.

At NOV, we are a globally diverse happy family, driven to power the people who power the world.

As a Baker, you'll be responsible for preparing and baking the products that fill our cases and fulfill our customers' orders every day. From proofing and frying to pulling from the freezer and leading bakery clerks, your skill and attention to detail directly shape the quality our customers experience.

If you take pride in your craft, thrive in a fast-paced kitchen environment, and enjoy being part of a hardworking team, we'd love to have you on board.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile and assisting them with their needs throughout the store

  • Check orders for the day and set up a timeline and production schedule, prioritizing special and future orders as needed

  • Prepare, make up, bake, and fry all department products, proofing items as necessary and pulling product from the freezer or cooler

  • Review product for freshness and pull by stale date; anticipate product needs not only for the current day but for subsequent days

  • Inspect incoming products for quality and quantity, including identifying mispicks

  • Invoice and put away product as instructed by the Department Manager

  • Check signage for correct labels on ad items and review the department for potential safety issues

  • Understand the use and maintenance needs of bakery equipment and follow up on potential issues

  • Operate as a lead with bakery clerks, providing guidance and direction

  • Review current product on the shelf, re-merchandise as needed, and remove or recycle outdated products

  • Order supplies and merchandise items for the department as directed by the Bakery Manager

  • Write the department schedule and ensure coverage in the Bakery Manager's absence

  • Practice proper sanitation procedures and keep the work area clean, neat, and safe at all times

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call, including taking product orders

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding customer and team experience

  • Solve practical problems and make sound decisions with a variety of variables and limited standardization

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Lead and guide bakery clerks, providing direction and maintaining department standards

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Handle confidential information including sales with discretion

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Perishables, Store Operations, Health Wellness Home; Bakery Department Manager

Direct Reports: Apprentice Baker, Bakery Designer, Wrapper, Fryer

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent experience; department training is helpful

  • Over six months up to one year of similar or related experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines throughout your shift. You'll work in the bakery department and can expect continual exposure to flour, noise, and temperature extremes, as well as frequent exposure to dampness, vibrations, and equipment movement hazards, and occasional exposure to cleaning chemicals and solvents. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

The Planner is responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of production planning and coordinates workflow for the machine shop while prioritizing operations to ensure maximum performance.

  • Proactively communicate with all key stakeholders any deviations of manufacturing planning schedule from customer required dates including mitigation plans when dates are not met.

  • Interacts between Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, and Order Management groups to ensure effective inventory levels and customer satisfaction while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Maintains Manufacturing Completion / Schedule Date(s) in the ERP system.
  • Primary operations contact for ATP / CTP (Available-To-Promise / Capable-To-Promise) for all sales quotations and promise dates to all customers. The Planner commits to customer orders on behalf of the factory. Once committed, it is the Planner that takes responsibility and ownership for achieving the order commitment to the customer and holds himself/herself, together with the planning and purchasing teams, personally accountable for achieving OTD (On Time Delivery).
  • Identifies excess and obsolete materials and uses same as a substitute where applicable.

title: Manager II, Engineering & Maintenance
description:
What You'll Do:

The Engineering & Maintenance Manager 2 (EMM-2) manages the daily maintenance activities across multiple warehouses and/or at a single larger warehouse with greater complexities. Typically, these warehouses are composed of a 400,000 square feet or larger footprint, a material handling fleet of 50 or more assets and may include other operational activities/equipment for repacking, E-Commerce or automation as examples. This position maintains safe, compliant, reliable and functional facilities by directing installation, maintenance and repair of machines, tools, equipment, and utility systems for refrigerated warehouses.

Essential Function:

• Directs and assigns work; sets performance objectives and monitors the performance of all Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) associates.
• Achieves financial objectives by preparing an annual maintenance budget; scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; and initiating corrective actions.
• Supports operations productivity by determining work priorities and scheduling repair, maintenance, and installation of machines, tools, and equipment.
• Designs, implements, and modifies preventive maintenance programs by reviewing production, quality control, and maintenance reports and statistics, inspecting operating machines, equipment, and systems for conformance with operational standards.
• Ensures compliance with all OSHA regulations and PSM requirements.
• Ensures compliance with mechanical, electrical and all other municipal and state codes.
• Protects employees and visitors by maintaining a safe and clean working environment.
• Ensures equipment reliability by maintaining & analyzing “Maintenance One Pager Reports” and initiating action plans to drive improvement.
• Ensures material handling equipment is clean, safe, fully operational and in good repair.
• Creates and executes a comprehensive energy plan, which includes: Energy consumption, defined rate goals, strategies, action plans, conservation plans and utilization effectiveness.
• Maintain a working knowledge of new technologies, which may improve operations and develops recommendations accordingly.
• Maintain a working knowledge of safety policies and regulations to ensure duties of self and others are performed in a safe manner.
• Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local environment, health, safety and HR regulations/procedures along with ensuring that all tasks are carried out in a safe and healthful manner with no adverse impact upon the environment.
• Works with General Manager/s to develop annual budgets
• Works with General Manager/s to ensure Departmental financial goals are met.
• Works with General Manager/s to Develop Capital Expense budgets and provide long term planning for facility and equipment improvements.
• Executes capital projects to completion. Including obtaining bids, creating and submitting capital requests, and managing contractors/vendors throughout the process.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

What Experience and Education You Need :

• Associates Degree or Higher relevant to facility maintenance preferred.
• CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional) or similar certification preferred.
• Completion of all eight (8) RETA courses preferred.

• Experience working 5-7+ years in maintenance with at least 3+ years’ directly managing or supervising the work of others.

What Could Set You Apart :

• Strong knowledge of industrial maintenance principles and best practices.
• Ability to manage employees and contractors.
• Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
• Ability to communicate effectively with a variety of individuals at different levels of the organization.
• Ability to reason, negotiate, instruct, persuade, or speak with others.
• Strong interpersonal skills and judgment in communicating with staff.
• Willingness to develop a mentoring relationship in order to contribute experience, skills and wisdom to subordinate employees for their development.
• Receptive to management development suggestions and willing to seek additional knowledge to facilitate job growth.
• Must have strong relationship skills, be able to provide and model leadership behaviors including the ability to defuse conflict. Relate to other people beyond giving and receiving instructions: they must get along with others without exhibiting behavioral extremes; perform work activities requiring reasoning, negotiating, instructing, persuading or speaking with others; and respond appropriately to criticism.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills.
• Proven ability to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously and fully grasp the priority of each task.
• Ability to interpret HR regulations, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedures manuals.
• Ability to solve complex problems and situations.
• Must have very strong customer service orientation with high sense of urgency in meeting objectives and deadlines.
• Fully competent to a high degree in mechanical knowledge and basic electrical concepts.

• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions, as well as interpret pencil sketches and diagrams.
• Ability to supervise and inspect work performed by all levels of maintenance associates.

title: Project Quality and Risk Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Project Quality and Risk Engineer is responsible for ensuring that engineering projects meet defined quality standards and comply with applicable regulations, while proactively identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks. This role bridges project management, quality assurance, and risk management to safeguard project performance and reliability.

About the Company

At NOV, we deliver safe, high-quality, technology-driven equipment, services, and support that are essential to the global energy industry. Our mission is simple: we power the industry that powers the world.

At NOV’s business unit Subsea Production Systems (SPS) we empower the energy sector with passion, expertise, and forward-thinking solutions. We develop reliable and efficient subsea energy production products that enhance our customers’ energy portfolios. With strong roots in the offshore oil and gas industry, we are also at the forefront of future technologies such as water treatment, ammonia storage, carbon injection, and wind energy—helping to reduce CO₂ emissions and drive the energy transition.

SPS is headquartered in Brøndby, Denmark, with production sites in Kalundborg (DK), Porto do Acu (Br), Glenrothes (UK) and offices in Stavanger and Oslo (No), Rio de Janeiro ( Br), and Houston (US). Globally, our team includes around 1,500 dedicated professionals, contributing to NOV’s workforce of approximately 34,000 employees.

What We Offer

This role offers the opportunity to build broad expertise across both project quality and risk management in an international engineering and manufacturing environment. You will work with varied projects, each bringing different technical, quality and risk challenges, creating continuous opportunities to learn and develop.

Risk wise

  • Work close and collaborate with all relevant internal process to rise risks and manage them.
  • Lead risk assessments to identify potential impacts and threats to NOV’s operation reliability and efficiency.
  • Support contingency planning when needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and up-to-date records of risk analyses, evaluations, and mitigation plans.
  • Support to develop and implement a Risk Assessment approach within relevant internal processes.
  • Prepare reports and communicate results of risk analyses and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
  • Develop controls and monitoring measures and follow-up on the implementation of mitigation plans and its effectiveness.
  • Prepare reports and communicate results summarizing risk status from quality perspective.
  • Provide training and awareness sessions on risk procedures.

Quality wise

  • Perform periodic Quality meetings with customer.
  • Perform on Tender Review.
  • Perform customer’s requirements review on “Contract Reviews”.
  • Perform NCR and QDR management.
  • Perform Customer’s satisfaction follow-up.
  • Manage and perform Customer’s Internal Quality Audit.
  • Prepare and issue Project Quality and Execution Plan (PQEP).
  • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and other relevant processes to integrate quality and risk management into all phases of the project.
  • Provide training and awareness sessions on quality procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, quality regulations and standards, industry standards, and company policies.
  • Conduct audits and quality checks throughout project phases.

Essential Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Relevant professional experience in quality, risk, project engineering or a related engineering environment.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Practical experience on root cause analyses.
  • Experience with relevant quality tools, such as Ishikawa Diagram, 5W2H, 5 Why, Pareto chart, PDAC, Control Graphs.
  • Experience with risk assessment methodologies and tools, including identifying, evaluating and classifying risks and defining mitigation actions.
  • Experience supporting or conducting internal and/or supplier audits.
  • Experience with Project Quality Management (meetings with customer, non-conformity treatment).
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience on creating PowerPoint presentations
  • Experience with Intermediate Excel as minimum

Desired Qualifications

  • Valid driving licence, supporting occasional travel to the Kalundborg site.
  • Experience on suppliers' management
  • Experience on API Q1
  • ISO 9001 training - reading and interpretation
  • ISO 9001 training - internal auditor
  • Experience with statistic tools
  • Experience with Dashboards' creation (PowerBI)
  • Fluency in Danish

description:
Job Description

Senior AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services

Focus: AI Transformation Services for CoCounsel and Thomson Reuters solutions

Giving a legal, tax, or trade team access to AI is the easy part. The real work is changing how the work gets done — and proving it made a difference.

As a Senior AI Transformation Consultant, you will lead that work hands on: finding the workflows worth changing, designing how they should run with AI, getting people to genuinely use them, and measuring what it delivers - with CoCounsel Legal and CoCounsel for Tax and Trade at the center. You’ll work embedded with client teams, alongside Sales, our AI engineers, enablement specialists, and product teams, from the first client conversation through rollout and measured value.

Key Responsibilities:

In this opportunity as Senior AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services, you will:

· Independently lead defined transformation engagements or bounded workstreams across the lifecycle, managing plans, workstreams, and client communication.

· Conduct targeted discovery through interviews, workshops, surveys, usage information, and operational measures; synthesize clear diagnoses, priority workflows, and next-step decisions.

· Map current and future-state workflows and develop practical, scoped plans for targeted changes, activation, adoption, risks, dependencies, and success measures.

· Capture baselines, analyze quantitative and qualitative evidence, and prepare reporting that is precise about what the data does and does not support.

· Identify adoption barriers—including workflow fit, confidence, risk concerns, or unclear ownership—and put practical recovery actions in place.

· Support fit-for-purpose responsible-use controls, including review steps, quality checks, and clear accountability for priority use cases.

· Work alongside forward deployed AI engineers as they build against the customer’s real systems and data, translating what is technically possible into workflow designs people will actually use.

· Own the quality and credibility of your work, bring the hard calls to a Principal Consultant early, and turn what you learn in the field into methods the team can reuse.

Required Qualifications:

You’re a fit for the Senior AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services role if you have:

· Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Organizational Transformation, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

· 5+ years in professional services, consulting, transformation, change management, or complex AI or enterprise-technology delivery, subject to HR leveling.

· Experience independently leading defined customer engagements or workstreams within agreed scope, timelines, and commercial expectations.

· Experience assessing professional workflows and contributing to targeted workflow and operating changes that support technology-enabled outcomes.

· Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder-management skills across business, legal, operational, technology, and end-user groups.

· Analytical ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative evidence, establish success measures, and recommend clear next actions.

title: Technical Advisor, COE 5 - Pressure Control Equipment
description:
About the Role

As a Technical Advisor within the Centre of Excellence (COE 5), you will provide advanced technical support for NOV Pressure Control Equipment and act as an escalation point for complex issues requiring deeper technical analysis, continuity, and coordination.

Working from our Forfar location, you will support internal stakeholders and external customers across NOV’s global installed base. The environment can be fast-paced and high-stakes, particularly when technical issues affect or potentially affect customer operations. Success therefore requires strong technical judgement, structured problem-solving, clear communication, and the ability to remain effective under pressure.

This is a collaborative role with individual ownership of escalated technical cases. You will work closely with subject matter experts, Technical Advisors, Technical Leaders, Product Engineering, service teams, and other specialists to progress issues through to resolution. Occasional international travel may be required.

About NOV

NOV is a global provider of technology, equipment, and services supporting energy production and industrial operations. Through its engineering, manufacturing, service, and digital capabilities, NOV helps customers improve operational performance, safety, reliability, and efficiency across drilling, completion, production, marine, industrial, and energy transition activities worldwide.

Within this environment, the Pressure Control Equipment team supports technically complex equipment with a global operational footprint, connecting field experience, technical support, service operations, and engineering expertise.

Your Impact

You will contribute to the team’s ability to provide reliable technical escalation support for Pressure Control Equipment, helping resolve complex field challenges while maintaining effective communication with customers and internal stakeholders.

Beyond individual technical cases, you will contribute to product reliability and performance improvement by identifying trends, providing structured technical feedback, supporting root cause analysis, and connecting field experience with Product Engineering and other technical functions.

Development & Team Environment

You will join a collaborative technical environment where knowledge sharing and day-to-day interaction are an important part of how the team operates. Onboarding will combine practical, on-the-job learning with established work instructions, internal tools, and product-specific training where appropriate.

The role provides opportunities to broaden your technical knowledge, gain exposure across NOV’s global operations, and develop through experience with complex equipment and customer challenges. Career development is not limited to a single linear path, with experience in the COE providing exposure that can support future technical and broader opportunities across NOV.

Diversity & Inclusion

At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex Pressure Control Equipment issues, providing advanced analysis and recommendations to internal teams and customers.
  • Provide advanced technical product support to global subject matter experts supporting NOV’s internal and external customer base.
  • Investigate complex equipment issues using structured fault-finding and root cause analysis techniques, including methods such as 5 Whys and Fishbone analysis.
  • Analyze product performance and reliability trends and provide structured technical feedback to Product Engineering regarding design, maintenance, and operational performance.
  • Prepare technical reports, damage assessments, corrective action recommendations, work scopes, and other documentation supporting issue resolution.
  • Coordinate with Product Engineering, Global Product Engineering, service teams, technical specialists, and other NOV business groups to resolve multidisciplinary technical challenges.
  • Support customer and internal stakeholder meetings by evaluating technical issues, communicating recommendations, documenting agreed actions, and following issues through to resolution.
  • Contribute to technical knowledge and competency development by supporting training materials, competency activities, and knowledge sharing across the technical support organization.
  • Review technical and product information and contribute to the evaluation of new products, tools, services, product notifications, and performance improvement opportunities.
  • Perform work in accordance with NOV quality, HSE, and applicable operational procedures and support continuous improvement across the COE technical support network.

Essential Qualifications

  • Technical diploma or an equivalent combination of relevant education and practical technical experience.
  • Proven experience with NOV BOP Pressure Control Systems, including subsea and/or surface BOP equipment and associated control systems.

Share knowledge, train and develop less experienced technicians.

Able to work in confined areas.

Able to climb ladders and stairs.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the Role

As a Data Analyst at NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions, you will serve as the primary technical and analytical support for our real-time and memory-based drilling services. Acting as a key focal point across up to three rigs at a time, you will monitor operations, interpret complex downhole datasets, and provide timely recommendations that enhance drilling performance, manage risk, and protect wellbore integrity.

You will support Project Managers as an in-house drilling advisor, own critical analytical workflows (from optimization reporting to post-well reviews), and act as a technical escalation point for both internal teams and clients. This role combines deep drilling domain knowledge with strong analytical skills and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to new software solutions, advanced tools, and industry-leading technical publications.

About the Company

NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions is a business group within the NOV Energy Products and Services segment, specializing in drilling automation and optimization through the use of real-time downhole data. By deploying Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) technology and Along-String Measurement (ASM) tools, we enable the transmission of high-density, low-latency data from downhole systems to surface teams. This includes key metrics such as temperature, pressure, rotation, and vibration data, which contribute to smarter, safer, and more efficient drilling operations. As demand grows, we continue to expand our operations and analytics teams to drive innovation and excellence for our customers.

What We Offer

Joining National Oilwell Varco means becoming part of a dynamic, international team committed to delivering outstanding results. We provide:

  • Challenging Assignments: Work on complex, high-impact drilling and well construction projects where advanced analytics directly influence operational decisions.
  • Career Development: Access strong technical career paths, mentoring, and opportunities to grow as a Data Analyst across drilling dynamics, data analytics, and digital solutions.
  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Thrive in an open and informal work environment where teamwork, innovation, and personal responsibility are valued.
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with world-class clients, internal experts, and third-party partners on regional and global projects.

At NOV, your contributions make a difference. We look forward to welcoming motivated individuals ready to take their careers to the next level.

Why Join Our Global Family

We are a purpose-driven company on a mission to empower the global energy industry. At NOV, we foster a culture of inclusion where every employee is valued for their unique background, experiences, and perspectives. We believe in recognizing talent and providing opportunities for growth, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about drilling data, optimization, and technical excellence—and want your work to directly shape safer, more efficient operations for our customers—we would be excited to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the main focal point for technical and analytical support across assigned rigs.
  • Provide daily technical oversight for real-time operations and tool performance.
  • Generate optimization reports with key events, mitigations, and recommendations.
  • Deliver operational intervention support on drilling dynamics, pressure management, and wellbore integrity.
  • Conduct BHA and operational design reviews, trajectory advice, and scope-of-work reviews.
  • Perform detailed performance and failure analysis using high-frequency memory data.
  • Support field testing and rollout of new tools, software, and technical changes.
  • Own the peer review process for technical service delivery and reporting.
  • Develop and deliver internal and customer technical training; mentor senior operations staff.
  • Collaborate with client engineering and subsurface teams and contribute to technical publications.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Preferably 3-5 years’ experience in drilling operations, including significant exposure to DD/LWD and drilling optimization, or equivalent combination of field and analytical experience.
  • Strong expertise in drilling dynamics, BHA design, trajectory management, and well integrity concepts.
  • Demonstrated experience in performance analysis, high-frequency data interpretation, and failure investigation.
  • Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear operational recommendations and client-ready reports.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (operations, subsurface, engineering, quality, and software).
  • Comfortable presenting technical findings to internal stakeholders, clients, and at industry forums; experience authoring technical papers is an advantage.
  • Proficient in standard data analysis and visualization tools; experience with advanced analytics, scripting, or programming languages is a plus.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are an asset.

title: Refrigeration Technician III
description:
What You'll Do

You will independently perform advanced refrigeration maintenance and repair throughout the warehouse to support operational objectives. Responsibilities include setting up and monitoring refrigeration equipment, troubleshooting systems, replacing components, and ensuring compliance with safety standards. You will also oversee contractors, participate in operational excellence initiatives, and assist in training less experienced technicians.

Essential Functions

  • Define and set up operational settings and parameters for all refrigeration equipment.
  • Monitor system performance and take actions to ensure optimal operation.
  • Troubleshoot refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and control systems to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.

  • Perform routine and complex maintenance and repairs on various warehouse equipment in accordance with OSHA standards.
  • Oversee and inspect work of internal and external technicians for compliance and quality control and assist in training and development of less experienced technicians.
  • Maintain accurate preventive and predictive maintenance records and participate in operational excellence initiatives.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • Minimum 5 years of industrial refrigeration maintenance experience.
  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
  • Completion of assigned industrial refrigeration and mechanical-electrical courses required.
  • HAZMAT training and certification required.
  • Experience troubleshooting and repairing control systems such as ALTA and Allen Bradley and maintaining records within a Computerized Maintenance Management System.

What Could Set You Apart

  • Experience working in a cold storage environment.
  • RETA CIRO or CARO certifications.
  • Experience using Oracle Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Demonstrated experience performing root cause analysis and component-level diagnostics on industrial refrigeration systems.
  • Experience providing formal or informal technical training and mentorship to junior refrigeration technicians.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures of minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius) and outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold, and precipitation).
  • Able to work at heights in excess of 30 ft. (9 meters) and access elevated platforms, catwalks, and roofs.
  • Able to work in confined areas.
  • Able to climb ladders and stairs.
  • Able frequently to stand, walk, push, pull, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, and/or crouch.
  • Able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds (23 kg) frequently.
  • Able to operate hand and power tools safely.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job including close vision, distance vision, color vision, and depth perception. (Use of contacts are prohibited when working with ammonia.)
  • Depending on specific role, able to pass a physical and respiratory/respirator fit exam.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for any/all tasks.

title: NDT Inspector
description:
Ensure that products comply with specifications by performing Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) and visual inspection.

Inspection

  • Inspect materials using various Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, including:
    • Visual Inspection (VT)
    • Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI)
  • Report any detected defects or deviations.
  • Perform surface improvements (e.g., grinding) to evaluate inspection indications.
  • Cross-check inspected products.
  • Verify that all required materials and documentation are available before inspection.

Inspection Reporting

  • Document and report all identified defects and non-conformities.

Minor Equipment Maintenance

  • Keep inspection equipment in good working condition by performing routine preventive maintenance.

Job Characteristics

Communication

  • Discuss inspection progress and any issues with the Cell Support Team (including the Cell Captain, Cell Managers, and Cell Planner).
  • Discuss uncertainties, defects, and NDT acceptance tolerances with the QC Manager.
  • Discuss rejected products with Production and the QC Manager.
  • Exchange information with the Purchasing department regarding the quality of castings.
  • Discuss welding waiver reports with the Engineering department and colleagues.
  • Communicate in English when required.

Authority

  • Perform non-destructive testing in accordance with established procedures.
  • Reject products when necessary, in consultation with the Cell Support Team.

Responsibilities

  • Correctly inspecting products according to specifications and procedures.
  • Performing and documenting periodic inspections as described in company procedures.
  • Reporting deviations and non-conformities.
  • Recording relevant inspection data in the computerized system.

Competencies

  • Quality Awareness
  • Independence
  • Teamwork
  • Accuracy
  • Judgment / Decision Making

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education level: VMBO+ (vocational secondary education) or equivalent work and thinking level.
  • NDT Level II certification.
  • Magnetic Particle Limited I – No formal training required.
  • Magnetic Particle Level I – 70 hours of training (typically completed within 0.5–3 months).
  • Magnetic Particle Level II – 210 hours of training (typically completed within 1.5–9 months).
  • Visual Inspection Level I – 70 hours of training (typically completed within 0.5–3 months).
  • Visual Inspection Level II – 140 hours of training (typically completed within 1.5–9 months).
  • Dutch language proficiency.
  • Basic English language skills.

title: Senior Simulation Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Simulation Engineer to design and develop dynamic simulation models for our flexible pipe production facility using AnyLogic. The role will focus on modeling complex manufacturing lines, continuous pipe production, material flow, machine utilization, storage reel capacities, downtime events, and throughput projections. The engineer will support production optimization, bottleneck analysis, and capacity planning through accurate simulation models and data-driven insights.

  • Develop discrete-event, continuous/rate-based, and agent-based simulation models using AnyLogic.
  • Model flexible pipe manufacturing processes, including production lines, machines, rollers/reels, buffers, operators, and material flow.
  • Simulate continuous pipe production, line speeds, material consumption, reel transfers, and storage limitations.
  • Model production interruptions such as bobbin depletion, welding stops, reel changes, changeovers, restart delays, and machine downtime.
  • Analyze bottlenecks, machine utilization, WIP, storage capacity, throughput, and production constraints.
  • Create input parameters, scenarios, dashboards, charts, and output reports within AnyLogic.
  • Integrate with ML for iterating model behavior.

title: Development Engineer (Extrusion Process)
location: Sao Joao da Barra, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Development Engineer - Extrusion Process Team

Location: Porto do Açu, São João da Barra, Brazil

About the Role

Good engineering is not done only at a desk. Some of the most important answers are found on the production floor, where materials, machines, settings and people meet in real production. In this role, you will work with that reality every day.

As Development Engineer in NOV's Extrusion Process Team, you will help develop, improve and troubleshoot the extrusion processes behind some of the world's most advanced flexible pipe systems. You will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Projects and R&D to understand technical challenges, find the root causes and turn good ideas into reliable solutions in production.

Previous extrusion experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. We are looking for an engineer who is curious, structured and willing to learn. Someone who asks why, who enjoys complex problems, and who wants to understand how a manufacturing process really behaves before deciding how to improve it.

About NOV

NOV is a global leader in the design and production of advanced flexible pipe systems. With manufacturing facilities in Denmark and Brazil and a robust global engineering network, we are committed to technical innovation, quality, and operational excellence.

What We Offer

  • A skilled international team with a strong focus on extrusion, manufacturing technology and practical problem solving.
  • A role where your work is visible in real production and contributes directly to safety, quality, productivity and process robustness.
  • Technical challenges that require both analytical thinking and hands-on validation on the production floor.
  • Close collaboration with colleagues across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Projects and R&D.
  • The opportunity to influence manufacturing performance across our production sites in Denmark and Brazil.
  • Professional development in a highly specialized area with long-term importance for NOV's flexible pipe production.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and standardize extrusion processes to improve safety, quality, productivity and process robustness.
  • Lead technical investigations of complex production deviations together with Quality, Operations and Maintenance, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Support the introduction of new equipment and ensure new technology is transferred successfully into production.
  • Work across Production, Maintenance, Quality, Projects and R&D to solve technical challenges and improve manufacturing performance.
  • Validate ideas through practical trials, data analysis and close interaction with the production floor.
  • Share knowledge across our manufacturing sites in Denmark and Brazil and travel internationally when required, typically 0-2 trips per year.

Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Materials, Manufacturing or a related Engineering discipline.
  • You enjoy analysing technical problems and finding practical solutions.
  • You are naturally curious and interested in understanding how manufacturing processes really work.
  • You are comfortable working independently as well as in multidisciplinary teams, including direct interaction with the production floor.
  • You communicate clearly in English and can explain technical topics to colleagues from different functions and backgrounds.
  • You take a structured and quality-conscious approach to technical work and documentation.

Preferred

  • Experience with extrusion or other continuous manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with process improvement, production troubleshooting or Root Cause Analysis.

Why Join Us?

At NOV, your ideas do not stay on the drawing board. They are tested, challenged and used in production. You will join a team that values technical curiosity, practical problem solving and knowledge sharing, and where good engineering is measured by how well it works in real life.

If you want a role where you continue learning, work on technically demanding challenges and see the impact of your solutions in production, we would like to hear from you.

Please note: Only applications in English will be taken into consideration.

title: Field Instructor
description:
Benefits:

Cal-Wood Mission & Philosophy

Cal-Wood Education Center is on a mission to facilitate positive nature experiences for all—especially those who haven't yet spent time in the mountains. Since 1982, Cal-Wood has provided residential environmental and outdoor education programs to hundreds of thousands of Coloradans at our 1,200-acre outdoor classroom located west of Boulder, Colorado. Through school programs, summer camps, and family camps, we provide access for kids and adults from underrepresented communities to have life-changing experiences outdoors.

We believe that no matter where you live or what language you speak, you deserve to feel safe and welcome outside. We strive to grow our programs so that more people from all walks of life can find a meaningful connection with nature.

Cal-Wood has received several national and local awards for our high-quality programs and service to linguistically diverse audiences. Our field instructors receive training in sheltered instruction and inclusive teaching practices to help them effectively engage all students—from Commerce City to Aurora to Boulder and beyond. Instructors provide dynamic, hands-on science education in the field so that all students can explore, learn, and see themselves as scientists.

Position Overview

Cal-Wood seeks a Field Instructor whose primary duty is teaching environmental science curriculum to K–12 students in an outdoor setting. Field Instructors work in our beautiful 1,200-acre outdoor classroom alongside a motivated team passionate about natural science, education, and conservation.

Instructors are responsible for providing educational experiences for learning groups of 10–15 students by leading outdoor learning activities and teaching environmental science lessons. Programs range from one-day visits to three-day overnight trips for local students of all ages. Instructors are charged with teaching instructional modules in outdoor skills and environmental science, including applied lessons in ecology, wildlife biology, and outdoor field studies. Utilizing Cal-Wood's curriculum and materials, Instructors independently develop lesson plans, select instructional methods, adapt curriculum to meet student needs, and evaluate student performance.

This position begins January 11, 2027 and runs through December 17, 2027, with the possibility of extending employment for additional seasons.

This position is a seasonal, full-time role.
Salary, Exempt.

Schedule

  • Monday through Friday, with some evening and weekend shifts as needed
  • Average 40-hour work week
  • Programs may require early mornings, evenings, and overnight presence for facilitation (note: Instructors do not sleep in cabins with students)

Responsibilities

75% Teaching:

  • Lead a learning group of 10–15 students during each school’s visit; typical programs run 2–3 days
  • Spend 4–8 hours per day, 3–5 days per week, leading programs outdoors in all seasons in the mountains of Colorado
  • Develop, teach, and evaluate environmental education programs aligned with local curriculum standards
  • Incorporate science, math, history, creative writing, art, and team-building into programs as requested by schools
  • Teach English, Spanish, and multilingual groups with sheltered teaching methods.
25% Support

  • Lead large-group games, songs, skits, storytelling, and campfires to foster a fun, inclusive environment
  • Facilitate 1–2 meals (breakfasts and/or dinners) and 1–2 evening programs (typically a night hike or campfire) each week
  • Assist with maintenance of program staff commons areas, organize educational materials, gear room, and staff office

Qualities & Qualifications

  • Bilingual in Spanish and English (preferred)
  • Individuals from underrepresented groups are encouraged to apply
  • High level of personal motivation, flexibility, and responsibility, with a positive attitude
  • Bachelor’s degree in science, natural resources management, education, environmental education, or a related field
  • Two or more years of teaching experience.
  • Ability to work and live closely with a small, passionate instructional team (approximately 10–15 staff members)
  • Comfortable living in a remote mountain town approximately 35 minutes from Boulder, CO (optional housing available)
  • Ability to pass background checks and motor vehicle report
  • Ability to hike 3–6 miles daily, lift up to 50 lbs for short periods (sometimes multiple times per day), and work outdoors in all weather conditions
  • Ability to learn and implement sheltered teaching methods through on-the-job training.
  • Current First Aid/CPR certification or willingness to obtain certification required; Wilderness First Aid (WFA) or Wilderness First Responder (WFR) certification is a plus
Benefits
  • Health
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • Simple IRA with 3% employer match
  • Life AD&D insurance
  • Optional employee housing (free rent and utilities)

title: Project Manager
description:
About the Role
As a Project Manager, you will lead engineering projects throughout their full lifecycle, ensuring they are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in line with customer expectations. Acting as the primary point of contact for customers, you will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage project risks, and maintain clear communication throughout every stage of project execution.


About the Team
You'll become part of a collaborative Project Management team within NOV's Fluid Motion Solutions business. Working closely with colleagues across Commercial, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics, and Operations, you'll gain broad exposure to the complete manufacturing process while contributing to successful project delivery.


Why This Role Matters
This is a role where no two projects are the same. You'll balance technical requirements, production priorities, and customer expectations while working with multiple stakeholders across the business. Success comes from building strong relationships, making sound decisions, and keeping projects moving in a fast-paced engineering environment.


About NOV
NOV is a global provider of technology-driven equipment, systems, services, and software solutions supporting energy production and industrial operations worldwide. Within our Fluid Motion Solutions business, we design, manufacture, and support pumping and fluid handling technologies that help customers improve reliability, efficiency, and operational performance.

What We Offer
• A varied role where every project presents new technical and operational challenges.
• The opportunity to work with experienced professionals across multiple engineering and manufacturing disciplines.
• A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and teamwork are essential to success.
• The autonomy to manage your own projects while being supported by established processes and experienced colleagues.
• Career development opportunities within a global engineering organisation, with potential to explore different functions as your career grows.

Diversity & Inclusion
At NOV, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We value diversity in all its forms and believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

• Lead customer projects from order acceptance through engineering, manufacturing, testing, and final delivery.

title: Beauty Counter Manager - Clinique, Greenwood - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Counter Manager, you will lead a dynamic team of Beauty Advisors while managing all aspects of a specific cosmetics brand. Your role blends leadership, creativity, and customer engagement—delivering genuine hospitality through personalized consultations, expert product application, and a deep understanding of each customer’s beauty and style preferences.

You’ll inspire teamwork to drive sales and elevate the customer experience by creating meaningful, long-lasting connections. With a strong focus on client development, you will cultivate a loyal customer base through outreach, follow-up, and consistent, personalized service.

In addition to meeting and exceeding sales goals, you’ll analyze business performance, execute vendor events and promotions, and partner with vendors and store leadership to grow the business. You'll also oversee stock presentation, hygiene standards, and team performance to ensure an exceptional and polished brand experience.

How Our Counter Managers Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Counter Manager, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by coaching them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate flexibility, sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry

title: Hydrotest
description:
To safely execute hydrostatic pressure testing activities, ensuring piping systems and pressure vessels meet design, quality, and integrity requirements prior to commissioning and operation.

  • Support construction, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities while promoting a strong safety culture and teamwork.
Execute hydrostatic pressure testing activities safely and efficiently, ensuring piping systems and pressure vessels meet project quality, integrity, and commissioning requirements while maintaining full compliance with safety procedures and industry standards as per below.

  • Install and remove test blinds, hoses, pumps, pressure gauges, and other hydrotest equipment.

  • Inspect systems for leaks, pressure drops, or other abnormalities during testing.
  • Assist in filling, venting, pressurizing, depressurizing, and draining test systems.
  • Establish and maintain hydrotest exclusion zones and safety barriers.

  • Testing and Validation: Conducting rigorous testing and validation of upgrades to ensure they meet operational requirements and performance expectations.
  1. Regulatory Compliance:
  • Standards Adherence: Ensuring radar systems comply with relevant industry standards (e.g., FCC regulations, ITAR) and safety protocols.
  • Documentation: Maintaining accurate documentation of modifications, upgrades, and compliance records.
  1. Training and Knowledge Transfer:
  • Operator Training: Developing training programs and materials for radar operators on system operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance procedures.
  • Team Collaboration: Working closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to achieve project goals and deadlines.
Skills and Qualifications
  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in radar systems are advantageous.
  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in radar theory, antenna design, signal processing, and radar performance analysis. Ten (10) years of related technical experience.
  • Previous Military experience in related field a plus
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze radar data, identify trends, and make data-driven recommendations for system improvements.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose complex radar issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Clear and concise communication abilities to convey technical information to diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders. Bi-lingual a plus.
  • Project Management: Experience in managing radar upgrade projects from conception through to implementation and validation.
  • US Citizen: Ability to obtain security clearance
  • Must be able to stand, climb stairs, and be able to carry 30 lbs.
Work Schedule
  • This full-time position typically works during our standard business hours
  • There is the possibility of domestic and international travel required with this position. Candidate must have a valid passport or able to obtain one.
As a Radar Engineer specializing in the TPS-43/70/72/75/78, FPS-117, TPS-77, TPS-59 family, continual professional development is crucial to stay updated with advancements in radar technology, regulatory changes, and industry best practices. title: Maintenance Lead
description:
What You'll Do

You will oversee and guide maintenance associates to ensure department objectives are met while performing maintenance technician duties. You will lead troubleshooting, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration and material handling equipment, monitor system performance, and recommend corrective actions. You will coordinate contractor activities, maintain preventive maintenance records, and support continuous improvement efforts across the site.

Essential Functions

  • Provide oversight and guidance to maintenance associates to ensure execution of department objectives and assignments.
  • Perform operation, repair, and adjustment of refrigeration systems and material handling equipment.
  • Monitor equipment and system performance, recommend corrective actions, and analyze reliability and availability.
  • Troubleshoot building, refrigeration, and equipment systems to drive root cause analysis and implement solutions.
  • Direct and oversee contractor work and inspect completed tasks for compliance with specifications and safety standards.
  • Maintain accurate preventive maintenance records and lead continuous improvement initiatives across the site.
  • Support capability development of facility technicians and ensure effective communication across all maintenance shifts.
  • Other essential duties may be applicable and assigned as necessary.

What Experience and Education You Need

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum 5 years of industrial maintenance experience, or minimum 2 years of industrial maintenance experience plus supervisory or lead experience.
  • Skilled in industrial refrigeration, material handling equipment, dock door and leveler, plumbing, electrical, and building maintenance.
  • Required to complete assigned industrial refrigeration and maintenance courses and obtain HAZMAT certification.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) programs in an industrial setting, and proficiency in using Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and Microsoft Office Suite.

What Could Set You Apart

  • CARO or CIRO certification.
  • Experience using Oracle Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Experience training and developing less experienced technicians.
  • Experience overseeing and inspecting work performed by maintenance associates.
  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to tolerate working environment with inside controlled temperatures of minus 45 (-45) degrees Fahrenheit (-43 degrees Celsius) and outside ambient temperatures (including heat, cold, and precipitation).
  • Able to work at heights in excess of 30 ft. (9 meters) and access elevated platforms, catwalks, and roofs.
  • Able to work in confined areas.
  • Able to climb ladders and stairs.
  • Able frequently to stand, walk, push, pull, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, and/or crouch.
  • Able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds (23 kg) frequently.
  • Able to operate hand and power tools safely.
  • Able to meet specific vision abilities required by this job including close vision, distance vision, color vision, and depth perception. (Use of contacts is prohibited when working with ammonia.)
  • Depending on specific role, able to pass a physical and respiratory/respirator fit exam.
  • Able to frequently step up/on or step down/off to mount and dismount material handling equipment.
  • Able to perform fine articulation movements with fingers/hands and/or feet to operate equipment.
  • Able to wear personal protective equipment required for any/all tasks.
